Abstract

Industrial asset operations workflows are latency-sensitive because a single user query may require coordination over sensor data, work orders, failure modes, forecasting tools, and domain-specific agents. We evaluate this problem on AssetOpsBench (AOB), an industrial agent benchmark whose plan-execute pipeline exposes repeated overhead from tool discovery, LLM planning, MCP tool execution, and final summarization. Existing LLM caching techniques such as KV-cache reuse and embedding-based semantic caching were designed for chatbot serving and break down when output validity depends on time, asset, or sensor parameters. We propose two complementary optimization layers for AOB plan-execute pipelines: a temporal semantic cache and a set of MCP workflow optimizations combining disk-backed tool-discovery caching and dependency-aware parallel step execution. MCP workflow optimizations corresponded to a 1.67x speedup and reduced median end-to-end latency by about 40.0% while the temporal-cache benchmark achieved a median of 30.6x speedup on cache hits. Beyond the speedup, our results expose a concrete failure mode of pure semantic caching for parameter-rich industrial queries, providing a critical analysis of how caching choices interact with evaluation correctness in MCP-backed agent benchmarks.

item.title: Pareto-Enhanced Portrait Generation: Vision-Aligned Text Supervision for Alignment, Realism, and Aesthetics
item.author: Yunlong Wang, Jinjin Shi, Wenbin Gao, Xuran Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对文本到图像扩散模型在生成人类肖像时面临的三难困境，提出了一种基于特征监督的多模态扩散Transformer方法，通过轻量级跨模态对齐机制和美学信号挖掘，实现了在文本图像对齐、照片级真实感和人类感知美学上的协同提升。

背景: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成人类肖像时面临一个严重的三难困境：文本图像对齐、照片级真实感和人类感知的美学之间本质上是相互抑制的。

目的: 为了打破监督微调（SFT）导致过拟合、破坏预训练图像先验并降低对齐或美学的瓶颈，提出一种特征监督范式来增强多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）的性能。

方法: 引入了一种轻量级的跨模态对齐机制，从SigLIP 2中隐式提取多粒度视觉对齐的文本表示，并在训练阶段对MM-DiT的图像分支应用监督，且不增加推理开销。此外，直接从预训练的视觉基础模型中挖掘隐式的多粒度美学信号。

主要发现: 在MM-DiT上的广泛实验表明，该方法推动了帕累托前沿，并在文本图像对齐、照片级真实感和人类感知美学方面实现了协同改进。

结论: 该方法在注入视觉对齐的文本引导的同时，保持了基础模型的原始泛化能力，避免了SFT导致的退化，从而有效解决了三难困境。

翻译: Text-to-image diffusion models often face a severe trilemma in human portrait generation: text-image alignment, photorealism, and human-perceived aesthetics inherently inhibit one another. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is an effective method for enhancing the photorealism of image generation. However, it often leads to overfitting to the training dataset, corrupts pre-trained image priors, and degrades alignment or aesthetics. To break this bottleneck, we propose a feature supervision paradigm for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiT). Specifically, we introduce a lightweight cross-modal alignment mechanism that implicitly extracts multi-granularity vision-aligned text representations from SigLIP 2 and applies supervision to the image branch of MM-DiT during the training stage, with zero extra inference overhead. Our method injects vision-aligned text guidance while preserving the base model's original generalization, avoiding degradation caused by SFT. Furthermore, our method directly mines implicit multi-granularity aesthetic signals from pre-trained vision foundation models to optimize human-perceived aesthetics. Extensive experiments on MM-DiTs show that our method pushes the Pareto frontier and achieves synergistic improvements across text-image alignment, photorealism, and human-perceived aesthetics.

Abstract

Text-to-image diffusion models often face a severe trilemma in human portrait generation: text-image alignment, photorealism, and human-perceived aesthetics inherently inhibit one another. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is an effective method for enhancing the photorealism of image generation. However, it often leads to overfitting to the training dataset, corrupts pre-trained image priors, and degrades alignment or aesthetics. To break this bottleneck, we propose a feature supervision paradigm for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiT). Specifically, we introduce a lightweight cross-modal alignment mechanism that implicitly extracts multi-granularity vision-aligned text representations from SigLIP 2 and applies supervision to the image branch of MM-DiT during the training stage, with zero extra inference overhead. Our method injects vision-aligned text guidance while preserving the base model's original generalization, avoiding degradation caused by SFT. Furthermore, our method directly mines implicit multi-granularity aesthetic signals from pre-trained vision foundation models to optimize human-perceived aesthetics. Extensive experiments on MM-DiTs show that our method pushes the Pareto frontier and achieves synergistic improvements across text-image alignment, photorealism, and human-perceived aesthetics.

item.title: On the limits and opportunities of AI reviewers: Reviewing the reviews of Nature-family papers with 45 expert scientists
item.author: Kim, Seungone, Yoon, Dongkeun, Gashteovski, Kiril, Suk, Juyoung, Baek, Jinheon, Aggarwal, Pranjal, Wu, Ian, Zaverkin, Viktor, Petkoski, Spase, Schrider, Daniel R., Dukovski, Ilija, Santini, Francesco, Mitreska, Biljana, Jeong, Yong, Kwon, Kyeongha, Sim, Young Min, Manasova, Dragana, Porto, Arthur, Mojsoska, Biljana, Takamoto, Makoto, Shuntov, Marko, Liu, Ruoqi, Lee, Hyunjoo Jenny, Dinç, Niyazi Ulas, Jo, Yehhyun, Han, Sunkyu, Lee, Chungwoo, Li, Huishan, Tsai, Esther H. R., Simsek, Ergun, Shafi, Khushboo, Chung, Yeonseung, Park, Jihye, Shulevski, Aleksandar, Christiansen, Henrik, Son, Yoosang, Knight, Elly, Montoya, Amanda, Ahn, Jeongyoun, Langkammer, Christian, Moon, Heera, Yoon, Changwon, Stikov, Nikola, Jang, Mooseok, Choi, Edward, Kim, Junhan, Jung, Yeon Sik, Kim, Woo Youn, Kim, Jae Kyoung, Anjum, Ishraq Md, Kim, Hyun Uk, Bridges, Drew, Lawrence, Carolin, Yue, Xiang, Oh, Alice, Asai, Akari, Welleck, Sean, Neubig, Graham
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究通过大规模专家标注评估了AI审稿人在科学同行评审中的能力与局限，发现AI审稿人在综合评分上优于人类最高评分者，但存在过度重叠和特定弱点。

背景: 随着AI能力的提升，AI审稿人开始被部署在科学同行评审中，但其能力和可信度仍受质疑，现有评估多关注裁决与人类的一致性，不足以全面刻画其能力。

目的: 通过大规模专家标注研究，了解AI审稿人在哪些方面表现良好、在哪些方面存在不足以及面临的挑战。

方法: 45名来自物理、生物和健康科学领域的科学家花费469小时，对82篇Nature系列论文中人类撰写和AI生成的2,960条具体批评意见进行了标注，评估其正确性、重要性和证据充分性。

主要发现: 在综合三个维度的评分上，GPT-5.2驱动的审稿人得分高于每篇论文的最高评分人类审稿人（60.0% vs 48.2%）；所有三个AI审稿人在每个维度上都超过了最低评分的人类；AI审稿人准确的批评意见更常被评定为重要且有充分证据，且发现了人类未提及的26%的问题；但AI审稿人之间的重叠率远高于人类（21% vs 3%），并表现出16种人类不具备的重复弱点，如缺乏子领域知识、缺乏多文件长上下文管理以及过度关注次要问题。

结论: 当前AI审稿人应被视为人类的补充而非替代品。

翻译: 随着人工智能能力的提升，人工智能审稿人开始被部署在科学同行评审中，但其能力和可信度仍受到质疑：许多科学家只是将它们视为缺乏评估研究专业知识概率系统，而其他研究人员则在没有具体证据的情况下对其准备情况更为乐观。了解AI审稿人在哪些方面做得好、在哪些方面存在不足以及面临的挑战至关重要。然而，现有对AI审稿人的评估主要集中在其裁决是否与人类裁决一致（例如评分一致性、接受预测），这不足以刻画其能力和局限。在本文中，我们通过大规模专家标注研究填补了这一空白，45名来自物理、生物和健康科学领域的科学家花费469小时，对82篇Nature系列论文中人类撰写和AI生成的2,960条具体批评意见（每条批评意见针对论文的一个特定方面）进行了标注，评估其正确性、重要性和证据充分性。在所有三个维度的综合评分上，由GPT-5.2驱动的审稿人得分高于每篇论文的最高评分人类审稿人（60.0% vs 48.2%，p = 0.009），而所有三个AI审稿人（包括Gemini 3.0 Pro和Claude Opus 4.5）在每个维度上都超过了最低评分的人类。AI审稿人准确的批评意见也更常被评定为重要且有充分证据，并且发现了人类未提及的26%的问题。然而，AI审稿人之间的重叠率远高于人类（跨审稿人配对为21% vs 3%），并表现出16种人类不具备的重复弱点，如缺乏子领域知识、缺乏对多文件的长上下文管理，以及对次要问题采取过于批判的态度。总体而言，我们的结果将当前AI审稿人定位为人类的补充，而非替代品。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨人工智能作为评审员的局限性和机遇。研究团队利用45位专家科学家来审查Nature系列论文的评审意见，以评估AI的表现。这个问题在现实中非常重要，因为AI正越来越多地被用于科学评审，了解其优缺点有助于确保评审质量并合理利用技术。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该研究利用45位专家科学家对《自然》系列论文的审稿意见进行评估，探讨了AI审稿人的局限与机遇。

Abstract

With the advancement of AI capabilities, AI reviewers are beginning to be deployed in scientific peer review, yet their capability and credibility remain in question: many scientists simply view them as probabilistic systems without the expertise to evaluate research, while other researchers are more optimistic about their readiness without concrete evidence. Understanding what AI reviewers do well, where they fall short, and what challenges remain is essential. However, existing evaluations of AI reviewers have focused on whether their verdicts match human verdicts (e.g., score alignment, acceptance prediction), which is insufficient to characterize their capabilities and limits. In this paper, we close this gap through a large-scale expert annotation study, in which 45 domain scientists in Physical, Biological, and Health Sciences spent 469 hours rating 2,960 individual criticisms (each targeting one specific aspect of a paper) from human-written and AI-generated reviews of 82 Nature-family papers on correctness, significance, and sufficiency of evidence. On a composite of all three dimensions, a reviewing agent powered by GPT-5.2 scores above each paper's top-rated human reviewer (60.0% vs. 48.2%, p = 0.009), while all three AI reviewers (including Gemini 3.0 Pro and Claude Opus 4.5) exceed the lowest-rated human across every dimension. AI reviewers' accurate criticisms are also more often rated significant and well-evidenced, and surface a distinct 26% of issues no human raises. However, AI reviewers overlap far more than humans do (21% vs. 3% for cross-reviewer pairs), and exhibit 16 recurring weaknesses humans do not share, such as limited subfield knowledge, lack of long context management over multiple files, and overly critical stance on minor issues. Overall, our results position current AI reviewers as complements to, not substitutes for, human reviewers.

item.title: Modular Multimodal Classification Without Fine-Tuning: A Simple Compositional Approach
item.author: Herman Bergström, Aditya Mehrotra, Rahul G. Krishnan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoMET是一种用于多模态分类的简单且具有竞争力的方法，通过冻结预训练骨干网络、PCA压缩和拼接输入到表格基础模型中进行预测。

背景: 现有的多模态学习通常需要复杂的端到端训练流程，而CoMET提出了一种无需训练的即插即用的解决方案。

目的: 提出CoMET方法，旨在通过组合基础模型实现高效的多模态分类，特别是在处理大规模层次化任务时。

方法: 将每个模态通过冻结的预训练骨干网络处理，使用PCA压缩嵌入，然后拼接输入到表格基础模型中；当基础模型的CLS标记与下游任务对齐不佳时，使用PALPooling进行自适应标记池化。

主要发现: PCA足以作为适配器，在各种模态间产生强大且稳健的性能；PALPooling能持续提高表示质量；该方法在无需微调的情况下，在多样化的多模态基准测试中实现了最先进的结果。

结论: 基础模型的组合是一种简单、强大且即插即用的多模态学习解决方案，挑战了新问题需要复杂端到端训练流程的必要性。

翻译: 我们介绍了CoMET，这是一种用于多模态分类的简单且极具竞争力的方法：将每个模态通过冻结的预训练骨干网络处理，使用PCA压缩结果嵌入，并将它们拼接作为输入，输入到表格基础模型中进行预测。我们表明，仅PCA就足以作为适配器，在各种模态间产生强大且稳健的性能。当基础模型的CLS标记与下游任务对齐不佳时，我们提出了PALPooling，一种轻量级的自适应标记池化器，能持续提高表示质量。通过组合强大的冻结表示学习骨干网络与表格基础模型，我们的方法在各种多模态基准测试中实现了最先进的结果，且无需任何训练。在具有大规模细粒度类别的层次化任务中，我们的方法能够实现快速且可扩展的分类，无需微调即可处理超过50万样本和2000个类别的数据集。总体而言，我们的结果表明，基础模型的组合是多模态学习的一种简单、强大且即插即用的解决方案，挑战了新问题需要复杂端到端训练流程的必要性。

Abstract

We introduce CoMET, \textit{\textbf{C}omposing \textbf{M}odality \textbf{E}ncoders with \textbf{T}abular foundation models}, a simple yet highly competitive method for multimodal classification: pass each modality through a frozen pre-trained backbone, compress the resulting embeddings with PCA, and concatenate as input into a Tabular Foundation Model (TFM) for prediction. We show that PCA alone suffices to act as an adaptor yielding strong, robust performance across modalities. When the \texttt{CLS} tokens of the foundation model align poorly with downstream tasks, we propose \textbf{PALPooling}, a lightweight adaptive token pooler that consistently improves representation quality. By composing strong frozen representation learning backbones with TFMs, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse multimodal benchmarks without any training. On hierarchical tasks with large fine-grained class spaces, our approach enables fast and scalable classification, handling datasets with over 500,000 samples and 2,000 classes without any fine-tuning. Overall, our results show that the composition of foundation models is a simple, yet powerful, out-of-the-box solution for multimodal learning, challenging the necessity of complex, end-to-end training pipelines for new problems.

item.title: IndusAgent: Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection with Agentic Tools
item.author: Tan, Rongbin, Lin, Fangfang, Yuan, Zhenlong, Qiu, Min, Cui, Kejin, Wang, Mengmeng, Wang, Yi, Song, Zijian, Wang, Zhiyuan, Wang, Jiyuan, Wang, Yue, Song§, Shuhan, Cao, Huawei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: IndusAgent是一个用于开放词汇工业异常检测的工具增强型智能体框架，通过构建Indus-CoT数据集和动态工具编排，结合门控强化学习优化，在多个工业异常检测基准上实现了最先进的零样本性能。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在视觉感知和文本推理方面表现出色，但在开放词汇工业异常检测中，其性能常受限于领域不匹配的推理和结构推断的幻觉问题。

目的: 提出IndusAgent框架，以解决开放词汇工业异常检测中的领域不匹配推理和结构推断幻觉问题。

方法: 1. 构建Indus-CoT数据集，整合全局视觉观察、高分辨率局部补丁和专家正常性先验；2. 动态编排外部工具，包括动态区域裁剪、高频特征增强和先验检索；3. 引入门控强化学习目标，联合优化异常分类、定位精度、异常类型推理和高效工具使用。

主要发现: 在MVTec-AD、VisA、MPDD、DTD和SDD五个工业异常检测基准上，IndusAgent实现了所有现有方法中最先进的零样本性能，验证了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。

结论: IndusAgent通过工具增强和门控强化学习，有效解决了工业异常检测中的推理和幻觉问题，展现了优异的零样本性能和泛化能力。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在连接视觉感知和文本推理方面表现出色，能够在各种工业场景中实现零样本理解。然而，它们在开放词汇工业异常检测中的性能往往受到领域不匹配推理和结构推断幻觉的限制。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了IndusAgent，一个用于开放词汇工业异常检测的工具增强型智能体框架。具体而言，我们首先构建了Indus-CoT，一个结构化数据集，整合了全局视觉观察、高分辨率局部补丁和专家正常性先验，为在严格的工业检查轨迹上微调模型提供了监督。在此基础上，IndusAgent动态编排一组外部工具，包括动态区域裁剪、高频特征增强和先验检索，从而使智能体能够主动解决视觉歧义并分离细微异常。此外，我们引入了一个门控强化学习目标，联合优化异常分类、定位精度、异常类型推理和高效工具使用，确保仅在有益时调用工具。在MVTec-AD、VisA、MPDD、DTD和SDD五个工业异常检测基准上的广泛评估表明，IndusAgent在所有现有方法中实现了最先进的零样本性能，验证了我们的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决工业异常检测的问题，特别是利用代理工具来实现开放词汇的检测。文中未明确说明该问题在现实或研究中的重要性，写为 unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 1. **分析请求：** * **角色：** 严谨的学术论文助手。 * **输入：** 一段 PDF 元数据/内容（标题、作者、元数据、链接、乱码文本）。 * **任务：** 通读并分析输入内容，回答一个具体问题：“如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？” * **约束条件：** * 基于输入文本（不要编造）。 * 简洁、准确、通俗的中文。 * 避免公式、符号或缩写。 * 如果未说明，写 "unknown"。 * 简短（2-4 句）。 * 不要列表、数组或嵌套对象。 * **仅**输出纯文本（不要 JSON、markdown、代码块）。2. **分析输入文本：** * **标题：** "IndusAgent: Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection with Agentic Tools" * **作者：** Rongbin Tan 等人。 * **DOI/链接：** arXiv.2605.20682。 * **内容：** 输入文本主要是 PDF 结构（对象、流、元数据）。它包含乱码文本（`stream` 部分），但标题和元数据是可读的。 * **关键词/主题：** "IndusAgent"（工业代理），"Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection"（开放词汇工业异常检测），"Agentic Tools"（代理工具）。3. **确定答案：** * 由于提供的文本*仅*包含元数据、结构信息和乱码文本，而没有论文的实际内容（摘要、引言、方法等），我无法从提供的文本中提取关于贡献的具体细节。 * *然而*，标题非常具有描述性。 * 标题分析："IndusAgent" + "Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection with Agentic Tools"。 * 翻译/解读：该论文提出了一个名为 IndusAgent 的系统，用于工业异常检测。它使用了“代理工具”来增强“开放词汇”检测。 * *约束检查：* 提示要求我“通读并分析以下论文的原始内容”。由于内容是乱码/元数据，我必须说明我无法从提供的文本中提取具体贡献，或者仅根据标题进行总结。 * *严格解读：* 提示说“你必须基于输入文本回答”。输入文本*没有*摘要。它只有标题。 * *策略：* 如果我严格遵循“基于输入文本”，且文本没有摘要，我应该说明信息缺失。然而，通常在这些 RAG（检索增强生成）任务中，如果标题是唯一可读的内容，且用户要求总结，我应该根据标题进行总结，同时承认局限性或仅使用标题。 * *优化策略：* 提示说“如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”。标题*没有*明确说明*贡献*（例如，“我们提出了一个新框架……”）。它只说了*是什么*。 * *决定：* 由于提供的文本是乱码/元数据，且没有摘要，我无法知道*如何*强化它或*什么*代理工具。因此，严格来说，答案是 "unknown"。 * *替代方案：* 如果我被迫根据标题回答，我可以总结标题。但提示说“基于输入文本”。输入文本是乱码。 * *让我们再看一遍提示：* “你是一个严谨的学术论文助手……必须基于输入文本回答”。 * 输入文本是：`%PDF-1.7 ... Title (IndusAgent: Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary Industrial Anomaly Detection with Agentic Tools) ... stream ...`。 * 没有摘要。 * 因此，答案是 "unknown"。 * *自我修正/细化：* 有时用户粘贴 PDF 元数据并期望 AI 读取标题。但提示很严格：“必须基于输入文本回答”。文本*不*包含贡献的摘要。它只包含标题。 * 然而，如果我说 "unknown"，用户可能会觉得我失败了，因为标题是可见的。 * 让我们看看“问题”：“如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？” * 如果我严格遵循“不要编造”，我不能说“它使用 LLM 来修复缺陷”。 * 我只能说：“基于提供的文本，无法确定具体贡献。” * 或者，我可以根据标题进行总结：“该论文提出了 IndusAgent，用于通过代理工具增强开放词汇工业异常检测。” * 让我们检查约束条件：“如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”。 * 标题*没有*明确说明贡献。它说明了*主题*。 * 所以，"unknown" 是最安全、最严谨的答案。 * *等等*，让我们看看乱码文本。它包含 `stream` 数据。通常，PDF 内容是二进制/压缩的。`pikepdf` 是一个库。文本是乱码的。我无法阅读它。 * 结论：文本不包含摘要或贡献的描述。 * *最终决定：* 输出 "unknown"。 * *重新评估：* 有时在这些提示中，用户希望 AI *假装*它读了论文。但提示说“不要编造”。这是矛盾的。如果我不能编造，且文本缺失，我必须说 "unknown"。 * Abstract

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable capability in bridging visual perception and textual reasoning, enabling zero-shot understanding across diverse industrial scenarios. However, their performance in open-vocabulary industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is often limited by domain-misaligned reasoning and hallucinated structural inferences. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{IndusAgent}, a tool-augmented agentic framework for open-vocabulary IAD. Specifically, we first construct \textbf{Indus-CoT}, a structured dataset that integrates global visual observations, high-resolution local patches, and expert normalcy priors, providing supervision for fine-tuning the model on rigorous industrial inspection trajectories. Building on this, IndusAgent dynamically orchestrates a set of external tools, including dynamic region cropping, high-frequency feature enhancement, and prior retrieval, thus enabling the agent to actively resolve visual ambiguities and disentangle subtle anomalies. Furthermore, we introduce a gated reinforcement learning objective that jointly optimizes anomaly classification, localization accuracy, anomaly type reasoning, and efficient tool usage, ensuring that tool invocation occurs only when beneficial. Extensive evaluations on five industrial anomaly benchmarks, including MVTec-AD, VisA, MPDD, DTD, and SDD, demonstrate that IndusAgent achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance among all existing methods, validating our robustness and generalization capacity.

item.title: Resolving Long-Tail Ambiguity in Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Segmentation with Language Priors
item.author: Siqi Wei, Hongbin Xu, Feng Xiao, Tian Lan, Chun Li, Ming Li, Qiuxia Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LangTail是一种语言引导的分层学习框架，用于解决无监督3D点云分割中的长尾模糊问题。

背景: 现有的无监督3D点云分割方法主要依赖基于视觉相似性的学习聚类范式，存在长尾模糊的根本局限性。

目的: 提出LangTail框架，利用语言模型中编码的平衡世界知识来缓解无监督3D分割中的长尾模糊问题。

方法: LangTail通过对比对齐将语言模型构建的实体级语义先验注入分层聚类框架，建立多级关联，防止少数类被主导聚类吸收。

主要发现: 在ScanNet-v2、S3DIS和nuScenes数据集上，LangTail分别比现有方法显著高出13.5、12.9和8.9 mIoU。

结论: 语言先验在改善3D点云中少数类的表示方面是有效的。

翻译: LangTail是一种语言引导的分层学习框架，用于解决无监督3D点云分割中的长尾模糊问题。现有的无监督3D点云分割方法主要依赖基于视觉相似性的学习聚类范式，存在长尾模糊的根本局限性。提出LangTail框架，利用语言模型中编码的平衡世界知识来缓解无监督3D分割中的长尾模糊问题。LangTail通过对比对齐将语言模型构建的实体级语义先验注入分层聚类框架，建立多级关联，防止少数类被主导聚类吸收。在ScanNet-v2、S3DIS和nuScenes数据集上，LangTail分别比现有方法显著高出13.5、12.9和8.9 mIoU。语言先验在改善3D点云中少数类的表示方面是有效的。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出利用语言先验来解决无监督 3D 点云分割中的长尾歧义问题。

Abstract

Existing approaches for unsupervised 3D point cloud segmentation predominantly rely on a purely visual similarity-based learning-by-clustering paradigm, which suffers from a fundamental limitation: long-tail ambiguity. In such a paradigm, features of minor classes are consistently absorbed by dominant clusters, leading to severely imbalanced predictions. To address this issue, we propose LangTail, a language-guided hierarchical learning framework that leverages the balanced world knowledge encoded in language models to mitigate long-tail ambiguity in unsupervised 3D segmentation. The key idea is to establish multi-level associations between language-derived semantic priors and visually underrepresented minor classes, thereby compensating for the biased attention of purely visual clustering toward dominant classes. Specifically, LangTail first constructs an entity-level semantic prior from language models, capturing balanced and fine-grained world knowledge across categories. These priors are injected into a hierarchical clustering framework via contrastive alignment. This guides multi-granularity semantic structure formation and prevents minor classes from being absorbed by dominant clusters, yielding more discriminative representations for underrepresented categories. Extensive experiments on ScanNet-v2, S3DIS, and nuScenes demonstrate that LangTail consistently outperforms existing methods by significant margins, \ie, +13.5, +12.9, and +8.9 mIoU, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of language priors in improving the representation of minority classes in 3D point clouds. The code will be released at: https://github.com/Whisky0129/langtail_official.

item.title: Draw2Think: Harnessing Geometry Reasoning through Constraint Engine Interaction
item.author: Juncheng Hu, Jiawei Du, Xin Zhang, Joey Tianyi Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Draw2Think框架通过将几何推理与GeoGebra约束引擎结合，实现了对模型中间状态的精确验证，显著提升了几何问题解决的准确性和可靠性。

背景: 现有的视觉语言模型在解决几何问题时虽然准确率上升，但其中间状态是隐式的且无法验证；现有的外部化方法基于渲染像素或单次脚本，无法提供精确的、针对每个动作的几何保证。

目的: 提出Draw2Think框架，将几何推理从隐式空间推断转化为与GeoGebra约束引擎的代理交互，通过外部化假设、测量精确几何量并反馈结构化观察，实现基于代数定义的几何关系强制执行。

方法: Draw2Think采用Propose-Draw-Verify循环，将几何推理外化为可执行画布，测量精确几何量，并将结构化观察反馈给模型，使后续推理基于经过检查的画布状态进行。

主要发现: 在GeoGoal上，构建的画布通过了95.9%的谓词级和84.0%的严格问题级构建检查；在平面/实体基准测试中，结果准确率提高了最多4.1%/16.4%；在GenExam-math上达到了68.2%/90.5%的严格/宽松渲染分数。

结论: Draw2Think通过外部化使得模型级构建保真度和引擎级测量保真度可分别审计，证明了该方法在构建、结果和渲染评估中的有效性。

翻译: Vision-language models solve geometry problems with rising accuracy, yet their intermediate states remain latent and unverifiable: a relation expressed in textual reasoning or drawing code carries no guarantee that a constraint-satisfying configuration realizes it. We observe that existing externalization methods based on rendered pixels or one-shot scripts fail to provide exact, per-action geometric guarantees. Enforcing geometric relations by algebraic definition closes this gap: the workspace becomes a constraint-checked evolving canvas. We present Draw2Think, a framework that recasts geometric reasoning from latent spatial inference into agentic interaction with the GeoGebra constraint engine. In a Propose-Draw-Verify loop, Draw2Think externalizes hypotheses onto an executable canvas, measures exact geometric quantities, and feeds structured observations back to the model, so subsequent reasoning proceeds from checked canvas state grounded by the shared workspace. This externalization makes two properties separately auditable: model-level Construction Fidelity (whether the canvas realizes the intended configuration) and engine-level Measurement Faithfulness (exact values and relations from canvas constraints). Across construction, outcome, and rendering evaluations, Draw2Think builds canvases that pass 95.9% predicate-level and 84.0% strict problem-level construction checks on GeoGoal, improves outcome accuracy by up to 4.1%/16.4% on planar/solid benchmarks, and attains 68.2%/90.5% strict/relaxed rendering scores on GenExam-math. Project page is available at https://draw2think.github.io/

Abstract

Vision-language models solve geometry problems with rising accuracy, yet their intermediate states remain latent and unverifiable: a relation expressed in textual reasoning or drawing code carries no guarantee that a constraint-satisfying configuration realizes it. We observe that existing externalization methods based on rendered pixels or one-shot scripts fail to provide exact, per-action geometric guarantees. Enforcing geometric relations by algebraic definition closes this gap: the workspace becomes a constraint-checked evolving canvas. We present Draw2Think, a framework that recasts geometric reasoning from latent spatial inference into agentic interaction with the GeoGebra constraint engine. In a Propose-Draw-Verify loop, Draw2Think externalizes hypotheses onto an executable canvas, measures exact geometric quantities, and feeds structured observations back to the model, so subsequent reasoning proceeds from checked canvas state grounded by the shared workspace. This externalization makes two properties separately auditable: model-level Construction Fidelity (whether the canvas realizes the intended configuration) and engine-level Measurement Faithfulness (exact values and relations from canvas constraints). Across construction, outcome, and rendering evaluations, Draw2Think builds canvases that pass 95.9% predicate-level and 84.0% strict problem-level construction checks on GeoGoal, improves outcome accuracy by up to 4.1%/16.4% on planar/solid benchmarks, and attains 68.2%/90.5% strict/relaxed rendering scores on GenExam-math. Project page is available at https://draw2think.github.io/

item.title: PACD-Net: Pseudo-Augmented Contrastive Distillation for Glycemic Control Estimation from SMBG
item.author: Canyu Lei, David Repaske, Jianxin Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PACD-Net是一个自监督对比知识蒸馏框架，用于从稀疏的血糖自我监测数据中估计血糖控制指标。

背景: 许多患者由于CGM的高成本和可及性有限，依赖SMBG进行血糖监测。与CGM相比，SMBG提供稀疏和不规则的测量，使得准确估计TIR、TBR和TAR等指标具有挑战性。

目的: 提出PACD-Net框架，以解决在稀疏和不规则采样设置下，从SMBG数据中准确估计血糖控制指标的问题。

方法: PACD-Net采用自监督对比知识蒸馏框架，利用具有丰富时间覆盖率的伪SMBG样本作为教师信号来指导稀疏观测的学习。此外，多视图对比学习强制不同采样模式下的表示一致性。模型采用混合Swin Transformer-CNN骨干网络来捕获稀疏SMBG序列中的时间依赖性。

主要发现: PACD-Net在从真实世界SMBG数据中估计TAR、TIR和TBR方面始终优于现有方法，在极稀疏观测设置下实现了更高的准确性、稳定性和泛化能力。

结论: 该框架为临床SMBG解释提供了实用工具，并为从稀疏和不规则采样的传感器数据中学习提供了可泛化的方法。

翻译: 有效管理糖尿病需要持续监测血糖水平。临床上，血糖控制通过时间范围（TIR）、时间低于范围（TBR）和时间高于范围（TAR）等指标进行评估，这些指标通常源自连续血糖监测（CGM）。然而，由于CGM的高成本和可及性有限，许多患者依赖血糖自我监测（SMBG）。与CGM不同，SMBG提供稀疏和不规则的测量，使得准确估计这些指标具有挑战性。传统的监督学习方法在这种稀疏性下表现不佳，导致泛化能力差和性能不稳定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PACD-Net，一个用于从SMBG估计血糖控制的自监督对比知识蒸馏框架。具有丰富时间覆盖率的伪SMBG样本被用作教师信号来指导稀疏观测的学习。此外，多视图对比学习强制不同采样模式下的表示一致性。该模型采用混合Swin Transformer-CNN骨干网络来捕获稀疏SMBG序列中的时间依赖性。实验结果表明，PACD-Net在从真实世界SMBG数据中估计TAR、TIR和TBR方面始终优于现有方法，在极稀疏观测设置下实现了更高的准确性、稳定性和泛化能力。提出的框架为临床SMBG解释提供了实用工具，并为从稀疏和不规则采样的传感器数据中学习提供了可泛化的方法。

Abstract

Effective diabetes management requires continuous monitoring of glycemic levels. Clinically, glycemic control is assessed using metrics such as Time in Range (TIR), Time Below Range (TBR), and Time Above Range (TAR), typically derived from continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). However, many patients rely on self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) due to the high cost and limited accessibility of CGM. Unlike CGM, SMBG provides sparse and irregular measurements, making accurate estimation of these metrics challenging. Conventional supervised learning approaches struggle under such sparsity, leading to poor generalization and unstable performance. To address this, we propose PACD-Net, a self-supervised contrastive knowledge distillation framework for estimating glycemic control from SMBG. Pseudo-SMBG samples with richer temporal coverage are used as teacher signals to guide learning from sparse observations. In addition, multi-view contrastive learning enforces representation consistency across diverse sampling patterns. The model adopts a hybrid Swin Transformer-CNN backbone to capture temporal dependencies in sparse SMBG sequences. Experimental results demonstrate that PACD-Net consistently outperforms existing methods in estimating TAR, TIR, and TBR from real-world SMBG data, achieving improved accuracy as well as enhanced stability and generalization under extremely sparse observation settings. The proposed framework provides a practical tool for clinical SMBG interpretation and offers a generalizable approach for learning from sparse and irregularly sampled sensor data in broader applications.

item.title: DuplexSLA: A Full-Duplex Spoken Language Model with Synchronized Speech, Language, and Action
item.author: Haoyang Zhang, Jun Chen, Donghang Wu, Yuxin Li, Yuxin Zhang, Xiangyu Tony Zhang, Che Liu, Qingjian Lin, Yizhou Peng, Hexin Liu, Eng Siong Chng, Chao Yan, Boyong Wu, Yechang Huang, Xuerui Yang, Fei Tian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出DuplexSLA模型，通过双流三通道架构实现全双工语音-语言-动作基础模型，支持语义驱动的对话控制、实时对话规划及工具调用，并构建了DuplexSLA-Bench基准进行评估。

背景: 现有全双工语音语言模型缺乏原生通道进行对话规划和工具调用，导致实时代理行为要么受限于对话回合边界，要么依赖外部级联。

目的: 构建一个原生全双工语音-语言-动作基础模型，实现连续监听、说话、规划和工具调用，并在同一共享时钟下协同工作。

方法: 采用双流三通道架构，包括连续用户音频通道、离散助手音频通道和受限文本动作通道，所有通道由单一骨干网络联合解码，解码时间间隔为160毫秒。

主要发现: 模型具备两项核心能力：1) 语义驱动的对话控制，在骨干网络内部处理中断、暂停和应答；2) 对话内规划和工具调用，通过动作通道发射规划文本和结构化工具调用，无需停止助手音频，实现多动作和应答触发的工具使用与持续语音的交错。

结论: 通过DuplexSLA-Bench基准评估了模型在暂停、中断、应答对话控制及三种对话内工具调用风格下的表现，项目页面、交互演示和评估套件已公开。

翻译: 最近，口语对话语言模型的进展已从基于回合的设计转向全双工设计，其中模型在生成响应的同时持续监听用户。然而，现有的全双工骨干缺乏原生通道用于对话内规划和工具调用，导致实时代理行为要么受限于回合边界，要么被 relegated 到外部级联。我们提出了DuplexSLA，一个原生全双工语音-语言-动作基础模型，在共享的160毫秒时间块上解码助手音频和结构化动作流。DuplexSLA基于双流三通道公式构建：一个连续用户音频通道、一个离散助手音频通道和一个受限文本动作通道，所有通道由单一骨干网络联合解码，使得监听、说话、规划和工具调用在一个共享时钟上展开。两个能力定义了该模型：1) 语义驱动的对话控制，其中中断、暂停和应答在同一个骨干网络内处理，而不是由外部语义VAD处理；2) 对话内规划和工具调用，其中规划文本和结构化工具调用在动作通道上发出，而无需停止助手音频，从而实现多动作和应答触发的工具使用与持续语音交错。为了共同评估这些能力，我们进一步构建了DuplexSLA-Bench，一个涵盖暂停、中断和应答对话控制以及三种对话内工具调用风格的全双工基准。我们的项目页面、交互演示和DuplexSLA-Bench评估套件在https://github.com/hyzhang24/DuplexSLA上公开。

Abstract

Recent advances in spoken dialogue language models have shifted from turn-based to full-duplex designs, where the model continuously listens to the user while generating responses. However, existing duplex backbones still lack a native channel for in-conversation planning and tool calling, leaving real-time agentic behaviour either tied to turn boundaries or relegated to an external cascade. We propose DuplexSLA, a native full-duplex Speech-Language-Action foundation model that decodes assistant audio together with a structured action stream on a shared 160 ms chunk timeline. DuplexSLA is built on a dual-stream three-channel formulation: a continuous user audio channel, a discrete assistant audio channel, and a rate-limited textual action channel, all decoded jointly by a single backbone, so that listening, speaking, planning, and tool calling unfold on one shared clock. Two capabilities define the model: (1) semantic-driven turn-taking control, where interruption, pause, and backchannel are handled inside the same backbone instead of by an external semantic VAD; and (2) in-conversation planning and tool calling, where planning text and structured tool calls are emitted on the action channel without halting assistant audio, so that multi-action and backchannel-triggered tool use are interleaved with ongoing speech. To evaluate these capabilities together, we further construct DuplexSLA-Bench, a duplex benchmark covering pause, interrupt, and backchannel turn-taking together with three styles of in-conversation tool calling. Our project page, interactive demos, and the DuplexSLA-Bench evaluation suite are publicly available at https://github.com/hyzhang24/DuplexSLA.

item.title: Findings of the Counter Turing Test: AI-Generated Image Detection
item.author: Rajarshi Roy, Nasrin Imanpour, Ashhar Aziz, Shashwat Bajpai, Gurpreet Singh, Shwetangshu Biswas, Kapil Wanaskar, Parth Patwa, Subhankar Ghosh, Shreyas Dixit, Nilesh Ranjan Pal, Vipula Rawte, Ritvik Garimella, Amitava Das, Amit Sheth, Vasu Sharma, Aishwarya Naresh Reganti, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Defactify 4.0研讨会中提出的对抗图灵测试（CT2）及其在AI生成图像检测中的发现。

背景: 生成式AI技术的快速发展，如Stable Diffusion、DALL-E和Midjourney，在创造合成视觉内容的同时，也带来了虚假信息、偏见内容和难以检测等挑战。

目的: 为了应对AI生成图像日益增强的真实感带来的检测紧迫性，提出了对抗图灵测试（CT2）以评估AI图像检测能力。

方法: 开发了MS COCOAI数据集，包含来自多个生成模型的50,000张合成图像以及来自MS COCO数据集的真实图像。参与者采用了包括卷积神经网络、视觉Transformer、基于频率的分析、对比学习和多模态技术在内的多种检测策略。

主要发现: 虽然AI生成图像可以被高精度检测（F1分数大于0.83），但识别出具体使用的生成模型仍然非常困难（最高F1分数为0.4986）。

结论: 研究强调了改进模型指纹识别、对抗鲁棒性和实时检测机制的必要性。

翻译: 生成式AI技术（如Stable Diffusion、DALL-E和Midjourney）的快速进步显著改变了合成视觉内容的创作方式。虽然这些模型促进了各行业的创新，但也带来了严重的挑战，包括虚假信息、错误信息和偏见内容的生成。AI生成图像日益增强的真实感使得检测成为研究人员、政策制定者和行业利益相关者当务之急。本文介绍了Defactify 4.0研讨会的发现，该研讨会引入了用于AI生成图像检测的对抗图灵测试（CT2）。该竞赛包含两个关键任务：（1）将图像分类为AI生成或真实；（2）识别负责AI生成图像的具体生成模型。为此，我们开发了MS COCOAI数据集，包含来自多个生成模型的50,000张合成图像以及来自MS COCO数据集的真实图像。参与者采用了多种检测策略，包括卷积神经网络、视觉Transformer、基于频率的分析、对比学习和多模态技术。结果显示，虽然AI生成图像可以被高精度检测（F1分数大于0.83），但识别出具体使用的生成模型仍然非常困难（最高F1分数为0.4986）。这些发现强调了改进模型指纹识别、对抗鲁棒性和实时检测机制的必要性。

Abstract

The rapid advancements in generative AI technologies, such as Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and Midjourney, have significantly transformed the creation of synthetic visual content. While these models enable innovation across industries, they also pose serious challenges, including misinformation, disinformation, and biased content generation. The increasing realism of AI-generated images makes their detection a pressing concern for researchers, policymakers, and industry stakeholders. In this paper, we present the findings of the Defactify 4.0 workshop, which introduced the Counter Turing Test (CT2) for AI-Generated Image Detection. The competition consisted of two key tasks: (1) binary classification of images as either AI-generated or real and (2) identification of the specific generative model responsible for an AI-generated image. To facilitate this, we developed the MS COCOAI dataset, consisting of 50,000 synthetic images from multiple generative models alongside real-world images from the MS COCO dataset. Participants employed diverse detection strategies, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), frequency-based analysis, contrastive learning, and multimodal techniques. The results demonstrated that while AI-generated images can be detected with high accuracy (F1-score > 0.83), identifying the exact model used remains significantly more challenging (highest F1-score: 0.4986). These findings highlight the need for improved model fingerprinting, adversarial robustness, and real-time detection mechanisms.

item.title: Spatial Gram Alignment for Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis
item.author: Jinjin Zhang, Xiefan Guo, Di Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为空间格拉姆对齐（SGA）的新框架，旨在解决在超高清图像合成中预训练潜在扩散模型（LDM）的可学习性与保真度之间的冲突。

背景: 现代超高清图像合成严重依赖大规模预训练潜在扩散模型（LDMs）的强大生成能力。虽然基于基础模型（如SAM或DINO）的表示对齐方法通过将视觉先验蒸馏到生成潜在特征中已被证明有效，但在极端分辨率下将这些方法扩展到预训练LDMs时，暴露了一个关键的可学习性-保真度冲突。

目的: 为了解决这一瓶颈，本文提出了空间格拉姆对齐（SGA）框架，旨在显式利用视觉基础模型的表示先验，同时保留LDM的原生生成能力。

方法: SGA通过一种非侵入性的空间约束来对齐生成特征与基础先验的内部自相似性，而不是进行直接的特征蒸馏。这种方法在保持LDM原生生成目标的同时，建立了宏观结构一致性。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，SGA在超高清文本到图像合成中实现了最先进的性能，在全局结构完整性和细粒度视觉细节之间实现了有效的平衡。

结论: SGA作为一种通用策略，无缝集成到预训练LDMs的中间扩散特征和VAE潜在空间中。

翻译: 现代超高清图像合成严重依赖大规模预训练潜在扩散模型（LDMs）的强大生成能力。虽然基于基础模型（如SAM或DINO）的表示对齐方法通过将视觉先验蒸馏到生成潜在特征中已被证明有效，但在极端分辨率下将这些方法扩展到预训练LDMs时，暴露了一个关键的可学习性-保真度冲突。具体来说，强制进行直接的分片特征蒸馏本质上会扰动预训练的潜在流形，最终导致生成退化。为了解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了空间格拉姆对齐（SGA），这是一种新颖的框架，它显式地利用视觉基础模型的表示先验，同时保留LDM的原生生成能力。超越严格的直接对齐，SGA通过将生成特征的内部自相似性与基础先验的自相似性对齐，施加了一种非侵入性的空间约束。这种空间约束有效地建立了宏观结构一致性，而原生生成目标保留了原始LDM固有的微观像素级保真度。值得注意的是，这种通用策略无缝地集成到预训练LDMs的中间扩散特征和VAE潜在空间中。广泛的实验表明，SGA在超高清文本到图像合成中实现了最先进的性能，在全局结构完整性和细粒度视觉细节之间实现了有效的平衡。代码可在 https://github.com/zhang0jhon/SGA 获取。

Abstract

Modern ultra-high-resolution image synthesis relies heavily on the robust generative capacity of large-scale pre-trained Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). While recent representation alignment methods have proven effective by distilling visual priors from foundation models (e.g., SAM or DINO) into generative latent features, scaling these approaches to pre-trained LDMs at extreme resolutions exposes a critical learnability-fidelity conflict. Specifically, forcing direct patch-wise feature distillation inherently perturbs the pre-trained latent manifold, ultimately leading to generation degradation. To address this bottleneck, we propose Spatial Gram Alignment (SGA), a novel framework that explicitly leverages the representation priors of vision foundation models while preserving the native generative capacity of LDMs. Moving beyond restrictive direct alignment, SGA imposes a non-invasive spatial constraint by aligning the internal self-similarities of the generative features with those of the foundation priors. This spatial constraint effectively establishes macroscopic structural coherence, while the native generative objectives retain the microscopic pixel-level fidelity inherent to the original LDMs. Notably, this versatile strategy integrates seamlessly across both intermediate diffusion features and VAE latents within pre-trained LDMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGA achieves state-of-the-art performance for ultra-high-resolution text-to-image synthesis, yielding an effective reconciliation between global structural integrity and fine-grained visual details. Code is available at https://github.com/zhang0jhon/SGA.

item.title: RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses
item.author: Minh Anh Nguyen, Quang Huy Tran, Bao Ngoc Le, Tuan Kiet Pham, Sui Yang Guang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一个名为RelWitness的框架，用于在部分关系监督下从RGB-D序列生成开放词汇3D场景图。该方法利用视觉几何线索来验证未标注的关系，从而提高关系识别的准确性和可靠性。

背景: 开放词汇3D场景图生成旨在描述物体实例及其关系，但面临词汇扩展和监督可靠性的挑战。现有的3D场景图数据集中的关系标注具有选择性，许多有效的物体对关系未被标注。

目的: 提出RelWitness框架，以解决在部分关系监督下从RGB-D序列生成开放词汇3D场景图的问题。

方法: RelWitness框架的核心概念是关系见证，即一种具体的视觉几何线索，使得关系在捕获的场景中可观察。该方法构建关系见证记录，并使用视觉几何见证验证器对未标注的关系候选进行分类。此外，还引入了见证一致解码和RGB-D缺失关系审计协议。

主要发现: 在3DSSG/3RScan和ScanNet衍生的开放词汇划分上的模拟手稿规划实验表明，该方法实现了预期的行为：提高了未见关系的识别能力，更高的见证精度，更低的幻觉和更少的冗余关系短语。

结论: 该方法通过利用关系见证和见证一致解码，能够在部分监督下有效生成开放词汇3D场景图，显著提升了关系识别的准确性和可靠性。

翻译: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation seeks to describe object instances and their relations with flexible natural-language predicates. The central difficulty is not only vocabulary expansion, but supervision reliability: relation annotations in 3D scene graph datasets are selective, and many valid object-pair relations are unannotated. We propose RelWitness, a framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation from posed RGB-D sequences under incomplete relation supervision. The key concept is a relation witness: a concrete visual-geometric cue that makes a relation observable in the captured scene. Support relations require contact and vertical ordering; containment requires enclosure; proximity requires metric closeness; orientation requires facing direction; and stable relations should persist across views where both objects are visible. RelWitness constructs relation witness records from RGB views, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, role-sensitive text, object-prior null views, and multi-view consistency. A visual-geometric witness verifier assigns unannotated relation candidates to verified missing positives, reliable negatives, or uncertain unlabeled cases. A witness-guided positive-unlabeled objective then learns from incomplete annotations without turning every missing label into a negative. We further introduce witness-consistent decoding and an RGB-D missing-relation audit protocol. Simulated manuscript-planning experiments on 3DSSG/3RScan and ScanNet-derived open-vocabulary splits show the intended behavior: improved unseen-relation recognition, higher witness precision, lower hallucination, and reduced redundant relation phrases. All numerical results are planning values and must be replaced by reproduced measurements before submission

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决利用自然语言描述生成 3D 场景图的问题。这个问题在研究中为什么重要？unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 1. **分析请求：** * **角色：** 严谨的学术论文助手。 * **输入：** 一段 PDF 元数据/结构文本（标题：《RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses》，作者等）。 * Abstract

Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation seeks to describe object instances and their relations with flexible natural-language predicates. The central difficulty is not only vocabulary expansion, but supervision reliability: relation annotations in 3D scene graph datasets are selective, and many valid object-pair relations are unannotated. We propose RelWitness, a framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation from posed RGB-D sequences under incomplete relation supervision. The key concept is a relation witness: a concrete visual-geometric cue that makes a relation observable in the captured scene. Support relations require contact and vertical ordering; containment requires enclosure; proximity requires metric closeness; orientation requires facing direction; and stable relations should persist across views where both objects are visible. RelWitness constructs relation witness records from RGB views, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, role-sensitive text, object-prior null views, and multi-view consistency. A visual-geometric witness verifier assigns unannotated relation candidates to verified missing positives, reliable negatives, or uncertain unlabeled cases. A witness-guided positive-unlabeled objective then learns from incomplete annotations without turning every missing label into a negative. We further introduce witness-consistent decoding and an RGB-D missing-relation audit protocol. Simulated manuscript-planning experiments on 3DSSG/3RScan and ScanNet-derived open-vocabulary splits show the intended behavior: improved unseen-relation recognition, higher witness precision, lower hallucination, and reduced redundant relation phrases. All numerical results are planning values and must be replaced by reproduced measurements before submission

item.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
item.author: Yang, Zhiqin, Zhang, Yonggang, Xue, Wei, Fang, Dong, Han, Bo, Guo, Yike
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了直接偏好优化（DPO）与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）之间的理论等价性，并指出该等价性是有条件的，且在特定假设不成立时会导致优化问题。为此，作者提出了约束偏好优化（CPO）方法，并在标准基准测试中验证了其性能。

背景: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的一种流行替代方案，因为它具有理论等价性和更简单的实现。

目的: 证明DPO与RLHF之间的等价性是有条件的，而非普遍适用；当假设不成立时，DPO会优化相对优势而非绝对对齐；提出约束偏好优化（CPO）以解决这些问题；提供DPO的几何解释。

方法: 通过理论分析证明DPO与RLHF在特定假设下的等价性；当假设不成立时，DPO优化相对优势而非绝对对齐；引入约束偏好优化（CPO），通过在RLHF中添加约束来实现可证明的对齐；通过软边缘排序提供几何解释。

主要发现: DPO的等价性取决于RLHF最优策略必须偏好人类偏好响应的隐含假设；当该假设被违反时，DPO会优化相对于参考策略的相对优势而非与人类偏好的绝对对齐，导致DPO损失下降但偏好不受欢迎的响应的病理收敛；DPO和RLHF在假设被违反时优化根本不同的目标；CPO在标准基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: DPO的保证在特定条件下成立；CPO提供了一种保留简单性同时具有可证明对齐性的解决方案；CPO在标准基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

翻译: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的一种流行替代方案，因为它具有理论等价性和更简单的实现。我们证明这种等价性是有条件的，而不是普遍的，取决于一个在实践中经常被违反的隐含假设：RLHF最优策略必须偏好人类偏好响应。当这个假设失败时，DPO优化相对于参考策略的相对优势，而不是与人类偏好的绝对对齐，导致一种病理收敛，即策略降低DPO损失但偏好不受欢迎的响应。我们描述了何时违反这个假设，显示了不期望的解空间的存在，并证明在这种情况下DPO和RLHF优化根本不同的目标。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了约束偏好优化（CPO），通过在RLHF中添加约束来实现可证明的对齐。我们进一步通过软边缘排序提供了几何解释，揭示了DPO实现了具有潜在负目标的边缘排序。我们的理论分析确定了DPO保证成立的条件，并提供了解决方案，在保持简单性的同时具有可证明的对齐性。标准基准测试上的综合实验表明，CPO实现了最先进的性能。代码可在此 https URL 获取。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文分析了DPO和RLHF之间的条件等价性，指出了隐含假设和失败模式，并提供了可证明的对齐理论。

Abstract

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation. We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences, leading to pathological convergence where policies decrease DPO loss while preferring dispreferred responses. We characterize when this assumption is violated, show the existence of an undesirable solution space, and prove that DPO and RLHF optimize fundamentally different objectives in such cases. To address this, we introduce Constrained Preference Optimization (CPO), augmenting RLHF with constraints for provable alignment. We further provide a geometric interpretation through soft margin ranking, revealing that DPO implements margin ranking with potentially negative targets. Our theoretical analysis establishes when DPOs' guarantees hold and provides solutions preserving simplicity with provable alignment. Comprehensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CPO achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at: this https URL .

item.title: ArchSIBench: Benchmarking the Architectural Spatial Intelligence of Vision-Language Models
item.author: Qirui Shen, Wenda Wang, Jiachen Lu, Zilong Huang, Jin Bai, Lei He, Hongxuan Chen, Weixin Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ArchSIBench是一个基于建筑、认知科学和心理学视角的基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型在建筑空间智能方面的能力，包含感知、推理、导航、变换和配置五个核心维度，共17个细粒度子任务。

背景: 现有的视觉语言模型评估主要关注相对方向、距离比较和物体计数等基础空间技能，忽略了建筑空间的高级认知，如布局理解、流通模式和功能分区。

目的: 构建ArchSIBench基准测试，以全面评估视觉语言模型的建筑空间智能，并识别其与人类基准之间的差距。

方法: 通过具有建筑背景的专家进行仔细的手工标注，构建了3000个问答对，涵盖了感知、推理、导航、变换和配置五个核心维度，共17个细粒度子任务。

主要发现: 大多数模型的建筑空间智能与人类基准存在显著差异；模型在不同能力维度上表现出显著差异；一些最先进的模型在无建筑训练的情况下可以接近人类评估者的水平，但在空间变换和配置推理方面与受过建筑训练的人类评估者之间仍存在明显差距。

结论: ArchSIBench将为测量和推进视觉语言模型的建筑空间智能提供重要见解和系统性资源。

翻译: 建筑空间智能，即识别和推断建筑空间的能力，是机器人导航、具身交互和3D场景理解与生成等任务的基础。虽然大量研究已经评估了视觉语言模型（VLMs）的相对方向、距离比较和物体计数等基本空间技能，但这些任务仅涵盖了空间认知的最基本水平，很大程度上忽略了建筑空间的高级认知，包括布局理解、流通模式和功能分区。在这项工作中，我们提出了ArchSIBench，一个基于建筑、认知科学和心理学视角的建筑空间智能基准测试。ArchSIBench涵盖了五个核心维度：感知、推理、导航、变换和配置，包含17个细粒度子任务。通过具有建筑背景的专家进行仔细的手工标注，我们构建了3000个问答对，以实现对建筑空间智能的全面评估。基于ArchSIBench，我们评估了各种VLMs，发现大多数模型的建筑空间智能与人类基准存在显著差异；此外，模型在不同能力维度上表现出显著差异。一些最先进的模型在无建筑训练的情况下可以接近人类评估者的水平。然而，与受过建筑训练的人类评估者相比，特别是在空间变换和配置推理方面，仍存在明显差距。我们相信ArchSIBench将为测量和推进VLMs的建筑空间智能提供重要见解和系统性资源。数据集和代码可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/ArchSIBench/ArchSIBench获取。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了 ArchSIBench 基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型在建筑空间智能方面的能力。

Abstract

Architectural spatial intelligence, the ability to recognize and infer architectural space, is fundamental to tasks such as robot navigation, embodied interaction, and 3D scene understanding and generation. Although extensive research has evaluated the basic spatial skills of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as relative orientation, distance comparison, and object counting, these tasks cover only the most elementary levels of spatial cognition and largely overlook higher-level cognition of architectural space, including layout understanding, circulation patterns, and functional zoning. In this work, we present ArchSIBench, a Benchmark for Architectural Spatial Intelligence based on the perspectives from architecture, cognitive science, and psychology. ArchSIBench covers five core dimensions: perception, reasoning, navigation, transformation, and configuration, comprising 17 fine-grained subtasks. Through careful manual annotation by experts with architectural backgrounds, we construct 3,000 question-answer pairs to enable comprehensive evaluation of architectural spatial intelligence. Based on ArchSIBench, we evaluate various VLMs and find that the architectural spatial intelligence of most models shows significant differences from human baselines; additionally, models exhibit substantial variability across capability dimensions. Some state-of-the-art models can approach the level of human evaluators without architectural training. However, a clear gap remains compared to human evaluators with architectural training, particularly in spatial transformation and configuration reasoning. We believe that ArchSIBench will provide important insights and systematic resources for measuring and advancing the architectural spatial intelligence of VLMs. The dataset and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ArchSIBench/ArchSIBench.

来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了USV数据集，包含224K个用户生成的短视频，并建立了主题识别和视频文本检索两个任务，提出了MMF-Net和VTCL两种基线方法。

背景: 虽然大型视频数据集推动了视频理解领域的发展，但针对新兴的用户生成短视频的研究很少。

目的: 建立USV数据集以支持高层语义视频理解，并设立主题识别和视频文本检索两个任务。

方法: 提出了多模态融合网络MMF-Net和视频文本对比学习VTCL作为基线方法。

主要发现: 通过建立USV数据集和两个任务，以及提出两种基线方法，为未来研究提供了全面的基准。

结论: USV数据集和提出的方法有助于解决用户生成短视频的高层语义理解问题。

翻译: 近年来，许多大规模视频数据集的发布推动了视频理解领域的发展。然而，新兴的用户生成短视频很少受到研究。本文介绍了USV，即用于高层语义视频理解的用户生成短视频数据集。该数据集包含约224K个视频，这些视频是从UGC平台通过标签查询收集的，无需额外的人工验证和修剪。尽管视频理解近年来取得了合理的进步，但大多数工作集中在实例级识别上，这对于学习视频高层语义信息的表示是不够的。因此，我们进一步在USV上建立了两个任务：主题识别和视频文本检索。我们提出了两种统一且有效的基线方法多模态融合网络（MMF-Net）和视频文本对比学习（VTCL），分别解决主题识别任务和视频文本检索任务，并进行了全面的基准测试以促进未来的研究。我们的项目页面是https://usvdataset.github.io。

Abstract

Several large-scale video datasets have been published these years and have advanced the area of video understanding. However, the newly emerged user-generated short-form videos have rarely been studied. This paper presents USV, the User-generated Short-form Video dataset for high-level semantic video understanding. The dataset contains around 224K videos collected from UGC platforms by label queries without extra manual verification and trimming. Although video understanding has achieved plausible improvement these years, most works focus on instance-level recognition, which is not sufficient for learning the representation of the high-level semantic information of videos. Therefore, we further establish two tasks: topic recognition and video-text retrieval on USV. We propose two unified and effective baseline methods Multi-Modality Fusion Network (MMF-Net) and Video-Text Contrastive Learning (VTCL), to tackle the topic recognition task and video-text retrieval respectively, and carry out comprehensive benchmarks to facilitate future research. Our project page is https://usvdataset.github.io.

item.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
item.author: Zhao, Ziliang, Xu, Zenan, Wang, Shuting, Qian, Hongjin, Lei, Yan, Hu, Minda, Wang, Zhao, Dou, Shihan, Dou, Zhicheng, Zhou, Pluto
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PlanningBench是一个用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证规划数据的框架，旨在解决现有规划基准数据集的局限性。

背景: 现有规划基准通常将规划数据视为固定的实例集合，而非可控的生成目标，这限制了场景覆盖面，将难度与表面代理而非结构性来源挂钩，且对可扩展生成、自动验证或规划导向训练的支持有限。

目的: 引入PlanningBench框架，用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证的规划数据，以支持评估和训练。

方法: 从真实规划场景出发，将实际工作流程抽象为超过30种任务类型、子任务、约束家族和难度因素的分类法。基于此分类法，采用约束驱动的合成管道，实例化自包含的规划问题，并具备自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证检查清单功能。

主要发现: 当前模型在处理耦合约束时仍难以产生完整的解决方案；在经过验证的PlanningBench数据上进行强化学习，可以提高模型在未见过的规划基准和更广泛的指令遵循任务上的性能；确定或明确指定的最优解提供更清晰的奖励信号和更稳定的训练动态。

结论: PlanningBench提供了一个可控的规划数据来源，用于诊断和改进LLM中可泛化的规划能力。

翻译: 规划是大型语言模型的一项基本能力，因为此类复杂任务需要模型将目标、约束、资源和长期后果协调成可执行和可验证的解决方案。然而，现有的规划基准通常将规划数据视为固定的实例集合，而非可控的生成目标。这限制了场景覆盖面，将难度与表面代理而非结构性来源挂钩，且对可扩展生成、自动验证或规划导向训练的支持有限。我们引入了PlanningBench，这是一个用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证的规划数据的框架，用于评估和训练。PlanningBench从真实规划场景出发，将实际工作流程抽象为超过30种任务类型、子任务、约束家族和难度因素的分类法。在此分类法的指导下，约束驱动的合成管道实例化自包含的规划问题，并具备自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证检查清单功能。这使规划数据构建从固定的基准收集转变为可控生成，同时保留了现实任务的落地性。我们使用PlanningBench评估开源和闭源前沿LLM，发现当前模型在耦合约束下仍难以产生完整的解决方案。除了评估外，在经过验证的PlanningBench数据上进行强化学习，可以提高模型在未见过的规划基准和更广泛的指令遵循任务上的性能。进一步分析表明，确定或明确指定的最优解提供更清晰的奖励信号和更稳定的训练动态。总体而言，PlanningBench提供了一个可控的规划数据来源，用于诊断和改进LLM中可泛化的规划能力。

Evaluating and Training Large Language Models"。 * **问题：** 这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？ * **约束：** * 基于输入文本回答（不要编造）。 * 简洁、准确、通俗的中文。 * 避免公式、符号或缩写。 * 如果文中没有明确说明，请写 "unknown"。 * 简短（2-4 句）。 * 论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 提供的文本仅包含论文的元数据和结构信息，未包含正文内容，因此无法从中提取关于关键创新点和与之前工作差异的具体信息。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了 PlanningBench 数据集，旨在为评估和训练大型语言模型提供可扩展且可验证的规划数据。

Abstract

Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited support for scalable generation, automatic verification, or planning-oriented training. We introduce PlanningBench, a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for both evaluation and training. PlanningBench starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts practical workflows into a structured taxonomy of more than 30 task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Guided by this taxonomy, a constraint-driven synthesis pipeline instantiates self-contained planning problems with adaptive difficulty control, quality filtering, and instance-level verification checklists. This shifts planning data construction from fixed benchmark collection to controllable generation while preserving realistic task grounding. We use PlanningBench to evaluate open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs, and find that current models still struggle to produce complete solutions under coupled constraints. Beyond evaluation, reinforcement learning on verified PlanningBench data improves performance on unseen planning benchmarks and broader instruction-following tasks. Further analysis suggests that determinate or well-specified optimal solutions provide clearer reward signals and more stable training dynamics. Overall, PlanningBench provides a controllable source of planning data for diagnosing and improving generalizable planning abilities in LLMs.

item.title: Transferable 3D Convolutional Neural Networks for Elastic Constants Prediction in Nanoporous Metals
item.author: Sergei Zorkaltsev, Rafał Topolnicki, Tal-El Carmon, Santhosh Mathesan, Paweł Dłotko, Dan Mordehai, Maciej Harańczyk
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟生成了多种纳米多孔金属结构，并利用深度学习模型预测其弹性模量。

背景: 纳米多孔金属的拓扑结构对其机械响应至关重要。

目的: 比较两种预测弹性模量的方法，并评估模型在不同条件下的性能。

方法: 生成了6000个金和422个银的纳米多孔结构，计算了弹性模量的三个分量，共得到19263个数据点。使用了全连接神经网络和3D卷积神经网络（CNN）进行预测，并进行了迁移学习。

主要发现: 3D CNNs优于基于拓扑描述符的基线模型，其中DenseNet-201架构表现最佳（$R^2 = 0.955$）。研究了训练网格分辨率、数据集大小和描述符集成的影响。通过迁移学习证明了模型的鲁棒性。

结论: 训练好的模型被用于评估10万个随机纳米多孔金结构的机械性能，并识别出帕累托最优设计。

翻译: 纳米多孔金属的拓扑结构对其机械响应至关重要。在这项工作中，我们生成了6000个金和422个银纳米多孔结构，并通过分子动力学模拟计算了弹性模量的三个分量，共得到19263个数据点。本研究比较了两种预测弹性模量的不同方法：一种是在预计算的拓扑描述符上训练的全连接神经网络，以及几种从计算机视觉改编的3D卷积神经网络架构。3D CNNs优于基于描述符的基线模型（$R^2 = 0.704$），其中表现最佳的DenseNet-201架构达到了$R^2 = 0.955$。此外，还研究了训练网格分辨率、数据集大小以及描述符集成到模型中的影响。我们通过迁移学习进一步展示了模型的鲁棒性：一个预训练模型在更小规模的致密金结构和致密银结构数据集上进行了微调。最后，训练好的模型被用于评估10万个随机纳米多孔金结构的机械性能，并识别出帕累托最优设计。

Abstract

The topology of nanoporous metals is crucial for determining their mechanical response. In this work, we generated 6,000 gold and 422 silver nanoporous structures and calculated three components of elastic modulus with Molecular Dynamics simulations, resulting in 19,263 data points. This study compared two distinct approaches of predicting elastic modulus: a Fully-Connected neural network trained on precomputed topological descriptors, and several 3D Convolutional neural network architectures adapted from computer vision. The 3D CNNs outperformed the descriptor-based baseline model ($R^2 = 0.704$), with to-performing DenseNet-201 architecture achieving $R^2 = 0.955$. Additionally, the effects of training grid resolution, dataset size, and descriptor integration into a model were investigated. We further demonstrated model robustness through Transfer learning: a pretrained model was fine-tuned on a much smaller dataset of denser gold structures and the dataset of denser silver structures. Finally, the trained model was employed to evaluate the mechanical properties of 100,000 stochastic nanoporous gold structures and identify the Pareto optimal designs.

item.title: JFAA: Technical Report for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Anticipation Challenge at EgoVis 2026
item.author: Qiaohui Chu, Haoyu Zhang, Yisen Feng, Meng Liu, Weili Guan, Dongmei Jiang, Liqiang Nie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: JFAA是一种基于JEPA的预测未来动作的方法，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作预测任务中取得了第一名。

背景: 受V-JEPA 2.1在表示学习和未来预测方面的能力启发。

目的: 为了在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100)动作预测任务中实现未来动作预测。

方法: 使用冻结的编码器和预测器提取观察到的上下文特征和近未来潜在标记，训练轻量级注意探针来预测动词、名词和动作对数，并通过构建领域感知的集成来提高鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在官方挑战服务器上取得了第一名。

结论: JFAA在EK-100动作预测挑战赛中表现优异。

翻译: 我们提出了JFAA，一种基于JEPA的EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100)动作预测任务的未来动作预测方法。受V-JEPA 2.1的表示学习和未来预测能力启发，JFAA使用冻结的编码器和预测器来提取观察到的上下文特征和近未来潜在标记。然后训练一个轻量级注意探针来预测动词、名词和动作对数，使用单独的任务查询。为了提高鲁棒性，我们进一步在选定的基于epoch的预测上构建了领域感知的集成，使每个输出领域都能从其最可靠的候选者中受益。在官方挑战服务器上的实验结果表明，JFAA在EgoVis 2026 EK-100动作预测挑战赛中获得了第一名。我们的代码将在https://github.com/CorrineQiu/JFAA上发布。

Abstract

We propose JFAA, a JEPA-based Future Action Anticipation method for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100) Action Anticipation task. Inspired by the representation learning and future prediction ability of V-JEPA 2.1, JFAA uses a frozen encoder and predictor to extract observed context features and near-future latent tokens. A lightweight attentive probe is then trained to predict verb, noun, and action logits with separate task queries. To improve robustness, we further build a field-aware ensemble over selected epoch-level predictions, allowing each output field to benefit from its most reliable candidates. Experimental results on the official challenge server show that JFAA achieves first place in the EgoVis 2026 EK-100 Action Anticipation Challenge. Our code will be released at https://github.com/CorrineQiu/JFAA.

item.title: Bridging Structure and Language: Graph-Based Visual Reasoning for Autonomous Road Understanding
item.author: Lena Wild, Katie Z Luo, Marco Pavone
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合几何结构和开放词汇语义的框架，用于结构化道路理解。

背景: 结构化道路理解对于安全自动驾驶至关重要。视觉语言模型虽然语义灵活但缺乏几何和关系基础，传统模块化系统如高精地图提供结构精度但语义僵化。

目的: 为了弥合视觉语言模型缺乏几何和关系基础与传统模块化系统语义僵化之间的差距，引入组合道路底座（CRS）框架。

方法: CRS是一个图基础框架，使几何道路结构和开放词汇语义在单一表示中可执行。它通过递归图查询自动生成复杂的问答对，并引入“免费基础”机制确保逻辑可追溯性，以及程序提取的思维链监督轨迹。

主要发现: 训练一个小的2亿或4亿参数模型，使用20到80个CRS丰富场景，就能在组合推理任务中取得稳定增益。分析显示，与基线模型相比，CRS训练模型将失败模式从关系场景理解减少到属性识别。

结论: 道路理解的主要瓶颈不是模型规模，而是缺乏结构化监督。

翻译: 结构化道路理解，包括车道几何、拓扑和交通元素关系，是安全自动驾驶的基础。虽然视觉语言模型（VLM）提供了有希望的语言灵活性，但它们缺乏精确道路推理所需的几何和关系基础。相反，传统的模块化系统，例如高精地图和拓扑道路图，提供了结构精度，但保持语义刚性。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了组合道路底座（CRS），这是一个图基础框架，使几何道路结构和开放词汇语义在单一表示中可执行。CRS通过递归图查询和增强的“免费基础”机制，确保逻辑可追溯到特定的地图元素，以及程序提取的思维链监督轨迹，能够自动生成组合复杂和语言多样化的问答对。我们证明，最先进的VLM——包括大型、封闭源模型——在结构化道路推理方面面临显著困难，然而训练一个小的2亿或4亿参数模型，使用多达20到80个CRS丰富场景，就能在具有不同深度的组合推理任务中取得稳定增益。通过可验证的推理轨迹分析模型行为，揭示了失败模式的系统性转变：基线模型在关系场景理解方面失败，而CRS训练模型将失败减少到属性识别，表明道路理解的主要瓶颈不是模型规模，而是缺乏结构化监督。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何利用图结构来结合视觉信息与语言描述，从而更准确地理解道路场景的问题。这在现实中非常重要，因为自动驾驶系统需要精准地理解道路结构，结合语言信息能显著提升推理的准确性和鲁棒性。

Abstract

Structured road understanding of lane geometry, topology, and traffic element relationships is foundational to safe autonomous driving. While vision-language models (VLMs) offer promising semantic flexibility, they lack the geometric and relational grounding required for precise road reasoning. Conversely, traditional modular systems, e.g., HD maps and topological road graphs, provide structural precision but remain semantically rigid. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Combined Road Substrate (CRS), a graph-grounded framework that makes geometric road structure and open-vocabulary semantics jointly executable in a single representation. CRS enables the automatic generation of compositionally complex and linguistically varied question-answer pairs via recursive graph queries, augmented with a "grounding for free" mechanism that ensures logical traceability to specific map elements, and procedurally extracted chain-of-thought supervision traces. We demonstrate that state-of-the-art VLMs - including large, closed-source models - struggle significantly with structured road reasoning, yet training a small 2- or 4-billion-parameter model with as few as 20 to 80 CRS-enriched scenes yields stable gains in compositional reasoning tasks of varying depth. Analysis of model behavior via verifiable reasoning traces reveals a systematic shift in failure modes: whereas baseline models fail at relational scene understanding, CRS-trained models reduce failures to attribute recognition, suggesting that the primary bottleneck in road understanding is not model scale, but the absence of structured supervision.

item.title: DrawMotion: Generating 3D Human Motions by Freehand Drawing
item.author: Wang, Tao, Jin, Lei, Wu, Zhihua, He, Qiaozhi, Chu, Jiaming, Cheng, Yu, Xing, Junliang, Zhao, Jian, Yan, Shuicheng, Wang, Li
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为DrawMotion的框架，该框架基于扩散模型，旨在通过结合文本和手绘草图条件来生成人类动作，以解决用户仅通过文本难以精确传达意图的问题。

背景: 文本到动作的生成面临挑战，用户往往难以仅通过文本精确传达其预期的动作。

目的: 引入DrawMotion框架，旨在通过结合文本和手绘草图条件，为多条件场景提供高效的文本到动作生成。

方法: DrawMotion框架包含三个关键部分：1) 手绘草图条件算法，用于自动生成不同数据集格式的手绘火柴人草图；2) 多条件融合模块（MCM），集成到扩散过程中以利用所有可能的条件组合并降低计算复杂度；3) 无需训练的引导机制，确保MCM的中间特征位于连续空间，允许分类器引导梯度更新特征，从而对齐生成的动作与用户意图并保持保真度。

主要发现: 用户研究表明，使用手绘草图的方法在生成与用户想象一致的动作时，比仅使用文本节省了约46.7%的时间。

结论: DrawMotion框架通过结合文本和手绘草图条件，有效解决了用户难以通过文本精确传达动作意图的问题，并显著提高了生成效率。

翻译: Text-to-motion generation, which translates textual descriptions into human motions, faces the challenge that users often struggle to precisely convey their intended motions through text alone. To address this issue, this paper introduces DrawMotion, an efficient diffusion-based framework designed for multi-condition scenarios. DrawMotion generates motions based on both a conventional text condition and a novel hand-drawing condition, which provide semantic and spatial control over the generated motions, respectively. Specifically, we tackle the fine-grained motion generation task from three perspectives: 1) freehand drawing condition. To accurately capture users' intended motions without requiring tedious textual input, we develop an algorithm to automatically generate hand-drawn stickman sketches across different dataset formats; 2) multi-condition fusion. We propose a Multi-Condition Module (MCM) that is integrated into the diffusion process, enabling the model to exploit all possible condition combinations while reducing computational complexity compared to conventional approaches; and 3) training-free guidance. Notably, the MCM in DrawMotion ensures that its intermediate features lie in a continuous space, allowing classifier-guidance gradients to update the features and thereby aligning the generated motions with user intentions while preserving fidelity. Quantitative experiments and user studies demonstrate that the freehand drawing approach reduces user time by approximately 46.7% when generating motions aligned with their imagination. The code, demos, and relevant data are publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: A Survey of Audio Reasoning in Multimodal Foundation Models
item.author: Zhihan Guo, Wenqian Cui, Guan-Ting Lin, Daxin Tan, Jingyao Li, Qiyong Zheng, Dingdong Wang, Jing Xiong, Han Shi, Jiaya Jia, Irwin King
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文是首个专门针对音频推理的综述论文，旨在提供统一框架并系统梳理相关进展。

背景: 音频推理能力是现代基础模型的关键能力，但相比文本和视觉，音频推理的发展仍有限制。音频具有连续性、时间密度高以及包含多时间尺度的语言、副语言和环境信息等独特挑战。

目的: 本文旨在提供首个专门的音频推理综述，提供统一框架，区分直接预测建模与推理增强生成，并系统组织音频到文本、音频到语音、视听推理和代理音频推理的最新进展。

方法: 论文通过回顾音频推理模型的架构和训练基础，系统梳理了Audio-to-Text、Audio-to-Speech、Audio-Visual Reasoning和Agentic Audio Reasoning领域的近期进展，并探讨了新兴范式如思维链提示、监督微调、强化学习以及延迟感知的口语交互。

主要发现: 音频推理面临三大主要障碍：真正基于音频的推理数据稀缺、捷径学习和模态幻觉，以及推理深度与实时延迟之间的张力。

结论: 论文提供了开发稳健、高效且原生 grounded 音频推理系统的连贯路线图，并讨论了评估实践、开放挑战和未来方向。

翻译: 推理已成为现代基础模型的关键能力，但在音频模态中的发展仍然有限。音频带来了与文本和视觉不同的挑战。它是连续的、时间密集的，并在多个时间尺度上包含语言、副语言和环境信息。因此，音频推理模型必须将声学信号与大型语言模型的离散语义空间对齐，同时仍需保留可靠推理所需的细粒度信息。进展也受到三大主要障碍的限制：真正基于音频的推理数据稀缺、捷径学习和模态幻觉，以及口语交互中推理深度与实时延迟之间的张力。在本文中，我们提出了首个专门的音频推理综述。我们提供了一个统一公式，区分直接预测建模与推理增强生成，回顾了音频推理模型的架构和训练基础，并系统地组织了Audio-to-Text、Audio-to-Speech、Audio-Visual Reasoning和Agentic Audio Reasoning的最新进展。我们进一步检查了新兴范式，如思维链提示、监督微调、强化学习和延迟感知的口语交互，并讨论了评估实践、开放挑战和未来方向。我们的目标是提供开发稳健、高效且原生 grounded 音频推理系统的连贯路线图。

Abstract

Reasoning has become a defining capability of modern foundation models, yet its development in the audio modality remains limited. Audio poses challenges that are distinct from those of text and vision. It is continuous, temporally dense, and contains linguistic, paralinguistic, and environmental information at multiple time scales. As a result, audio reasoning models must align acoustic signals with the discrete semantic space of large language models, while still preserving fine-grained information needed for reliable inference. Progress is also limited by three major obstacles: the scarcity of genuinely audio-grounded reasoning data, shortcut learning and modality hallucination, and the tension between reasoning depth and real-time latency in spoken interaction. In this paper, we present the first dedicated survey of audio reasoning. We provide a unified formulation that distinguishes direct predictive modeling from reasoning-augmented generation, review the architectural and training foundations of audio reasoning models, and systematically organize recent advances in Audio-to-Text, Audio-to-Speech, Audio-Visual Reasoning and Agentic Audio Reasoning. We further examine emerging paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought prompting, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and latency-aware spoken interaction, and discuss evaluation practices, open challenges, and future directions. Our goal is to offer a coherent roadmap for developing robust, efficient, and natively grounded audio reasoning systems.

item.title: A Dialogue between Causal and Traditional Representation Learning: Toward Mutual Benefits in a Unified Formulation
item.author: Yan Li, Yuewen Sun, Shaoan Xie, Gongxu Luo, Yunlong Deng, Kun Zhang, Guangyi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出将因果表示学习与传统表示学习结合，通过统一框架促进两个领域的对话与合作。

背景: 因果表示学习与传统表示学习在发展轨迹、术语、问题表述和评估上存在差异，导致交流受限和重复努力。

目的: 将两个领域带入对话而非视为独立范式，通过统一表述促进双向益处。

方法: 引入统一表述，包含任务组件（指定需保留的信息）和约束组件（指定潜在空间结构）。

主要发现: 因果约束的有效性强烈依赖于与之配对的任务，实验在CausalVerse数据集上进行。

结论: 因果表示学习为理解结构化潜在约束的效用提供理论工具，传统表示学习为任务设计和目标选择提供实用见解，两者应相互促进。

翻译: 因果表示学习（CRL）和传统表示学习在很大程度上沿着不同的轨迹发展。传统表示学习主要由应用和经验目标驱动，而CRL更关注理论问题，特别是可识别性。这种侧重点的差异在术语、问题表述和评估方面造成了两个领域的差距，限制了交流，有时甚至导致脱节或重复的努力。在本文中，我们认为这两个领域应该进行对话，而不是被视为独立的范式。为此，我们介绍了一种统一表述，其中表示学习由两个组件表征：任务组件，指定学习到的表示所需保留的信息；约束组件，指定对潜在空间施加的结构。在这种表述下，收益是双向的。CRL为理解结构化潜在约束何时有用或必要提供理论工具，而传统表示学习为改善CRL方法开发提供关于任务设计和目标选择的实用见解。为了说明这种相互作用，我们实验研究了不同的任务组件如何在不同结构化约束下影响CRL方法的行为。在CausalVerse上的结果表明，因果约束的有效性强烈依赖于与之配对的任务。

Abstract

Causal representation learning (CRL) and traditional representation learning have largely developed along different trajectories. Traditional representation learning has been driven mainly by applications and empirical objectives, whereas CRL has focused more on theoretical questions, particularly identifiability. This difference in emphasis has created a gap between the two fields in terminology, problem formulation, and evaluation, limiting communication and sometimes leading to disconnected or redundant efforts. In this paper, we argue that these two fields should be brought into dialogue rather than treated as separate paradigms. To this end, we introduce a unified formulation in which the representation learning is characterized by two components: a task component, which specifies what information the learned representation is required to preserve, and a constraint component, which specifies what structure is imposed on the latent space. Under this formulation, the benefits run in both directions. CRL provides theoretical tools for understanding when structured latent constraints are useful or necessary, while traditional representation learning offers practical insights on task design and objective choice that can improve the development of CRL methods. To illustrate this interaction, we experimentally study how different task components affect the behavior of CRL methods under different structured constraints. Results on CausalVerse show that the effectiveness of causal constraints depends strongly on the tasks with which they are paired.

item.title: Multimodal LLMs under Pairwise Modalities
item.author: Yan Li, Yunlong Deng, Yuewen Sun, Gongxu Luo, Kun Zhang, Guangyi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种仅利用多模态对数据来训练多模态大语言模型的方法，通过理论分析提出了表示学习框架，包含潜在表示对齐和跨模态重组两个阶段，并在新加入3D点云和触觉模态时取得了良好的跨模态性能。

背景: 现有的多模态大语言模型训练通常依赖于精心策划的多模态数据，这需要大量人类努力来构建多对齐数据集，从而限制了跨领域的可扩展性。

目的: 探索仅利用多模态对数据作为完整联合多模态分布的替代品来训练多模态大语言模型，并分析仅观察成对模态时表示的可识别性条件。

方法: 提出一个表示学习框架，包含两个阶段：潜在表示对齐和跨模态重组。第一阶段通过自模态重建和成对对比学习学习跨模态的共享潜在空间，并在对比学习过程中引入归纳偏置。第二阶段将新引入模态的编码器与预训练模态的解码器集成，以促进跨模态迁移和生成。

主要发现: 通过学习对齐的潜在表示空间，模型在将3D点云和触觉模态新加入预训练的多模态大语言模型后，取得了良好的跨模态性能。

结论: 仅利用多模态对数据可以有效地训练多模态大语言模型，通过提出的框架能够实现跨模态的强性能。

翻译: 尽管多模态大语言模型取得了令人印象深刻的成果，但其训练通常依赖于联合策划的多模态数据，这需要大量人类努力来构建多对齐数据集，从而限制了跨领域的可扩展性。在这项工作中，我们探索仅利用多模态对数据作为完整联合多模态分布的替代品来训练多模态大语言模型。具体来说，我们首先提供了仅观察成对模态时表示可识别性的条件分析。基于此分析，我们提出了一种仅使用成对数据来对齐模态间潜在表示的表示学习框架。该框架包含两个阶段：潜在表示对齐和跨模态重组。具体来说，在第一阶段，我们通过自模态重建和成对对比学习来学习跨模态的共享潜在空间。我们还在对比学习过程中引入了归纳偏置，通过部分对齐和最小潜在规范。在第二阶段，我们将新引入模态的编码器与预训练模态的解码器集成，以促进跨模态迁移和生成。我们通过将3D点云和触觉模态新加入预训练的多模态大语言模型，并使用三种模态对来评估我们的方法，结果表明，通过学习对齐的潜在表示空间，我们的模型取得了良好的跨模态性能。

Abstract

Despite the impressive results achieved by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their training typically relies on jointly curated multimodal data, requiring substantial human effort to construct multi-way aligned datasets and thereby limiting scalability across domains. In this work, we explore training MLLMs by only leveraging multiple paired modalities as a surrogate for the full joint multimodal distribution. Specifically, we first provide a theoretical analysis of the conditions under which the representations are identifiable with only observing pairwise modalities. Building on this analysis, we propose a representation learning framework for aligning latent representations across modalities using only pairwise data. The framework consists of two stages: latent representation alignment and cross-modal recomposition. Specifically, in the first stage, we learn the shared latent space across modalities by both self-modal reconstruction and pair-wise contrastive learning. We also incorporate an inductive bias in the contrastive learning process by partially aligning and minimal latent specification. In stage two, we integrate the encoder of newly introduced modalities with the decoders of the pre-trained modalities to facilitate cross-modal transfer and generation. We evaluate our method by newly adding 3D point clouds and tactile modalities into pre-trained MLLMs with three modality pairs and show that, by learning an aligned latent representation space, our model achieves strong cross-modal performance.

item.title: SpectralEarth-FM: Bringing Hyperspectral Imagery into Multimodal Earth Observation Pretraining
item.author: Nassim Ait Ali Braham, Aaron Banze, Conrad M. Albrecht, Julien Mairal, Jocelyn Chanussot, Xiao Xiang Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SpectralEarth-FM是一个用于多传感器地球观测输入的分层Transformer模型，旨在解决高光谱图像在现有基础模型中代表性不足的问题。

背景: 现有的地球观测基础模型主要在多光谱、合成孔径雷达和派生地理空间层上训练，而高光谱图像代表性不足；同时，现有的高光谱基础模型仅在高光谱图像上训练，未探索高光谱与同位置地球观测传感器的联合预训练和融合。

目的: 介绍SpectralEarth-FM，构建SpectralEarth-MM数据集，并使用JEPA风格的联合嵌入预测架构进行预训练。

方法: SpectralEarth-FM采用分层Transformer架构，结合高光谱输入的光谱分词、传感器特定编码器、跨传感器融合模块和共享分层编码器。数据集SpectralEarth-MM包含来自三个航天传感器的高光谱图像，并与Sentinel-2、Landsat-8/9光学图像、Landsat地表温度和Sentinel-1 SAR图像在共同地理范围内配准。

主要发现: 在PANGAEA协议下，SpectralEarth-FM在高光谱下游任务和标准地球观测基准测试中均取得了最先进的结果。

结论: SpectralEarth-FM通过联合处理高光谱和低通道观测数据，成功实现了多传感器地球观测输入的先进性能。

翻译: Earth observation (EO) foundation models (FMs) are increasingly trained on multisensor data, spanning multispectral imagery (MSI), synthetic aperture radar (SAR), and derived geospatial layers, but hyperspectral imagery (HSI) remains underrepresented. Conversely, existing hyperspectral FMs are trained on HSI alone, leaving joint pretraining and fusion of HSI with co-located EO sensors unexplored. We introduce SpectralEarth-FM, a hierarchical transformer for multisensor EO input with heterogeneous spectral dimensionality. The architecture combines spectral tokenization for hyperspectral inputs, sensor-specific encoders, a cross-sensor fusion module, and a shared hierarchical encoder, enabling joint processing of HSI and lower-channel observations. To pretrain SpectralEarth-FM, we curate SpectralEarth-MM, a dataset that co-locates HSI from three spaceborne sensors (EnMAP, EMIT, DESIS) with Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9 optical imagery, Landsat land surface temperature (LST), and Sentinel-1 SAR, over common geographic footprints. It comprises approximately 2M globally distributed locations, 25M georeferenced patches, and over 40TB of data. Pretraining uses a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-style objective that matches representations between global views and single-sensor local views from the same location. We evaluate SpectralEarth-FM on hyperspectral downstream tasks and standard EO benchmarks following the PANGAEA protocol, achieving state-of-the-art results across both evaluation settings.

Abstract

Earth observation (EO) foundation models (FMs) are increasingly trained on multisensor data, spanning multispectral imagery (MSI), synthetic aperture radar (SAR), and derived geospatial layers, but hyperspectral imagery (HSI) remains underrepresented. Conversely, existing hyperspectral FMs are trained on HSI alone, leaving joint pretraining and fusion of HSI with co-located EO sensors unexplored. We introduce SpectralEarth-FM, a hierarchical transformer for multisensor EO input with heterogeneous spectral dimensionality. The architecture combines spectral tokenization for hyperspectral inputs, sensor-specific encoders, a cross-sensor fusion module, and a shared hierarchical encoder, enabling joint processing of HSI and lower-channel observations. To pretrain SpectralEarth-FM, we curate SpectralEarth-MM, a dataset that co-locates HSI from three spaceborne sensors (EnMAP, EMIT, DESIS) with Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9 optical imagery, Landsat land surface temperature (LST), and Sentinel-1 SAR, over common geographic footprints. It comprises approximately 2M globally distributed locations, 25M georeferenced patches, and over 40TB of data. Pretraining uses a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-style objective that matches representations between global views and single-sensor local views from the same location. We evaluate SpectralEarth-FM on hyperspectral downstream tasks and standard EO benchmarks following the PANGAEA protocol, achieving state-of-the-art results across both evaluation settings.

item.title: RCGDet3D: Rethinking 4D Radar-Camera Fusion-based 3D Object Detection with Enhanced Radar Feature Encoding
item.author: Weiyi Xiong, Bing Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 RCGDet3D 的实时 3D 目标检测方法，通过增强雷达特征提取来简化多模态融合，在保持高精度的同时实现了实时性能。

背景: 4D 汽车雷达因成本低和鲁棒性强而在自动驾驶中不可或缺，但其点云稀疏性给 3D 目标检测带来挑战。现有的 4D 雷达-相机融合方法因复杂的融合策略和密集特征图上的繁重计算，导致推理速度较慢，阻碍了实时部署。

目的: 为了解决现有融合方法在速度和性能之间的权衡问题，本文旨在探索通过增强雷达特征提取来获得与复杂融合模块相当或更高性能的可行性。

方法: 提出 RCGDet3D，该方法专注于雷达特征编码并简化多模态融合。其编码器基于高效的 Point Gaussian Encoder (PGE) 进行改进，包含两个关键改进：一是 Ray-centric PGE (R-PGE)，在统一到鸟瞰图空间之前在射线对齐坐标系中预测高斯属性，以显著提高几何一致性并降低学习难度；二是引入 Semantic Injection (SI) 模块，将图像的视觉线索融入雷达特征，以产生更几何准确且语义丰富的雷达特征。

主要发现: 研究发现，简单地增强雷达特征提取可以比复杂的融合模块实现相当甚至更高的性能，同时保持实时性能。

结论: 在 View-of-Delft (VoD) 和 TJ4DRadSet 数据集上的实验表明，RCGDet3D 在准确性和速度上均优于最先进的方法，为实时部署设立了新的基准。

翻译: 4D automotive radar is indispensable for autonomous driving due to its low cost and robustness, yet its point cloud sparsity challenges 3D object detection. Existing 4D radar-camera fusion methods focus on complex fusion strategies, trading inference speed for marginal gains. This trade-off hinders real-time deployment due to heavy computation on dense feature maps. In contrast, feature extraction from sparse radar points is less time-consuming but remains under-explored. This work uncovers that simply enhancing radar feature extraction can achieve comparable or even higher performance than elaborate fusion modules, while maintaining real-time performance. Based on this finding, we propose RCGDet3D, which centers on radar feature encoding and simplifies multi-modal fusion. Its encoder inherits from the efficient Gaussian Splatting-based Point Gaussian Encoder (PGE) in RadarGaussianDet3D with two key improvements. First, the Ray-centric PGE (R-PGE) predicts Gaussian attributes in ray-aligned coordinate systems before unifying them to Bird's-Eye View (BEV) space, significantly improving geometric consistency and reducing learning difficulty by decoupling the coordinate transformation from representation learning. Second, a Semantic Injection (SI) module incorporates visual cues from images, producing more geometrically accurate and semantically enriched radar features. Experiments on View-of-Delft (VoD) and TJ4DRadSet show that RCGDet3D outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and speed, setting a new benchmark for real-time deployment.

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种改进的 3D 目标检测方法，通过增强雷达特征编码来提升 4D 雷达与相机融合的效果。

Abstract

4D automotive radar is indispensable for autonomous driving due to its low cost and robustness, yet its point cloud sparsity challenges 3D object detection. Existing 4D radar-camera fusion methods focus on complex fusion strategies, trading inference speed for marginal gains. This trade-off hinders real-time deployment due to heavy computation on dense feature maps. In contrast, feature extraction from sparse radar points is less time-consuming but remains under-explored. This work uncovers that simply enhancing radar feature extraction can achieve comparable or even higher performance than elaborate fusion modules, while maintaining real-time performance. Based on this finding, we propose RCGDet3D, which centers on radar feature encoding and simplifies multi-modal fusion. Its encoder inherits from the efficient Gaussian Splatting-based Point Gaussian Encoder (PGE) in RadarGaussianDet3D with two key improvements. First, the Ray-centric PGE (R-PGE) predicts Gaussian attributes in ray-aligned coordinate systems before unifying them to Bird's-Eye View (BEV) space, significantly improving geometric consistency and reducing learning difficulty by decoupling the coordinate transformation from representation learning. Second, a Semantic Injection (SI) module incorporates visual cues from images, producing more geometrically accurate and semantically enriched radar features. Experiments on View-of-Delft (VoD) and TJ4DRadSet show that RCGDet3D outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and speed, setting a new benchmark for real-time deployment.

item.title: UniT: Unified Geometry Learning with Group Autoregressive Transformer
item.author: Wang, Haotian, Huang, Yusong, Kuang, Zhaonian, Lu, Hongliang, Zheng, Xinhu, Yang, Meng, Hua, Gang
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UniT是一个统一模型，基于新的分组自回归Transformer，将几何感知的多种能力整合到一个框架中。

背景: 现有的前馈模型在几何感知方面取得了显著进展，但其核心能力分散在多个不兼容的范式（如在线感知、离线重建、多模态集成、长时域可扩展性和度量尺度估计）中。

目的: 提出UniT，一个统一模型，旨在将看似不同的能力重新构建在一个单一的框架内。

方法: 将传感器观测组作为基本自回归单元，以无锚点和尺度自适应的方式预测相应的点图。通过改变组大小，在线模式在多个自回归步骤上操作，而离线模式在单次前向传播中聚合多帧组。使用队列式KV缓存机制确保长时域内的有界自回归内存，通过无锚点关系建模减少对早期帧的依赖。引入尺度自适应几何损失，结合相对几何约束和部分绝对尺度项，隐式地正则化全局尺度并诱导从尺度不变几何到度量尺度解的渐进过渡。使用专门的模态注意力模块集成辅助模态。

主要发现: UniT在七个代表性任务的十个基准上实现了最先进的性能。

结论: UniT在统一几何感知方面取得了最先进的性能。

翻译: 最近的前馈模型在从传感器观测推断密集3D结构方面取得了显著进展。然而，其核心能力仍然分散在多个不兼容的范式（包括在线感知、离线重建、多模态集成、长时域可扩展性和度量尺度估计）中。我们提出了UniT，一个基于新的分组自回归Transformer的统一模型，它将这些看似不同的能力重新构建在一个单一的框架内。关键思想是将传感器观测组视为基本自回归单元，并以无锚点和尺度自适应的方式预测相应的点图。更具体地说，在线和离线设置中的不同视图配置自然地统一在单个分组自回归过程中。通过改变组大小，在线模式在多个自回归步骤上操作，而离线模式在单次前向传播中聚合多帧组。同时，队列式KV缓存机制确保了长时域内的有界自回归内存。这是通过减少对早期帧的依赖，从而允许过时的内存被实时丢弃来实现的。为了提高跨场景的度量尺度泛化能力，在这个框架内引入了尺度自适应几何损失。它将相对几何约束与部分绝对尺度项相结合，隐式地正则化全局尺度并诱导从尺度不变几何到度量尺度解的渐进过渡。结合用于集成辅助模态的专用模态注意力模块，UniT在统一几何感知方面实现了最先进的性能，并在七个代表性任务的十个基准上得到了验证。
