如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent diffusion models achieve strong photorealism and fluency in video generation, yet remain fragile under abstract, sparse or complex conditions, leading to poor performance in professional production workflows such as storyboard sketches and clay render conditions. Existing video generation models, either inject conditions through adapters or couple a generic vision-language model (VLM) within a diffusion backbone, leaving a capability gap and failing to produce the videos that align with the user's creative intent. We present CogOmniControl, a reasoning-driven framework that factorizes controllable video generation into creative intent cognition and generation. Specifically, we train a specialized CogVLM using authentic anime production data. Compared to generic VLMs, it generates more professional and clear outputs, accurately cognizing user creative intent from sparse and abstract conditions and tuning these cues into dense reasoning output. Besides, CogOmniDiT unifies the controls from various conditions through in-context generation and is aligned to the CogVLM reasoning outputs via reinforcement learning. Furthermore, leveraging CogVLM's robust capability in guiding video generation, we release its potential in planning specific evaluators and enable a Best-of-N selection for the generated videos. This integration transforms the entire framework into a closed-loop "harness-like" architecture. We further introduce CogReasonBench and CogControlBench, built from professional workflows data that carry genuine creative intent rather than simulated ones. Experiments on two benchmarks show that CogOmniControl surpassed the existing open-source models. The project website: this https URL

item.title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
item.author: Liu, Jiaqi, Qiu, Shi, Li, Mairui, Li, Bingzhou, Ji, Haonian, Han, Siwei, Ye, Xinyu, Xia, Peng, Dong, Zihan, Zhang, Congyu, Zhang, Letian, Chen, Guiming, Tu, Haoqin, Yang, Xinyu, Feng, Lu, Zhao, Xujiang, Chen, Haifeng, Zhou, Jiawei, Wang, Xiao, Zhang, Weitong, Zhu, Hongtu, Li, Yun, Mei, Jieru, Fei, Hongliang, Zhang, Jiaheng, Li, Linjie, Zhang, Linjun, Zhou, Yuyin, Wang, Sheng, Xiong, Caiming, Zou, James, Zheng, Zeyu, Xie, Cihang, Ding, Mingyu, Yao, Huaxiu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AutoResearchClaw是一个多智能体自主研究管道，旨在通过结构化辩论、自我修复执行器、可验证报告、人机协作和跨运行进化等机制，实现更接近真实科学研究的迭代过程。

背景: 现有自主研究系统通常将研究过程建模为线性管道，依赖单智能体推理，在执行失败时停止，且无法在运行间积累经验。

目的: 构建一个多智能体自主研究管道，以模拟真实科学研究的迭代过程，包括多视角挑战假设、从失败中学习以及跨周期积累经验。

方法: AutoResearchClaw基于五种机制构建：结构化多智能体辩论用于假设生成和结果分析；具有Pivot/Refine决策循环的自我修复执行器，将失败转化为信息；可验证的结果报告以防止伪造数字和幻觉引用；具有七种干预模式的人机协作；以及跨运行进化，将过去的错误转化为未来的安全措施。

主要发现: 在ARC-Bench基准测试上，AutoResearchClaw比AI Scientist v2高出54.7%；人机协作消融实验表明，在高杠杆决策点的精确、有针对性的协作始终优于完全自主和详尽的逐步监督。

结论: AutoResearchClaw被定位为研究放大器，旨在增强而非取代人类科学判断。

翻译: 自动化科学发现需要的不只是从想法生成论文。真实的研究是迭代的：假设从多个角度受到挑战，实验失败并指导下一次尝试，经验在周期间积累。现有的自主研究系统通常将这个过程建模为线性管道：它们依赖单智能体推理，在执行失败时停止，并且不在运行间携带经验。我们提出了AutoResearchClaw，一个基于五种机制的多智能体自主研究管道：用于假设生成和结果分析的结构化多智能体辩论；具有Pivot/Refine决策循环的自我修复执行器，将失败转化为信息；可验证的结果报告，防止伪造数字和幻觉引用；具有七种干预模式的人机协作，从完全自主到逐步监督；以及跨运行进化，将过去的错误转化为未来的安全措施。在ARC-Bench上，一个25主题实验阶段基准，AutoResearchClaw比AI Scientist v2高出54.7%。跨七种干预模式的人机协作消融实验表明，在高杠杆决策点的精确、有针对性的协作始终优于完全自主和详尽的逐步监督。我们将AutoResearchClaw定位为研究放大器，旨在增强而非取代人类科学判断。代码可在此 https URL 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Automating scientific discovery requires more than generating papers from ideas. Real research is iterative: hypotheses are challenged from multiple perspectives, experiments fail and inform the next attempt, and lessons accumulate across cycles. Existing autonomous research systems often model this process as a linear pipeline: they rely on single-agent reasoning, stop when execution fails, and do not carry experience across runs. We present AutoResearchClaw, a multi-agent autonomous research pipeline built on five mechanisms: structured multi-agent debate for hypothesis generation and result analysis, a self-healing executor with a \textsc{Pivot}/\textsc{Refine} decision loop that transforms failures into information, verifiable result reporting that prevents fabricated numbers and hallucinated citations, human-in-the-loop collaboration with seven intervention modes spanning full autonomy to step-by-step oversight, and cross-run evolution that converts past mistakes into future safeguards. On ARC-Bench, a 25-topic experiment-stage benchmark, AutoResearchClaw outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7%. A human-in-the-loop ablation across seven intervention modes reveals that precise, targeted collaboration at high-leverage decision points consistently outperforms both full autonomy and exhaustive step-by-step oversight. We position AutoResearchClaw as a research amplifier that augments rather than replaces human scientific judgment. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
item.author: Xin, Zijie, Yang, Jie, Zhao, Ruixiang, Wang, Tianyi, Rao, Fengyun, Lyu, Jing, Li, Xirong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SEATS是一种训练无关且分阶段自适应的令牌选择方法，旨在通过去除冗余令牌来提高Omni-modal大语言模型（om-LLMs）的推理效率。

背景: Omni-modal大语言模型通过将视频和音频编码为交错的时间对齐令牌序列来实现统一的音频-视觉理解，但处理这些密集的非文本令牌会带来巨大的计算开销。现有的训练无关令牌选择方法要么仅关注视觉输入，要么仅在LLM之前以固定的模态比例修剪om-LLM令牌，无法捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度的演变。

目的: 为了解决现有方法无法捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度演变的问题，提出一种训练无关、分阶段自适应的令牌选择方法（SEATS），以在保持性能的同时提高om-LLM的推理效率。

方法: SEATS方法首先在LLM之前通过注意力加权多样性选择去除时空冗余；在LLM内部，它跨块逐步修剪令牌，并使用查询相关性分数动态分配保留预算；在后期层，一旦跨模态融合完成，它移除所有剩余的非文本令牌。

主要发现: 研究发现视觉和音频依赖关系遵循块状模式，并随深度逐渐减弱，表明许多后期层的非文本令牌在跨模态融合后变得冗余。

结论: 在Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni上的实验表明，SEATS能有效提高推理效率。仅保留10%的视觉和音频令牌，实现了9.3倍的FLOPs减少和4.8倍的预填充加速，同时保持了96.3%的原始性能。

翻译: Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) 通过将视频和音频编码为在窗口级别交错的时间对齐令牌序列来实现统一的音频-视觉理解。然而，在整个LLM中处理这些密集的非文本令牌会产生巨大的计算开销。虽然训练无关的令牌选择可以降低这种成本，但现有方法要么仅关注视觉输入，要么仅在LLM之前以固定的模态比例修剪om-LLM令牌，未能捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度的演变。为了解决这一局限性，我们首先分析了om-LLMs的逐层令牌依赖关系。我们发现视觉和音频依赖关系遵循块状模式，并随深度逐渐减弱，表明许多后期层的非文本令牌在跨模态融合后变得冗余。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了SEATS，一种用于高效om-LLM推理的训练无关、分阶段自适应令牌选择方法。在LLM之前，SEATS通过注意力加权多样性选择去除时空冗余。在LLM内部，它跨块逐步修剪令牌，并使用查询相关性分数动态分配保留预算。在后期层，一旦跨模态融合完成，它移除所有剩余的非文本令牌。在Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni上的实验表明，SEATS能有效提高推理效率。仅保留10%的视觉和音频令牌，实现了9.3倍的FLOPs减少和4.8倍的预填充加速，同时保持了96.3%的原始性能。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

Abstract

Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) achieve unified audio-visual understanding by encoding video and audio into temporally aligned token sequences interleaved at the window level. However, processing these dense non-textual tokens throughout the LLM incurs substantial computational overhead. Although training-free token selection can reduce this cost, existing methods either focus on visual-only inputs or prune om-LLM tokens only before the LLM with fixed per-modality ratios, failing to capture how cross-modal token importance evolves across layers. To address this limitation, we first analyze the layer-wise token dependency of om-LLMs. We find that visual and audio dependencies follow a block-wise pattern and gradually weaken with depth, indicating that many late-layer non-textual tokens become redundant after cross-modal fusion. Motivated by this observation, we propose SEATS, a training-free, stage-adaptive token selection method for efficient om-LLM inference. Before the LLM, SEATS removes spatiotemporal redundancy via attention-weighted diversity selection. Inside the LLM, it progressively prunes tokens across blocks and dynamically allocates the retention budget from temporal windows to modalities using query relevance scores. In late layers, it removes all remaining non-textual tokens once cross-modal fusion is complete. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni demonstrate that SEATS effectively improves inference efficiency. Retaining only 10% of visual and audio tokens, it achieves a 9.3x FLOPs reduction and a 4.8x prefill speedup while preserving 96.3% of the original performance.

item.title: OP2GS: Object-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting with Dual-Opacity Primitives
item.author: Guiyu Liu, Niklas Vaara, Janne Mustaniemi, Juho Kannala, Janne Heikkilä
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 提供了一种显式且高效的场景表示，但其原语缺乏固有的对象级身份，阻碍了开放词汇场景理解等下游任务。现有方法通常通过将高维特征嵌入蒸馏到高斯中或通过启发式细化将 2D 掩码标签提升到 3D 来解决这一问题。然而，基于特征的方法会产生沉重的存储和解码开销，而基于提升的管道仍然容易受到标签污染的影响：对于外观重建必要的高斯在 2D 到 3D 投影过程中经常接收错误的对象标签。

背景: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 提供了一种显式且高效的场景表示，但其原语缺乏固有的对象级身份，阻碍了下游任务。

目的: 提出 OP2GS，一种对象感知的高斯表示，通过为每个原语添加显式实例身份和专用的实例不透明度 σ* 来解决这些问题。

方法: 引入随机对象损失来优化 1D 实例占用场，使用 3DGS 的标准基于透射率的可见性。语义描述符随后通过多视图聚合在对象级别附加，消除了每个高斯特征存储。

主要发现: 与基于特征训练的方法相比，OP2GS 在实现具有竞争力的开放词汇性能的同时，显著减少了计算开销。与无训练管道相比，它利用物理一致的占用学习来解决可见性歧义。

结论: OP2GS 通过双不透明度公式解耦了视觉存在与实例占用，使得被错误标记的高斯可以保持可用于图像渲染，同时在对象掩码分支中变得透明。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为OP2GS的对象感知3D高斯溅射方法，通过使用双不透明度原语来增强对物体的建模能力。

Abstract

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an explicit and efficient scene representation, but its primitives lack inherent object-level identity, hindering downstream tasks such as open-vocabulary scene understanding. Existing methods typically address this by either distilling high-dimensional feature embeddings into Gaussians or by lifting 2D mask labels into 3D via heuristic refinement. However, feature-based approaches incur heavy storage and decoding overhead, while lifting-based pipelines remain vulnerable to label contamination: Gaussians necessary for appearance reconstruction often receive incorrect object labels during 2D-to-3D projection. We propose OP2GS, an object-aware Gaussian representation that augments each primitive with an explicit instance identity and a dedicated instance opacity $σ^{*}$ for object-mask rendering. The original opacity $σ$ remains responsible for visual reconstruction, while $σ^{*}$ models whether a Gaussian should contribute to a particular object mask. This dual-opacity formulation decouples visual existence from instance occupancy: mislabeled Gaussians can remain available for image rendering while becoming transparent in the object-mask branch. To learn this representation, we introduce a random object loss that optimizes the 1D instance occupancy field using the standard transmittance-based visibility of 3DGS. Semantic descriptors are then attached at the object level through multi-view aggregation, eliminating per-Gaussian feature storage. Compared with feature-training approaches, OP2GS achieves competitive open-vocabulary performance while significantly reducing computational overhead. Compared with training-free pipelines, it leverages physically consistent occupancy learning to resolve visibility ambiguities.

总结: 本文介绍了CopT，一种重新构建的推理管道，通过颠倒思考和回答的顺序来提高效率。CopT首先生成草稿答案，然后基于草稿答案进行后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案的可信度，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器，通过对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持程度，得出序列级反向KL估计器。CopT在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。

背景: 传统的思维链（CoT）范式将思考视为回答的前提，这可能导致在模型能够识别答案之前就进行不必要的思考，从而延迟获得合理答案并增加不必要的token成本，这种行为被称为表演性推理。

目的: 为了解决传统CoT范式中的效率问题，本文提出了一种重新构建的推理管道CopT，旨在颠倒思考和回答的顺序，以减少不必要的token使用并提高推理效率。

方法: CopT首先生成草稿答案，然后基于草稿答案进行后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案的可信度，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器，通过对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持程度，得出序列级反向KL估计器。当答案被认为不够可靠时，CopT会执行进一步的有政策思考，其中第二个KL估计器动态控制草稿答案的可见性，在保留有用部分信息的同时减少被不可靠内容误导的风险。

主要发现: 在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，CopT在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。

结论: CopT通过颠倒思考和回答的顺序，以及引入基于对比验证的可靠性评估机制，在不进行额外训练的情况下，显著提高了推理任务的准确率并降低了token使用成本，证明了其在提升推理效率和可靠性方面的有效性。

翻译: 思维链（CoT）是一种从大型语言模型（LLMs）中激发推理能力的标准方法。然而，常见的CoT范式将思考视为回答的前提，这可能导致在模型能够识别答案之前就进行不必要的思考，从而延迟获得合理答案并增加不必要的token成本，这种行为被称为表演性推理。在本文中，我们介绍了CopT，一种重新构建的推理管道，它颠倒了思考和回答的顺序。CopT不是在回答之前先思考，而是首先激发草稿答案，然后基于其自身的草稿答案调用后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案是否值得信赖，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器。具体来说，它对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持，得出序列级反向KL估计器，用于评估答案的可靠性。我们的分析表明，在特定假设下，期望估计值等于未解决潜在状态和发出的答案token之间的互信息，解释了为什么它捕获的是与答案相关的潜在状态的不确定性，而不是潜在状态中的任意不确定性。当答案被认为不够可靠时，CopT执行进一步的有政策思考，其中第二个KL估计器动态控制草稿答案的可见性，在保留有用部分信息的同时减少被不可靠内容误导的风险。在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，CopT在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。代码可在该URL处获取。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Chain-of-thought (CoT) is a standard approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities from large language models (LLMs). However, the common CoT paradigm treats thinking as a prerequisite for answering, which can delay access to plausible answers and incur unnecessary token costs even when the model is able to identify an answer before extended thinking, a behavior known as performative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce CopT, a reformulated reasoning pipeline that reverses the usual order of thinking and answering. Instead of thinking before answering, CopT first elicits a draft answer and then invokes subsequent on-policy thinking conditioned on its own draft answer for reflection and correction. To assess whether the draft answer should be trusted, CopT recasts continuous embeddings as inference-time contrastive verifiers. Specifically, it contrasts the model's support for the same generated tokens under discrete-token inputs and continuous-embedding inputs, yielding a sequence-level reverse KL estimator for answer reliability. Our analysis shows that under certain assumptions, the expected estimate equals the mutual information between the unresolved latent state and the emitted answer token, explaining why it captures answer-relevant uncertainty rather than arbitrary uncertainty in the latent state. When the answer is deemed insufficiently reliable, CopT performs further on-policy thinking, where a second KL estimator dynamically controls draft-answer visibility, preserving useful partial information while reducing the risk of being misled by unreliable content. Across mathematics, coding, and agentic reasoning tasks, CopT improves peak accuracy by up to 23% and reduces token usage by up to 57% at comparable or higher accuracy, without any additional training. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions
item.author: Chuanyang Jin, Binze Li, Haopeng Xie, Cathy Mengying Fang, Tianjian Li, Shayne Longpre, Hongxiang Gu, Maximillian Chen, Tianmin Shu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ThoughtTrace 是首个大规模对话数据集，将真实多轮人机对话与用户自我报告的思维过程配对，旨在研究用户思维模式。

背景: 现有对话数据集仅捕捉人们说的话，未包含他们说的话背后的想法和反应。

目的: 引入 ThoughtTrace 数据集，将用户发送提示的原因和对话中的反应配对，以研究人机交互背后的认知动态。

方法: ThoughtTrace 包含 1,058 名用户、2,155 次对话、17,058 轮对话和 10,174 条思维标注，收集自 20 个语言模型。

主要发现: ThoughtTrace 捕捉了长期、主题多样的交互，思维与消息在语义上不同，难以从上下文中推断，内容多样且与对话阶段相关；思维有助于下游建模，提升用户行为预测，并为个性化助手训练提供对齐信号。

结论: ThoughtTrace 建立了用户思维作为研究人机交互认知动态的新数据模态，为构建更好理解用户潜在目标、偏好和需求的助手奠定了基础。

翻译: Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis shows that ThoughtTrace captures long-horizon, topically diverse interactions, and that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages, difficult for frontier LLMs to infer from context, diverse in content, and tied to conversation stages. We further demonstrate the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling. First, thoughts improve user-behavior prediction as inference-time context. Second, thought-guided rewrites provide fine-grained alignment signals for training personalized assistants. Together, ThoughtTrace establishes user thoughts as a new data modality for studying the cognitive dynamics behind human--AI interaction and provides a foundation for building assistants that better understand and adapt to users' latent goals, preferences, and needs.

Abstract

Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis shows that ThoughtTrace captures long-horizon, topically diverse interactions, and that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages, difficult for frontier LLMs to infer from context, diverse in content, and tied to conversation stages. We further demonstrate the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling. First, thoughts improve user-behavior prediction as inference-time context. Second, thought-guided rewrites provide fine-grained alignment signals for training personalized assistants. Together, ThoughtTrace establishes user thoughts as a new data modality for studying the cognitive dynamics behind human--AI interaction and provides a foundation for building assistants that better understand and adapt to users' latent goals, preferences, and needs.

item.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
item.author: Shen, Yuhao, Liu, Tianyu, Hu, Xinyi, Kong, Quan, Zhang, Baolin, Dai, Jun, Zhang, Jun, Ge, Shuang, Chen, Lei, Li, Yue, Wan, Mingcheng, Wang, Cong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Graft是一个训练无损失且完全免费的补偿框架，通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

背景: 推测解码通过利用草稿-验证范式加速大型语言模型推理，但为了最大化接受率，近期方法构建了广泛的草稿树，这不幸地导致了严重的显存带宽和计算开销，限制了端到端加速。虽然动态深度修剪可以通过移除边缘分支来减少延迟，但它也丢弃了潜在的有效候选者，阻止了接受率达到密集树的最高上限。

目的: 识别资源分配中的关键机会：从密集到修剪的草稿转换释放了大量的计算预算。为了打破修剪和检索之间的权衡，引入Graft补偿框架，将修剪和检索耦合为相互增强的操作。

方法: 采用顺序的'修剪-然后-嫁接'机制，将高度预测的检索令牌附加到修剪打开的位置，用近零开销填充拓扑间隙。Graft完全训练无损失且免费。

主要发现: Graft在短上下文生成、长上下文生成和大规模模型中建立了新的帕累托前沿。在短上下文基准测试中，实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大规模Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

结论: Graft通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，成功打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

翻译: 推测解码通过利用草稿-验证范式加速大型语言模型推理，但为了最大化接受率，近期方法构建了广泛的草稿树，这不幸地导致了严重的显存带宽和计算开销，限制了端到端加速。虽然动态深度修剪可以通过移除边缘分支来减少延迟，但它也丢弃了潜在的有效候选者，阻止了接受率达到密集树的最高上限。Graft是一个训练无损失且完全免费的补偿框架，通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

Abstract

Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by leveraging a draft-then-verify paradigm. To maximize the acceptance rate, recent methods construct expansive draft trees, which unfortunately incur severe VRAM bandwidth and computational overheads that bottleneck end-to-end speedups. While dynamic-depth pruning can reduce this latency by removing marginal branches, it also discards potentially valid candidates, preventing the acceptance rate from reaching the upper bound of dense trees. In this paper, we identify a critical opportunity in resource allocation: the transition from dense to pruned drafting frees up significant computational budget. To break this Pareto tradeoff, we introduce Graft, a compensation framework that couples pruning and retrieval as mutually reinforcing operations. Pruning supplies sufficient budget for retrieval, while retrieval compensates for pruning-induced coverage loss and recovers accepted length. By employing a sequential `prune-then-graft' mechanism, Graft attaches highly predictive retrieved tokens into positions opened by pruning, filling the topological gaps with near-zero overhead. Graft is entirely training-free and lossless. Comprehensive evaluations show that Graft establishes a new Pareto frontier across practical deployment settings, including short-context generation, long-context generation, and large-scale models. On short-context benchmarks, it achieves up to 5.41$\times$ speedup and improves average speedup over EAGLE-3 by up to 21.8% on the large-scale Qwen3-235B. We also provide a preliminary exploration of applying Graft to the DFlash-style block drafting paradigm, offering initial evidence and insights for extending grafting beyond autoregressive draft trees.

item.title: TrajTok: Adaptive Spatial Tokenization for Trajectory Representation Learning
item.author: Zhen Xiong, Shang-Ling Hsu, Cyrus Shahabi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TrajTok是一种轨迹编码器，通过多分辨率六边形网格划分和掩码令牌建模，从原始GPS轨迹中学习可迁移的轨迹表示。

背景: 从原始GPS轨迹学习通用可迁移的轨迹表示很难，因为数据是连续的、嘈杂的且不规则采样的。空间分词也具有挑战性：细网格产生稀疏单元格且嵌入弱，粗网格将异质运动模式合并到同一令牌中。

目的: 提出TrajTok，一种具有简单预训练配方以实现可迁移轨迹嵌入的轨迹编码器。

方法: TrajTok首先从GPS点的空间分布中学习多分辨率六边形单元格划分，将嘈杂的GPS序列转换为离散单元格令牌。为了捕获几何和运动学，它使用分解的Transformer编码器，包括早期模态自注意力块、交叉注意力融合层和时空旋转位置嵌入ST-RoPE来编码每个令牌发生的位置和时间。TrajTok使用掩码令牌建模进行预训练，从部分轨迹观察中恢复几何结构和运动学模式。

主要发现: 在Porto数据集上，带有轻量级任务适配器的冻结TrajTok编码器在轨迹相似性搜索、分类、到达时间估计和完整旅行时间回归中实现了强劲性能，优于多种特定任务方法。相同的冻结编码器支持几何主导和运动学主导任务，表明TrajTok学习的是可迁移的轨迹结构而不是任务特定的捷径。

结论: 学习到的多分辨率空间分词与掩码令牌预训练的结合是通用轨迹基础模型的有前景的方向。

翻译: 从原始GPS轨迹学习通用可迁移的轨迹表示仍然困难，因为数据是连续的、嘈杂的且不规则采样的。空间分词也具有挑战性：细网格产生稀疏单元格且嵌入弱，而粗网格将异质运动模式合并到同一令牌中。我们提出了TrajTok，一种具有简单预训练配方以实现可迁移轨迹嵌入的轨迹编码器。TrajTok首先从GPS点的空间分布中学习多分辨率六边形单元格划分，将嘈杂的GPS序列转换为离散单元格令牌。为了捕获几何和运动学，它使用分解的Transformer编码器，包括早期模态自注意力块、交叉注意力融合层和时空旋转位置嵌入ST-RoPE来编码每个令牌发生的位置和时间。TrajTok使用掩码令牌建模进行预训练，从部分轨迹观察中恢复几何结构和运动学模式。在Porto数据集上，带有轻量级任务适配器的冻结TrajTok编码器在轨迹相似性搜索、分类、到达时间估计和完整旅行时间回归中实现了强劲性能，优于多种特定任务方法。相同的冻结编码器支持几何主导和运动学主导任务，表明TrajTok学习的是可迁移的轨迹结构而不是任务特定的捷径。这些结果表明，学习到的多分辨率空间分词与掩码令牌预训练相结合是通用轨迹基础模型的有前景的方向。

Abstract

Learning generalizable trajectory representations from raw GPS traces remains difficult because the data is continuous, noisy, and irregularly sampled. Spatial tokenization is also challenging: fine grids yield sparse cells with weak embeddings, while coarse grids merge heterogeneous movement patterns into the same token. We present TrajTok, a trajectory encoder with a simple pretraining recipe for transferable trajectory embeddings. TrajTok first learns a multi-resolution hexagonal cell partition from the spatial distribution of GPS points, converting noisy GPS sequences into discrete cell tokens. To capture both geometry and kinematics, it uses a factorized transformer encoder with early per-modality self-attention blocks, cross-attention fusion layers, and spatiotemporal rotary position embeddings, ST-RoPE, to encode where and when each token occurs. TrajTok is pretrained with masked-token modeling that recovers both geometric structure and kinematic patterns from partial trajectory observations. On the Porto dataset, a frozen TrajTok encoder with lightweight task adapters achieves strong performance across trajectory similarity search, classification, estimated time of arrival, and full travel-time regression, outperforming multiple task-specific methods. The same frozen encoder supports both geometry-dominated and kinematics-dominated tasks, suggesting that TrajTok learns transferable trajectory structure rather than task-specific shortcuts. These results indicate that learned multi-resolution spatial tokenization combined with masked-token pretraining is a promising direction for general-purpose trajectory foundation models.

item.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
item.author: Chen, Haojun, He, Haoyang, Xu, Chengming, He, Qingdong, Zhu, Junwei, Wang, Yabiao, Xue, Zhucun, Zeng, Xianfang, Chen, Zhennan, Hu, Xiaobin, Zhao, Hao, Liu, Yong, Zhang, Jiangning, Tao, Dacheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了PixVerve-95K数据集、PixVerve-Bench基准测试以及将文本到图像模型扩展到100MP生成的训练方案。

背景: 随着对更好视觉体验的需求和成像技术的快速发展，对超高清图像生成的需求显著增长。

目的: 解决超高清图像生成面临的挑战，通过数据集和基准测试提供有价值的见解。

方法: 1. 构建了包含95K图像的PixVerve-95K数据集；2. 提出了PixVerve-Bench基准测试；3. 提出了三种训练方案将基础模型扩展到100MP生成。

主要发现: 通过实验结果和训练策略的探索，提供了有价值的见解。

结论: 为未来的突破提供了有价值的见解。

翻译: 文本到图像模型在最近1K和2K分辨率方面取得了显著进展。随着对更好视觉体验的极端需求和成像技术的快速发展，对超高清图像生成的需求显著增长。然而，由于高分辨率内容的稀缺性和复杂性，UHR图像生成带来了巨大挑战。在本文中，我们首先介绍了PixVerve-95K，这是一个高质量、开源的UHR T2I数据集，通过精心设计的数据管道进行策划，包含95K图像，涵盖多种场景（每张图像的最小像素数至少为1亿）和七维注释。基于我们的大规模图像文本数据集，我们率先采取了一步，通过三种训练方案将各种T2I基础模型扩展到原生100MP生成。最后，利用传统指标和多模态大语言模型评估，我们提出的PixVerve-Bench基准测试建立了一个全面的UHR图像评估协议，包括视觉质量和语义对齐。在我们的基准测试和训练策略的建设性探索上的大量实验结果共同为未来的突破提供了有价值的见解。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决原生超高清图像生成的问题，特别是将分辨率提升至一亿像素级别。关于这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要，文中未提及，为 unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 输入文本仅包含论文的元数据信息，未提供关于方法设计思路或借鉴现有工作的具体内容，因此无法回答。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了一个大规模高质量数据集，旨在推进原生超高清图像生成至 100MP 分辨率。

Abstract

Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently seen notable progress around 1K and 2K resolution. With the extreme desire for better visual experience and the rapid development of imaging technology, the demand for Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) image generation has grown significantly. However, UHR image generation poses great challenges due to the scarcity and complexity of high-resolution content. In this paper, we first introduce PixVerve-95K, a high-quality, open-source UHR T2I dataset curated with a carefully designed data pipeline, which contains 95K images across diverse scenarios (each image has a minimum pixel-count of 100M) and seven-dimensional annotations. Based on our large-scale image-text dataset, we take a pioneering step to extend various T2I foundation models to native 100MP generation with three training schemes. Finally, leveraging both conventional metrics and multimodal large language model-based assessments, our proposed PixVerve-Bench benchmark establishes a comprehensive evaluation protocol for UHR images encompassing visual quality and semantic alignment. Extensive experimental results on our benchmark and the constructive exploration of training strategies collaboratively provide valuable insights for future breakthroughs.

item.title: TideGS: Scalable Training of Over One Billion 3D Gaussian Splatting Primitives via Out-of-Core Optimization
item.author: Zhong, Chonghao, Shi, Linfeng, Chen, Hua, Sun, Tiecheng, Zhao, Hao, Yuan, Binhang, Li, Chaojian
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TideGS是一个在大规模3D高斯泼溅训练中解决内存限制的框架，通过利用稀疏性和轨迹条件特性，在单个24GB GPU上实现了超过10亿个高斯原型的训练，同时保持最佳重建质量。

背景: 在单GPU硬件上训练大规模3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）受到内存限制，因为每个高斯原型携带大量属性向量，导致聚合参数表快速超过GPU容量，限制了先前系统在商用单GPU硬件上只能训练数千万个高斯。

目的: 提出TideGS框架，旨在解决在大规模3DGS训练中的内存瓶颈问题，实现单GPU上训练超过10亿个高斯原型，并保持最佳重建质量。

方法: TideGS利用3DGS训练的内在稀疏性和轨迹条件特性，采用三种协同技术：块虚拟化几何以实现SSD对齐的空间局部性、分层异步流水线以重叠I/O与计算，以及轨迹自适应差分流式传输以仅传输增量工作集差值。

主要发现: 实验表明，TideGS能够在单个24GB GPU上训练超过10亿个高斯，在大型场景中达到最佳重建质量，超越了先前的基于外存训练基线（约100M高斯）和标准内存训练（约11M高斯）。

结论: TideGS成功克服了大规模3DGS训练的内存限制，证明了在单GPU上实现超大规模高斯训练的可行性，并提供了比现有方法更优的重建质量。

翻译: TideGS是一个在大规模3D高斯泼溅训练中解决内存限制的框架，通过利用稀疏性和轨迹条件特性，在单个24GB GPU上实现了超过10亿个高斯原型的训练，同时保持最佳重建质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文介绍了一种名为TideGS的方法，通过外存优化技术实现了对超过十亿个3D高斯原语的可扩展训练。

Abstract

Training 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) at billion-primitive scale is fundamentally memory-bound: each Gaussian primitive carries a large attribute vector, and the aggregate parameter table quickly exceeds GPU capacity, limiting prior systems to tens of millions of Gaussians on commodity single-GPU hardware. We observe that 3DGS training is inherently sparse and trajectory-conditioned: each iteration activates only the Gaussians visible from the current camera batch, so GPU memory can serve as a working-set cache rather than a persistent parameter store. Building on this insight, we introduce TideGS, an out-of-core training framework that manages parameters across an SSD-CPU-GPU hierarchy via three synergistic techniques: block-virtualized geometry for SSD-aligned spatial locality, a hierarchical asynchronous pipeline to overlap I/O with computation, and trajectory-adaptive differential streaming that transfers only incremental working-set deltas between iterations. Experiments show that TideGS enables training with over one billion Gaussians on a single 24 GB GPU while achieving the best reconstruction quality among evaluated single-GPU baselines on large-scale scenes, scaling beyond prior out-of-core baselines (e.g., approximately 100M Gaussians) and standard in-memory training (e.g., approximately 11M Gaussians).

item.title: CaMo: Camera Motion Grounded Evaluation and Training for Vision-Language Models
item.author: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Junbin Lu, Kuang-Ming Chen, Jianxu Shangguan, Cheng-Yen Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种评估框架Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)和一种名为CaMo的模型，旨在解决现有视觉语言模型在空间问题回答中缺乏基本相机运动理解的问题，并验证了显式空间叙事外化对于评估具有可转移3D空间理解能力的模型的重要性。

背景: 现有的空间视觉语言模型在空间问题回答基准测试中表现出色，但尚不清楚这种性能提升是否反映了真正的空间智能。研究发现，现有的空间VLM缺乏基本相机运动理解，这是空间认知的关键组成部分。

目的: 1. 提出Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)评估框架，要求VLM生成包含场景语义和相机运动的显式空间叙事，并使用冻结的代理LLM进行推理。2. 介绍CaMo模型，一种基于相机运动的VLM，以解决现有模型在SNS评估和直接空间问题回答之间的性能差距。

方法: 1. 提出Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)评估框架：要求VLM生成显式空间叙事，捕捉场景语义和相机运动，随后使用冻结的代理LLM进行推理。2. 引入CaMo模型：一种基于相机运动的VLM，旨在在SNS评估和直接空间问题回答中保持一致的性能。

主要发现: 在SNS评估下，最先进的空间VLM尽管在直接问题回答准确率上很高，但表现出显著的性能下降。CaMo模型在SNS评估和直接空间问题回答准确率上均取得了良好表现。

结论: 显式空间叙事外化对于评估具有可转移3D空间理解能力的VLM至关重要。

翻译: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) 在空间问题回答基准测试中取得了强劲的性能，但尚不清楚这种提升是否反映了真正的空间智能。我们表明，现有的空间VLM缺乏基本相机运动理解，这是空间认知的关键组成部分。我们提出了Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)，一种评估框架，要求VLM生成包含场景语义和相机运动的显式空间叙事，随后使用冻结的代理LLM进行推理。在SNS下，最先进的空间VLM尽管在直接问题回答准确率上很高，但表现出显著的性能下降。为了解决这一差距，我们介绍了CaMo，一种基于相机运动的VLM，在SNS评估和直接空间问题回答准确率上均取得了良好表现。我们的结果强调了显式空间叙事外化对于评估具有可转移3D空间理解能力的VLM的重要性。我们的代码、数据和模型可在 https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/CaMo 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个名为 CaMo 的框架，用于基于相机运动来评估和训练视觉语言模型。

Abstract

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on spatial question answering benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether such gains reflect genuine spatial intelligence. We show that existing spatial VLMs lack basic camera motion understanding, a key component of spatial cognition. We propose the Spatial Narrative Score (SNS), an evaluation framework that requires VLMs to generate explicit spatial narratives capturing both scene semantics and camera motion, followed by reasoning with a frozen proxy LLM. Under SNS, state-of-the-art spatial VLMs exhibit significant performance degradation despite high direct question answering accuracy. To address this gap, we introduce CaMo, a camera motion grounded VLM that achieves consistent performance across SNS evaluation and direct spatial question answering accuracy. Our results highlight the importance of explicit spatial narrative externalization for evaluating VLMs with transferable 3D spatial understanding. Our code, data, and model is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/CaMo

item.title: Atoms of Thought: Universal EEG Representation Learning with Microstates
item.author: Xinyang Tian, Ruitao Liu, Ziyi Ye, Siyang Xue, Xin Wang, Xuesong Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于微状态的脑电图表示学习方法，通过聚类连续脑电图信号构建微状态分词器，并将其应用于睡眠分期、情感识别和运动想象分类等下游任务。

背景: 脑电图信号处理是神经信息学和脑机接口领域的前沿方法，传统方法通常将脑电图视为多元时间信号，提取时域或频域特征进行表示学习。

目的: 研究一种简单且有效的脑电图表示方法，即微状态，并构建一个通用的微状态分词器。

方法: 从大型医疗脑电图数据集中构建微状态分词器，通过聚类连续脑电图信号形成离散微状态序列，并将该分词器应用于睡眠分期、情感识别和运动想象分类等下游任务。

主要发现: 基于微状态的脑电图表示学习在不同模型和不同任务中均优于传统的时域和频域特征；微状态提供了更好的可解释性和可扩展性。

结论: 微状态方法在认知神经科学和临床研究中具有广阔的应用前景。

翻译: 从脑电图信号中学习通用表示是神经信息学和脑机接口领域的前沿方法。传统上，脑电图被视为多元时间信号，从中提取时域或频域特征进行表示学习。本文研究了一种简单且有效的脑电图表示方法，即微状态。微状态代表了微观时间尺度上大脑活动模式的构建块。我们从大型医疗脑电图数据集中构建了一个通用的微状态分词器，通过将连续脑电图信号聚类为离散微状态序列。然后，该微状态分词器被普遍采用于一系列下游任务，包括睡眠分期、情感识别和运动想象分类。实验结果表明，使用微状态的脑电图表示学习在不同模型和不同任务中均优于传统的时域和频域特征。进一步分析表明，微状态提供了更好的可解释性和可扩展性，从而为认知神经科学和临床研究开辟了应用前景。

Abstract

Learning universal representations from electroencephalogram (EEG) signals is a cutting-edge approach in the field of neuroinformatics and brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Conventionally, EEG is treated as a multivariate temporal signal, where time- or frequency-domain features are extracted for representation learning. This paper investigates a simple yet effective EEG representation, i.e., microstates. Microstates represent the building blocks of brain activity patterns at a microscopic time scale. We build a universal microstate tokenizer from a large medical EEG dataset by clustering continuous EEG signals into sequences of discrete microstates. The microstate tokenizer is then adopted universally across a series of downstream tasks, including sleep staging, emotion recognition, and motor imagery classification. Experimental results show that EEG representation learning with microstates outperforms traditional time-domain and frequency-domain features under different models and across different tasks. Further analysis shows that microstates offer greater interpretability and scalability, thereby opening up applications in both cognitive neuroscience and clinical research.

item.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
item.author: Wei, Yujie, Han, Yujin, Chen, Zhekai, Li, Yongming, Jiang, Kaixun, Liu, Zhihang, Li, Quanhao, Qing, Zhiwu, Wang, Xiang, Xing, Zhen, Chu, Ruihang, Hong, Lingyi, He, Yefei, Zhou, Junjie, Yu, Junqiu, Shi, Yang, Zou, Difan, Zhu, Kai, Zhang, Shiwei, Zhang, Yingya, Liu, Yu, Liu, Xihui, Shan, Hongming
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了MSAVBench，这是一个首个全面的基准测试和自适应混合评估框架，用于多镜头音频视频生成。

背景: 视频生成正从单镜头合成演变为复杂的多镜头音频视频叙事，以满足现实世界的需求。然而，评估此类前沿模型仍然是一个根本性的挑战。现有的基准测试在范围和数据多样性方面有限，并且依赖于僵化的评估管道，阻碍了对现代MSAV模型的系统性和可靠评估。

目的: 为了弥合这些差距，作者介绍了MSAVBench，这是首个用于多镜头音频视频生成的全面基准测试和自适应混合评估框架。

方法: MSAVBench涵盖了四个关键维度：视频、音频、镜头和参考，涵盖了多样化的任务设置、多达15个镜头的变镜头数量以及具有挑战性的非现实场景。评估框架通过镜头分割的自适应自校正机制、主观指标的实例级标准以及复杂判断的工具引导证据提取来提高鲁棒性。

主要发现: MSAVBench与人类判断高度一致，达到91.5%的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数。对19个最先进的封闭和开源模型的系统评估显示，当前系统在导演级控制和细粒度音频视觉同步方面仍然困难，而模块化或代理生成管道为缩小开源和封闭源模型之间的差距提供了有前景的路径。

结论: MSAVBench是一个全面的基准测试和评估框架，有助于评估多镜头音频视频生成模型。

翻译: 视频生成正从单镜头合成迅速演变为复杂的多镜头音频视频叙事，以满足现实世界的需求。然而，评估此类前沿模型仍然是一个根本性的挑战。现有的基准测试在范围和数据多样性方面有限，并且依赖于僵化的评估管道，阻碍了对现代MSAV模型的系统性和可靠评估。为了弥合这些差距，作者介绍了MSAVBench，这是首个用于多镜头音频视频生成的全面基准测试和自适应混合评估框架。MSAVBench涵盖了四个关键维度：视频、音频、镜头和参考，涵盖了多样化的任务设置、多达15个镜头的变镜头数量以及具有挑战性的非现实场景。评估框架通过镜头分割的自适应自校正机制、主观指标的实例级标准以及复杂判断的工具引导证据提取来提高鲁棒性。此外，MSAVBench与人类判断高度一致，达到91.5%的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数。对19个最先进的封闭和开源模型的系统评估显示，当前系统在导演级控制和细粒度音频视觉同步方面仍然困难，而模块化或代理生成管道为缩小开源和封闭源模型之间的差距提供了有前景的路径。作者将发布基准测试数据和评估代码，以促进未来的研究。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决多镜头音频视频生成中评估不够全面和可靠的问题。这个问题很重要，因为只有通过全面可靠的评估，才能准确衡量生成模型的效果，推动该领域的发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 文中未明确说明该论文的关键创新点及与之前工作的不同之处。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了 MSAVBench 基准，旨在对多镜头音频-视频生成模型进行全面且可靠的评估。

Abstract

Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot synthesis to complex multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) narratives to meet real-world demands. However, evaluating such frontier models remains a fundamental challenge. Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and data diversity, and rely on rigid evaluation pipelines, preventing systematic and reliable assessment of modern MSAV models. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MSAVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark and adaptive hybrid evaluation framework for multi-shot audio-video generation. Our benchmark spans four key dimensions, video, audio, shot, and reference, covering diverse task settings, varying shot counts of up to 15, and challenging non-realistic scenarios. Our evaluation framework improves robustness through an adaptive self-correction mechanism for shot segmentation, instance-wise rubrics for subjective metrics, and tool-grounded evidence extraction for complex judgments. Furthermore, MSAVBench achieves high alignment with human judgments, reaching a Spearman rank correlation of 91.5%. Our systematic evaluation of 19 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models shows that current systems still struggle with director-level control and fine-grained audio-visual synchronization, while modular or agentic generation pipelines offer a promising path toward narrowing the gap between open- and closed-source models. We will release the benchmark data and evaluation code to facilitate future research.

item.title: Learning Subspace-Preserving Sparse Attention Graphs from Heterogeneous Multiview Data
item.author: Jie Chen, Yuanbiao Gou, Chuanbin Liu, Zhu Wang, Xi Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 论文提出了一种稀疏注意力图学习方法，用于从异构多视图数据中学习保持内在子空间结构的稀疏注意力图。该方法通过双线性注意力分解方案捕捉高维特征之间的非对称相似性，利用动态稀疏门控机制预测特征特定的压缩因子以自适应控制邻居的拓扑贡献，并通过结构化稀疏投影生成保持子空间的稀疏注意力图。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上持续优于最先进的无监督迁移学习方法。

background: 从大规模无标记数据中通过各种预训练模型提取的高维特征被称为异构多视图数据。大多数现有的无监督迁移学习方法在利用多视图间的互补信息时，无法忠实地恢复内在子空间结构。

purpose: 构建能够保持内在子空间结构的稀疏相似图，以实现异构视图间的语义对齐。

method: 提出稀疏注意力图学习方法（SAGL）。具体包括：1. 引入双线性注意力分解方案捕捉高维特征间的非对称相似性；2. 利用动态稀疏门控机制预测特征特定的压缩因子以自适应控制邻居的拓扑贡献；3. 采用结构化稀疏投影生成保持子空间的稀疏注意力图。

main_findings: SAGL方法在多个基准数据集上持续优于最先进的无监督迁移学习方法。

conclusion: SAGL方法能够有效地从异构多视图数据中学习保持内在子空间结构的稀疏注意力图，从而获得判别性表示。

translation: The high-dimensional features extracted from large-scale unlabeled data via various pretrained models with diverse architectures are referred to as heterogeneous multiview data. Most existing unsupervised transfer learning methods fail to faithfully recover intrinsic subspace structures when exploiting complementary information across multiple views. Therefore, a fundamental challenge involves constructing sparse similarity graphs that preserve these underlying subspace structures for achieving semantic alignment across heterogeneous views. In this paper, we propose a sparse attention graph learning (SAGL) method that learns subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs from heterogeneous multiview data. Specifically, we introduce a bilinear attention factorization scheme to capture asymmetric similarities among the high-dimensional features, which breaks the symmetry bottleneck that is inherent in the traditional representation learning techniques. A dynamic sparsity gating mechanism then predicts a feature-specific compression factor for adaptively controlling the topological contributions of neighbors. Furthermore, we employ a structured sparse projection via α-entmax to generate subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs for individual views. SAGL leverages these view-specific graphs to conduct sparse information aggregation, yielding discriminative representations for multiview learning tasks. In addition, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis that bridges differentiable sparse attention and probability simplex constraints. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that SAGL consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art unsupervised transfer learning approaches.

Abstract

The high-dimensional features extracted from large-scale unlabeled data via various pretrained models with diverse architectures are referred to as heterogeneous multiview data. Most existing unsupervised transfer learning methods fail to faithfully recover intrinsic subspace structures when exploiting complementary information across multiple views. Therefore, a fundamental challenge involves constructing sparse similarity graphs that preserve these underlying subspace structures for achieving semantic alignment across heterogeneous views. In this paper, we propose a sparse attention graph learning (SAGL) method that learns subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs from heterogeneous multiview data. Specifically, we introduce a bilinear attention factorization scheme to capture asymmetric similarities among the high-dimensional features, which breaks the symmetry bottleneck that is inherent in the traditional representation learning techniques. A dynamic sparsity gating mechanism then predicts a feature-specific compression factor for adaptively controlling the topological contributions of neighbors. Furthermore, we employ a structured sparse projection via $α$-entmax to generate subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs for individual views. SAGL leverages these view-specific graphs to conduct sparse information aggregation, yielding discriminative representations for multiview learning tasks. In addition, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis that bridges differentiable sparse attention and probability simplex constraints. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that SAGL consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art unsupervised transfer learning approaches.

item.title: Targeted Neuron Modulation via Contrastive Pair Search
item.author: Herring, Sam, Naviasky, Jake, Malhotra, Karan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究对比了指令微调模型在有害请求拒绝行为上的机制，提出了一种新的神经元归因方法，并验证了其在模型引导中的有效性。

背景: 现有的模型引导方法在强干预下会导致输出连贯性下降，限制了其实际应用，且对模型拒绝有害请求的底层机制理解不足。

目的: 引入对比神经元归因方法，旨在识别区分有害与良性提示的神经元，以实现无需梯度或辅助训练的模型引导。

方法: 采用对比神经元归因技术，通过仅进行前向传播来识别区分有害和良性提示的神经元，并在多种架构和参数规模的模型上进行验证。

主要发现: 在指令微调模型中，消除识别出的神经元电路可显著降低拒绝率，同时保持流畅性和非退化性；基础模型中存在类似的晚期层区分结构，但引导这些神经元仅导致内容变化而非行为改变。

结论: 神经元级干预能够在不牺牲质量的前提下实现可靠的模型行为引导，表明对齐微调将预存在的区分结构转化为稀疏且可靶向的拒绝门。

翻译: 语言模型经过指令微调以拒绝有害请求，但这一行为的底层机制仍知之甚少。流行的引导方法作用于残差流，在高干预强度下会降低输出连贯性，限制了其实际使用。我们引入了对比神经元归因，识别出区分有害与良性提示的 MLP 神经元，仅需前向传播且无需梯度或辅助训练。在指令模型中，消除发现的电路在标准越狱基准测试上使拒绝率降低了 50% 以上，同时保持所有引导强度下的流畅性和非退化性。将 CNA 应用于 Llama 和 Qwen 架构（从 1B 到 72B 参数）的匹配基础和指令模型，我们发现基础模型包含类似的晚期层区分结构，但引导这些神经元仅产生内容变化，而非行为变化。这些结果表明，神经元级干预能够在不牺牲质量的前提下实现可靠的模型行为引导。更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，对齐微调将预存在的区分结构转化为稀疏且可靶向的拒绝门。

Abstract

Language models are instruction-tuned to refuse harmful requests, but the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. Popular steering methods operate on the residual stream and degrade output coherence at high intervention strengths, limiting their practical use. We introduce contrastive neuron attribution (CNA), which identifies the 0.1% of MLP neurons whose activations most distinguish harmful from benign prompts, requiring only forward passes with no gradients or auxiliary training. In instruct models, ablating the discovered circuit reduces refusal rates by over 50% on a standard jailbreak benchmark while preserving fluency and non-degeneracy across all steering strengths. Applying CNA to matched base and instruct models across Llama and Qwen architectures (from 1B to 72B parameters), we find that base models contain similar late-layer discrimination structures but steering these neurons produces only content shifts, not behavioral change. These results demonstrate that neuron-level intervention enables reliable behavioral steering without the quality tradeoffs of residual-stream methods. More broadly, our findings suggest that alignment fine-tuning transforms pre-existing discrimination structure into a sparse, targetable refusal gate.

item.title: A$_3$B$_2$: Adaptive Asymmetric Adapter for Alleviating Branch Bias in Vision-Language Image Classification with Few-Shot Learning
item.author: Yiyun Zhou, Zhonghua Jiang, Wenkang Han, Kunxi Li, Mingjing Xu, Chang Yao, Jingyuan Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自适应非对称适配器方法，用于解决视觉语言图像分类中的分支偏差问题，在少样本学习任务中显著提升了性能。

背景: 现有的迁移学习方法通常假设图像分支和文本分支的重要性是均匀的，但在图像分类中，这种假设并未经过系统研究。

目的: 为了解决视觉语言图像分类中的分支偏差问题，提出一种自适应非对称适配器。

方法: A3B2方法引入了不确定性感知适配器阻尼，自动抑制图像分支的适配，并采用轻量级非对称设计， inspired by mixture-of-experts with Load Balancing Regularization。

主要发现: 在11个数据集的三个少样本图像分类任务上，A3B2 consistently outperforms 11 competitive prompt- and adapter-based baselines。

结论: A3B2能够有效缓解分支偏差，在少样本学习任务中表现出色。

翻译: Efficient transfer learning methods for large-scale vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) enable strong few-shot transfer, yet existing adaptation methods follow a fixed fine-tuning paradigm that implicitly assumes a uniform importance of the image and text branches, which has not been systematically studied in image classification. Through extensive analysis, we reveal a Branch Bias issue in vision-language image classification: adapting the image encoder does not always improve performance under out-of-distribution settings. Motivated by this observation, we propose A3B2, an Adaptive Asymmetric Adapter that alleviates Branch Bias in few-shot learning. A3B2 introduces Uncertainty-Aware Adapter Dampening (UAAD), which automatically suppresses image-branch adaptation when prediction uncertainty is high, enabling soft and data-driven control without manual intervention. Architecturally, A3B2 adopts a lightweight asymmetric design inspired by mixture-of-experts with Load Balancing Regularization. Extensive experiments on three few-shot image classification tasks across 11 datasets demonstrate that A3B2 consistently outperforms 11 competitive prompt- and adapter-based baselines.

Abstract

Efficient transfer learning methods for large-scale vision-language models ($e.g.$, CLIP) enable strong few-shot transfer, yet existing adaptation methods follow a fixed fine-tuning paradigm that implicitly assumes a uniform importance of the image and text branches, which has not been systematically studied in image classification. Through extensive analysis, we reveal a Branch Bias issue in vision-language image classification: adapting the image encoder does not always improve performance under out-of-distribution settings. Motivated by this observation, we propose A$_3$B$_2$, an Adaptive Asymmetric Adapter that alleviates Branch Bias in few-shot learning. A$_3$B$_2$ introduces Uncertainty-Aware Adapter Dampening (UAAD), which automatically suppresses image-branch adaptation when prediction uncertainty is high, enabling soft and data-driven control without manual intervention. Architecturally, A$_3$B$_2$ adopts a lightweight asymmetric design inspired by mixture-of-experts with Load Balancing Regularization. Extensive experiments on three few-shot image classification tasks across 11 datasets demonstrate that A$_3$B$_2$ consistently outperforms 11 competitive prompt- and adapter-based baselines.

item.title: KIT-TIP-NLP at MultiPride: Continual Learning with Multilingual Foundation Model
item.author: Barathi Ganesh HB, Michal Ptaszynski, Rene Melendez, Juuso Eronen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出了一种多阶段框架，用于检测多语言社交媒体话语中重新使用的贬义词。

背景: 该研究旨在解决在英语、西班牙语和意大利语推文中识别LGBTQ+相关贬义词的重新使用与非重新使用使用之间的挑战。

目的: 该研究旨在处理数据稀缺、类别不平衡和情感表达跨语言变化这三个相互交织的方法论挑战。

方法: 该框架集成了通过交叉验证进行的数据驱动模型选择、通过回译进行的语义保持增强、带有动态轮次级下采样的归纳迁移学习，以及通过掩码语言建模进行的领域特定知识注入。

主要发现: XLM-RoBERTa被选为基础模型。通过GPT-4o-mini回译进行的数据增强有效地将训练语料库增加了三倍，同时保持了语义内容和类别分布比例。语言特定阈值优化显示，最佳决策边界在不同语言之间存在显著差异。基于阈值的优化在不重新训练模型的情况下产生了2-5%的绝对F1提升。

结论: 该方法是完全可复现的，所有代码和实验设置均可在https://github.com/rbg-research/MultiPRIDE-Evalita-2026获取。

翻译: 该论文提出了一种多阶段框架，用于检测多语言社交媒体话语中重新使用的贬义词。它解决了在英语、西班牙语和意大利语推文中识别LGBTQ+相关贬义词的重新使用与非重新使用使用之间的挑战。该框架处理了数据稀缺、类别不平衡和情感表达跨语言变化这三个相互交织的方法论挑战。它集成了通过交叉验证进行的数据驱动模型选择、通过回译进行的语义保持增强、带有动态轮次级下采样的归纳迁移学习，以及通过掩码语言建模进行的领域特定知识注入。评估了八个多语言嵌入模型，XLM-RoBERTa基于宏平均F1分数被选为基础模型。通过GPT-4o-mini回译进行的数据增强有效地将训练语料库增加了三倍，同时保持了语义内容和类别分布比例。该框架产生了四个最终运行用于评估目的，其中运行1是带有增强和下采样的归纳迁移学习，运行2带有掩码语言建模预训练，运行3和运行4是通过通过ROC分析优化的语言特定决策阈值优化的先前预测。语言特定阈值优化显示，最佳决策边界在不同语言之间存在显著差异。这反映了模型置信度分数的分布差异和重新使用语言使用的语言变化。基于阈值的优化在不重新训练模型的情况下产生了2-5%的绝对F1提升。该方法是完全可复现的，所有代码和实验设置均可在https://github.com/rbg-research/MultiPRIDE-Evalita-2026获取。

Abstract

This paper presents a multi-stage framework for detecting reclaimed slurs in multilingual social media discourse. It addresses the challenge of identifying reclamatory versus non-reclamatory usage of LGBTQ+-related slurs across English, Spanish, and Italian tweets. The framework handles three intertwined methodological challenges like data scarcity, class imbalance, and cross-linguistic variation in sentiment expression. It integrates data-driven model selection via cross-validation, semantic-preserving augmentation through back-translation, inductive transfer learning with dynamic epoch-level undersampling, and domain-specific knowledge injection via masked language modeling. Eight multilingual embedding models were evaluated systematically, with XLM-RoBERTa selected as the foundation model based on macro-averaged F1 score. Data augmentation via GPT-4o-mini back-translation to alternate languages effectively tripled the training corpus while preserving semantic content and class distribution ratios. The framework produces four final runs for the evaluation purposes where RUN 1 is inductive transfer learning with augmentation and undersampling, RUN 2 with masked language modeling pre-training, RUN 3 and RUN 4 are previous predictions refined via language-specific decision thresholds optimized via ROC analysis. Language-specific threshold refinement reveals that optimal decision boundaries vary significantly across languages. This reflects distributional differences in model confidence scores and linguistic variation in reclamatory language usage. The threshold-based optimization yields 2-5% absolute F1 improvement without requiring model retraining. The methodology is fully reproducible, with all code and experimental setup available at https://github.com/rbg-research/MultiPRIDE-Evalita-2026.

item.title: Model-Adaptive Tool Necessity Reveals the Knowing-Doing Gap in LLM Tool Use
item.author: Cheng, Yize, Fan, Chenrui, JafariRaviz, Mahdi, Rezaei, Keivan, Feizi, Soheil
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型在自主代理中如何决定何时直接回答还是调用外部工具，并分析了模型在工具使用上的认知与行动之间的差距。

背景: 现有研究主要将工具必要性视为模型无关的属性，由人类或LLM标注，且多涵盖答案显而易见的简单情况。然而，实际场景中工具必要性因模型能力差异而更为复杂，一个强模型能独立解决的问题对弱模型可能仍需工具。

目的: 引入基于模型实证性能的模型自适应工具必要性定义，并比较该定义与观察到的工具调用行为之间的差异。

方法: 在算术和事实问答数据集上对比四种模型的工具必要性定义与实际工具调用行为；将工具使用分解为内部认知阶段和执行阶段；通过探测LLM隐藏状态分析信号可解码性及方向；追踪样本在两阶段过程中的轨迹。

主要发现: 工具必要性定义与实际工具调用行为存在显著不匹配，算术数据集不匹配率为26.5-54.0%，事实问答数据集为30.8-41.8%；两阶段信号在深层、末尾token阶段方向几乎正交；大多数不匹配集中在认知到行动的过渡阶段，而非认知本身。

结论: LLM在工具使用上存在认知与行动的差距，提高工具使用可靠性不仅需要更好地识别何时需要工具，还需要更好地将这种识别转化为行动。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents that must decide when to answer directly vs. when to invoke external tools. Prior work studying adaptive tool use has largely treated tool necessity as a model-agnostic property, annotated by human or LLM judge, and mostly cover cases where the answer is obvious (e.g., fetching the weather vs. paraphrasing text). However, tool necessity in the wild is more nuanced due to the divergence of capability boundaries across models: a problem solvable by a strong model on its own may still require tools for a weaker one. In this work, we introduce a model-adaptive definition of tool-necessity, grounded in each model's empirical performance. Following this definition, we compare the necessity against observed tool-call behavior across four models on arithmetic and factual QA dataset, and find substantial mismatches of 26.5-54.0% and 30.8-41.8%, respectively. To diagnose the failure, we decompose tool use into two stages: an internal cognition stage that reflects whether a model believes a tool is necessary, and an execution stage that determines whether the model actually makes a tool-call action. By probing the LLM hidden states, we find that both signals are often linearly decodable, yet their probe directions become nearly orthogonal in the late-layer, last-token regime that drives the next-token action. By tracing the trajectory of samples in the two-stage process, we further discover that the majority of mismatch is concentrated in the cognition-to-action transition, not in cognition itself. These results reveal a knowing-doing gap in LLM tool-use: improving tool-use reliability requires not only better recognition of when tools are needed, but also better translation of that recognition into action.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决大语言模型在工具使用中存在的“知行差距”问题，即模型虽然知道该用什么工具，却无法有效调用工具来完成任务。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为它揭示了当前模型在实际应用中的局限性，有助于推动模型向更灵活、更实用的方向发展。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents that must decide when to answer directly vs. when to invoke external tools. Prior work studying adaptive tool use has largely treated tool necessity as a model-agnostic property, annotated by human or LLM judge, and mostly cover cases where the answer is obvious (e.g., fetching the weather vs. paraphrasing text). However, tool necessity in the wild is more nuanced due to the divergence of capability boundaries across models: a problem solvable by a strong model on its own may still require tools for a weaker one. In this work, we introduce a model-adaptive definition of tool-necessity, grounded in each model's empirical performance. Following this definition, we compare the necessity against observed tool-call behavior across four models on arithmetic and factual QA dataset, and find substantial mismatches of 26.5-54.0% and 30.8-41.8%, respectively. To diagnose the failure, we decompose tool use into two stages: an internal cognition stage that reflects whether a model believes a tool is necessary, and an execution stage that determines whether the model actually makes a tool-call action. By probing the LLM hidden states, we find that both signals are often linearly decodable, yet their probe directions become nearly orthogonal in the late-layer, last-token regime that drives the next-token action. By tracing the trajectory of samples in the two-stage process, we further discover that the majority of mismatch is concentrated in the cognition-to-action transition, not in cognition itself. These results reveal a knowing-doing gap in LLM tool-use: improving tool-use reliability requires not only better recognition of when tools are needed, but also better translation of that recognition into action.

item.title: KVPO: ODE-Native GRPO for Autoregressive Video Alignment via KV Semantic Exploration
item.author: Zhang, Ruicheng, Cong, Kaixi, Zhou, Jun, Zhong, Zhizhou, Xu, Zunnan, Mao, Shuiyang, Liu, Wei, Li, Xiu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为KVPO的框架，用于对齐流式自回归视频生成器与人类偏好。

背景: 现有的强化学习方法主要依赖基于噪声的探索和基于SDE的代理策略，这些方法与蒸馏AR模型的确定性ODE动力学不匹配，且倾向于扰动低级外观而非对长时序连贯性至关重要的高级语义故事线进展。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在探索和策略建模方面的局限性，提出了一种ODE原生的在线组相对策略优化（GRPO）框架。

方法: 1. 引入因果语义探索范式，将变化源从随机噪声转移到历史KV缓存，通过随机路由历史KV条目构建语义多样化的生成分支；2. 引入基于轨迹速度能量（TVE）的速度场代理策略，量化分支在流匹配速度空间中的似然性，并产生与原生ODE公式完全一致的奖励加权对比目标。

主要发现: 在多个蒸馏AR视频生成器上的实验表明，KVPO在单提示词短视频和多提示词长视频设置下，均能持续提升视觉质量、运动质量和文本视频对齐度。

结论: KVPO框架能够有效对齐流式视频生成器与人类偏好，在保持语义连贯性的同时提高了生成质量。

翻译: Aligning streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators with human preferences is challenging. Existing reinforcement learning methods predominantly rely on noise-based exploration and SDE-based surrogate policies that are mismatched to the deterministic ODE dynamics of distilled AR models, and tend to perturb low-level appearance rather than the high-level semantic storyline progression critical for long-horizon coherence. To address these limitations, we present KVPO, an ODE-native online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework for aligning streaming video generators. For diversity exploration, KVPO introduces a causal-semantic exploration paradigm that relocates the source of variation from stochastic noise to the historical KV cache. By stochastically routing historical KV entries, it constructs semantically diverse generation branches that remain strictly on the data manifold. For policy modeling, KVPO introduces a velocity-field surrogate policy based on Trajectory Velocity Energy (TVE), which quantifies branch likelihood in flow-matching velocity space and yields a reward-weighted contrastive objective fully consistent with the native ODE formulation. Experiments on multiple distilled AR video generators demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, motion quality, and text-video alignment across both single-prompt short-video and multi-prompt long-video settings.

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 KVPO 的方法，通过常微分方程原生的组相对策略优化和键值语义探索，实现了自回归视频对齐。

Abstract

Aligning streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators with human preferences is challenging. Existing reinforcement learning methods predominantly rely on noise-based exploration and SDE-based surrogate policies that are mismatched to the deterministic ODE dynamics of distilled AR models, and tend to perturb low-level appearance rather than the high-level semantic storyline progression critical for long-horizon coherence. To address these limitations, we present KVPO, an ODE-native online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework for aligning streaming video generators. For diversity exploration, KVPO introduces a causal-semantic exploration paradigm that relocates the source of variation from stochastic noise to the historical KV cache. By stochastically routing historical KV entries, it constructs semantically diverse generation branches that remain strictly on the data manifold. For policy modeling, KVPO introduces a velocity-field surrogate policy based on Trajectory Velocity Energy (TVE), which quantifies branch likelihood in flow-matching velocity space and yields a reward-weighted contrastive objective fully consistent with the native ODE formulation. Experiments on multiple distilled AR video generators demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, motion quality, and text-video alignment across both single-prompt short-video and multi-prompt long-video settings.

item.title: Where Should Diffusion Enter a Language Model? Geometry-Guided Hidden-State Replacement
item.author: Kong, Injin, Lee, Hyoungjoon, Jo, Yohan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DiHAL是一种几何引导的扩散-Transformer混合模型，通过在预训练Transformer中选择合适的层进行扩散介入，以解决连续扩散语言模型在语言去噪和标记恢复方面的不足。

背景: 连续扩散语言模型落后于自回归Transformer，部分原因是扩散被应用于不适合语言去噪和标记恢复的空间。

目的: 提出DiHAL，一种几何引导的扩散-Transformer混合模型，旨在确定扩散应在预训练Transformer的何处介入。

方法: DiHAL通过基于几何的代理对层进行评分，选择一个扩散友好的隐藏状态接口，并用扩散桥替换较低的Transformer前缀，同时保留上层层和原始语言模型头。通过重建所选层的隐藏状态而不是标记，避免了直接从连续到离散的恢复。

主要发现: 在8B规模的骨干网络上，几何分数在固定的桥训练协议下预测了有效的浅层插入层；在匹配扩散/恢复训练预算的诊断比较中，隐藏状态恢复优于连续扩散基线。

结论: 隐藏状态几何有助于识别预训练语言模型内部基于扩散的替换是可行的位置。

翻译: 摘要：连续扩散语言模型落后于自回归Transformer，部分原因是扩散被应用于不适合语言去噪和标记恢复的空间。我们提出了DiHAL，一种几何引导的扩散-Transformer混合模型，询问扩散应在预训练Transformer的何处介入。DiHAL通过基于几何的代理对层进行评分，选择一个扩散友好的隐藏状态接口，并用扩散桥替换较低的Transformer前缀，同时保留上层层和原始语言模型头。通过重建所选层的隐藏状态而不是标记，DiHAL避免了直接从连续到离散的恢复。在8B规模的骨干网络上进行的实验表明，几何分数在固定的桥训练协议下预测了有效的浅层插入层，并且在匹配扩散/恢复训练预算的诊断比较中，隐藏状态恢复优于连续扩散基线。这些结果表明，隐藏状态几何有助于识别预训练语言模型内部基于扩散的替换是可行的位置。

Abstract

Continuous diffusion language models lag behind autoregressive transformers, partly because diffusion is applied in spaces poorly suited to language denoising and token recovery. We propose DiHAL, a geometry-guided diffusion-transformer hybrid that asks where diffusion should enter a pretrained transformer. DiHAL scores layers with geometry-based proxies, selects a diffusion-friendly hidden-state interface, and replaces the lower transformer prefix with a diffusion bridge while retaining the upper layers and original LM head. By reconstructing the selected-layer hidden state rather than tokens, DiHAL avoids direct continuous-to-discrete recovery. Experiments on 8B-scale backbones show that the geometry score predicts effective shallow insertion layers under a fixed bridge-training protocol and that hidden-state recovery improves over continuous diffusion baselines in a diagnostic comparison matching the diffusion/recovery training budget. These results suggest that hidden-state geometry helps identify where diffusion-based replacement is feasible inside pretrained language models.

item.title: EndPrompt: Efficient Long-Context Extension via Terminal Anchoring
item.author: Tian, Han, Chen, Luxuan, Chen, Xinran, Kong, Rui, Wang, Fang, Chen, Jiamin, Zhao, Jinman, Li, Yuchen, Zhao, Jiashu, Wang, Shuaiqiang, Xiong, Haoyi, Yin, Dawei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EndPrompt是一种通过仅使用短训练序列实现有效上下文扩展的方法，通过将原始短上下文作为完整的第一段并附加简短的终端提示作为第二段来引入局部和长程相对距离，从而在保持训练文本语义连续性的同时挑战了密集长序列训练是可靠上下文窗口扩展所必需的普遍假设。

背景: 扩展大型语言模型的上下文窗口通常需要在目标长度上进行序列训练，这会产生二次方级别的内存和计算成本，使得长上下文适应变得昂贵且难以复现。

目的: 提出EndPrompt方法，旨在仅使用短训练序列实现有效的上下文扩展，以降低长上下文适应的成本和难度。

方法: EndPrompt方法的核心见解是，通过将原始短上下文作为完整的第一段并附加简短的终端提示作为第二段，分配其位置索引接近目标上下文长度，从而在短物理序列中引入局部和长程相对距离，同时保持训练文本的语义连续性。

主要发现: EndPrompt在将LLaMA家族模型的上下文窗口从8K扩展到64K时，平均RULER得分达到76.03，在LongBench上得分最高，超过了LCEG、LongLoRA和全长度微调，同时需要更少的计算量。

结论: 长上下文泛化可以从稀疏的位置监督中诱导出来，挑战了密集长序列训练是可靠上下文窗口扩展所必需的普遍假设。

翻译: 扩展大型语言模型的上下文窗口通常需要在目标长度上进行序列训练，这会产生二次方级别的内存和计算成本，使得长上下文适应变得昂贵且难以复现。我们提出EndPrompt，一种仅使用短训练序列实现有效上下文扩展的方法。核心见解是，通过将原始短上下文作为完整的第一段并附加简短的终端提示作为第二段，分配其位置索引接近目标上下文长度，从而在短物理序列中引入局部和长程相对距离，同时保持训练文本的语义连续性——这是基于块的模拟方法所不具备的属性。我们提供了基于旋转位置嵌入和伯恩斯坦不等式的理论分析，表明位置插值对注意力函数施加了严格的平滑约束，共享的Transformer参数进一步抑制了向未观察到的中间距离的不稳定外推。应用于将LLaMA家族模型的上下文窗口从8K扩展到64K，EndPrompt实现了平均76.03的RULER得分和LongBench上的最高平均得分，超过了LCEG、LongLoRA和全长度微调，同时需要更少的计算量。这些结果表明，长上下文泛化可以从稀疏的位置监督中诱导出来，挑战了密集长序列训练是可靠上下文窗口扩展所必需的普遍假设。代码可在该https URL处获得。

Abstract

Extending the context window of large language models typically requires training on sequences at the target length, incurring quadratic memory and computational costs that make long-context adaptation expensive and difficult to reproduce. We propose EndPrompt, a method that achieves effective context extension using only short training sequences. The core insight is that exposing a model to long-range relative positional distances does not require constructing full-length inputs: we preserve the original short context as an intact first segment and append a brief terminal prompt as a second segment, assigning it positional indices near the target context length. This two-segment construction introduces both local and long-range relative distances within a short physical sequence while maintaining the semantic continuity of the training text--a property absent in chunk-based simulation approaches that split contiguous context. We provide a theoretical analysis grounded in Rotary Position Embedding and the Bernstein inequality, showing that position interpolation induces a rigorous smoothness constraint over the attention function, with shared Transformer parameters further suppressing unstable extrapolation to unobserved intermediate distances. Applied to LLaMA-family models extending the context window from 8K to 64K, EndPrompt achieves an average RULER score of 76.03 and the highest average on LongBench, surpassing LCEG (72.24), LongLoRA (72.95), and full-length fine-tuning (69.23) while requiring substantially less computation. These results demonstrate that long-context generalization can be induced from sparse positional supervision, challenging the prevailing assumption that dense long-sequence training is necessary for reliable context-window extension. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: OffsetAxis: UDF Mesh Reconstruction via Offset-Volume Medial Axis Extraction
item.author: Qijia Huang, Pierre Kraemer, Dominique Bechmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为OffsetAxis的新方法，用于从无符号距离场中重建具有开放边界、非流形结构和曲线状几何体的网格。

背景: 无符号距离场比有符号距离场具有更广泛的建模能力，能够表示具有开放边界、非流形结构或混合曲线和表面部分的形状。然而，从无符号距离场中提取连贯的网格比从有符号距离场中更困难，因为基于网格的等值面提取技术不适用，因为它们需要一种方法来区分形状的内部和外部。

目的: 介绍OffsetAxis，一种支持开放、非流形和曲线状几何体的无符号距离场重建流水线。

方法: 将0水平集提取问题重新表述为提取无符号距离场的α偏移体积的骨架轴。利用成熟的骨架轴机制来支持边界、非流形连接点和曲线。使用光线投射对α偏移表面进行采样，并在偏移体积内优化变分骨架轴采样的高效变体。通过取骨架球簇的连通性的对偶来恢复最终网格。

主要发现: 该方法能够处理不完美的距离场，包括在噪声输入上训练的神经无符号距离场、准骨架距离场（Q-MDF）以及直接在三角形汤或点云上计算的距离。实验表明，该方法比先前技术产生更忠实的网格重建，并与底层形状结构更好地对齐。

结论: OffsetAxis方法在处理不完美距离场方面表现出鲁棒性和多功能性，能够生成结构连贯的重建网格。

翻译: 无符号距离场（UDFs）比有符号距离场（SDFs）提供更广泛的建模能力，能够表示具有开放边界、非流形结构或混合曲线和表面部分的形状。然而，从UDFs中提取连贯的网格从根本上更困难，因为基于网格的等值面提取技术不适用，因为它们需要一种方法来区分形状的内部和外部。我们介绍了OffsetAxis，一种支持开放、非流形和曲线状几何体的UDF重建流水线。我们的关键见解是将0水平集提取问题重新表述为提取UDF的α偏移体积的骨架轴。这种表述解锁了成熟的骨架轴机制，自然支持边界、非流形连接点和曲线。为了避免基于网格技术的偏差，我们使用光线投射对α偏移表面进行采样，并在偏移体积内优化变分骨架轴采样的高效变体。最终网格通过取骨架球簇的连通性的对偶来恢复，为广泛的拓扑结构产生结构连贯的重建。该方法的鲁棒性和多功能性使其能够处理不完美的距离场，包括在噪声输入上训练的神经UDF、准骨架距离场（Q-MDF）以及直接在三角形汤或点云上计算的距离。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法比先前技术产生更忠实的网格重建，并与底层形状结构更好地对齐。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决隐式距离场网格重建的问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要：unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种名为 OffsetAxis 的方法，通过提取偏移体积中心轴来进行基于隐式距离场的网格重建。

Abstract

Unsigned distance fields (UDFs) offer broader modeling capabilities than signed distance fields (SDFs), enabling the representation of shapes with open boundaries, non-manifold structures or mixed curve and surface parts. However, extracting coherent meshes from UDFs is fundamentally harder, as classical grid-based iso-surfacing techniques are not applicable since they require a way to distinguish the inside from the outside of the shape. We introduce OffsetAxis, a new UDF reconstruction pipeline that supports open, non-manifold, and curve-like geometries. Our key insight is that the 0-level set extraction problem can be restated as the extraction of the medial axis of the $α$-offset volume of the UDF. This formulation unlocks mature medial-axis machinery that naturally supports boundaries, non-manifold junctions and curves. To avoid the biases of grid-based techniques, we sample the $α$-offset surface using ray casting and optimize medial balls inside the offset volume with an efficient variant of Variational Medial Axis Sampling. The final mesh is recovered by taking the dual of the connectivity of the medial ball clusters, producing structurally coherent reconstructions for a wide range of topologies. The robustness and versatility of the approach allow it to handle imperfect distance fields, including neural UDFs trained on noisy inputs, the Quasi-Medial Distance Field (Q-MDF), as well as distances computed directly on triangle soups or point clouds. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces more faithful mesh reconstruction and better alignment with the underlying shape structure than prior techniques.

item.title: A Unified Non-Parametric and Interpretable Point Cloud Analysis via t-FCW Graph Representation
item.author: Haijian Lai, Bowen Liu, Man Xu, Chan-Tong Lam, João Macedo, Benjamin Ng, Sio-Kei Im
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种增强型转置全连接加权t-FCW图表示，用于将点云嵌入度量空间。

背景: 原始t-FCW在点云分类中显示出有前景的结果，但其有效性的原因和更广泛的应用性尚不清楚。

目的: 分析使增强型和原始t-FCW有效的属性，设计一个仅使用增强型t-FCW作为特征提取器的网络。

方法: 构建用于分类、部分分割和语义分割的内存库；分析增强型t-FCW从表面描述符继承的鲁棒性以及通过维度间关系提供的可解释性。

主要发现: 增强型t-FCW具有鲁棒性和可解释性，能够实现高效且可解释的网络，在NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU上处理ModelNet40分类问题约需7秒；它既可作为轻量级独立基线，也可作为现有深度模型的互补插件。

结论: 增强型t-FCW具有鲁棒性和可解释性，能够实现高效且可解释的网络，处理ModelNet40分类问题约需7秒；它既可作为轻量级独立基线，也可作为现有深度模型的互补插件。

翻译: 本文介绍了一种增强型转置全连接加权t-FCW图表示，用于将点云嵌入度量空间。原始t-FCW在点云分类中显示出有前景的结果，但其有效性的原因和更广泛的应用性尚不清楚。本文分析了使增强型和原始t-FCW有效的属性，并设计了一个仅使用增强型t-FCW作为特征提取器的网络。从可解释性的角度来看，我们使用增强型t-FCW构建了用于分类、部分分割和语义分割的内存库。分析显示，增强型t-FCW从表面描述符继承了鲁棒性，并通过维度间关系提供了可解释性。这些属性使得一个高度高效且可解释的网络成为可能，该网络在NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU上处理ModelNet40分类问题大约需要7秒。重要的是，增强型t-FCW既可作为轻量级独立基线，也可作为现有深度模型的互补插件。

Abstract

We introduce an empowered transposed Fully Connected Weighted (t-FCW) graph representation to embed point clouds into a metric space. While original t-FCW has shown promising results for point cloud classification, the reasons behind its effectiveness and its broader applicability remained unclear. In this work, we analyze the properties that make the empowered and original t-FCW effective and design a network that uses the empowered t-FCW exclusively as feature extractors. From an interpretability perspective, we build memory banks for classification, part segmentation, and semantic segmentation using the empowered t-FCW. Our analysis reveals that the empowered t-FCW inherits robustness from surface descriptors, provides interpretability through dimension-wise relations. These properties enable a highly efficient and interpretable network, which processes the ModelNet40 classification problem in approximately 7 seconds on an NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU. Importantly, empowered t-FCW can function both as a lightweight standalone baseline and as a complementary plug-in to existing deep models.

item.title: FINESSE-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark Suite for Financial Domain Knowledge and Technical Analysis in Large Language Models
item.author: Stanishevskii, Dmitry, Kamkia, Nini, Khoroshilov, Alexey, Zmitrovich, Dmitry, Kokosinskii, Denis, Hayrapetyan, Zhirayr, Kalmykov, Andrei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FINESSE-Bench是一个包含3993个问题的专业金融能力评估基准测试套件，旨在对大语言模型进行分层评估。

背景: 大语言模型在金融分析、报告、投资决策支持、风险管理、合规和专业培训等领域的应用日益增多，但对其金融领域专业能力的稳健评估仍不完整。现有的金融问答基准测试如FinQA、ConvFinQA和TAT-QA主要关注金融报告问答，缺乏明确的专业难度层次；更广泛的资源如FinanceBench、PIXIU、FinBen和FLaME虽然扩展了金融任务覆盖面，但评估从基础知识到专家级金融推理的过渡问题仍未解决。

目的: 提出FINESSE-Bench，作为一个包含八个专业基准测试的套件，用于对大语言模型进行分层金融能力评估。

方法: FINESSE-Bench结合了受专业认证启发的考试导向数据集（如CFA一级至三级、CMT二级和CFTe一级）、应用交易任务集合以及俄语奥林匹克基准测试。该设计支持对领域广度、随难度增加的性能下降、解决计算任务的能力以及在专业金融领域的行为进行评估。此外，还描述了一个涵盖选择题、数值答案和简短开放式回答的统一评估协议，以及基于大语言模型作为评判者的自由形式答案自动评分方案。

主要发现: unknown

结论: FINESSE-Bench旨在作为现有开放金融基准测试的补充，并作为更实质性评估大语言模型专业相关金融能力的工具。

翻译: 大语言模型在金融分析、报告、投资决策支持、风险管理、合规和专业培训等领域的应用日益增多。然而，对其在金融领域的专业能力的稳健评估仍不完整。广泛使用的开放基准测试，如FinQA、ConvFinQA和TAT-QA，在推进金融问答和数值推理方面发挥了重要作用，但它们主要关注金融报告上的问答，并未提供明确的专业难度层次。更广泛的资源，包括FinanceBench、PIXIU、FinBen和FLaME，扩展了金融任务的覆盖范围，但评估从基础知识到专家级金融推理的过渡问题仍未解决。在这项工作中，我们提出了FINESSE-Bench，这是一个包含八个专业基准测试的套件，包含3993个问题，用于对大语言模型进行分层金融能力评估。FINESSE-Bench结合了受专业认证启发的考试导向数据集（如CFA一级至三级、CMT二级和CFTe一级）、应用交易任务集合以及俄语奥林匹克基准测试。这种设计能够评估领域广度、随难度增加的性能下降、解决计算任务的能力以及在专业金融领域的行为。我们还描述了一个涵盖选择题、数值答案和简短开放式回答的统一评估协议，以及基于大语言模型作为评判者的自由形式答案自动评分方案。FINESSE-Bench旨在作为现有开放金融基准测试的补充，并作为更实质性评估大语言模型专业相关金融能力的工具。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个名为 FINESSE-Bench 的分层基准测试套件，旨在评估大型语言模型在金融领域知识和技术分析方面的能力。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being applied to financial analysis, reporting, investment decision support, risk management, compliance, and professional training. However, robust evaluation of their domain competence in finance remains incomplete. Widely used open benchmarks such as FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA have played an important role in advancing financial question answering and numerical reasoning, but they focus primarily on question answering over financial reports and do not provide an explicit hierarchy of professional difficulty. Broader resources, including FinanceBench, PIXIU, FinBen, and FLaME, expand the coverage of financial tasks, yet the problem of evaluating the transition from foundational knowledge to expert-level financial reasoning remains open. In this work, we present FINESSE-Bench, a suite of eight specialized benchmarks comprising 3,993 questions for hierarchical evaluation of financial competencies in LLMs. FINESSE-Bench combines exam-oriented datasets inspired by professional certifications (CFA-like Levels 1-3, CMT-like Level 2, and CFTe-like Level 1), applied trading task collections, and a Russian-language olympiad benchmark. This design enables evaluation of domain breadth, performance degradation as difficulty increases, the ability to solve computational tasks, and model behavior in specialized financial domains. We also describe a unified evaluation protocol covering multiple-choice questions, numerical answers, and short open-ended responses, together with an automated scoring scheme for freeform answers based on the LLM-as-judge paradigm. FINESSE-Bench is intended both as a complement to existing open financial benchmarks and as a tool for more substantive evaluation of professionally relevant financial competencies in large language models.

item.title: Neural Point-Forms
item.author: Bruno Trentini, Jacob Hume, Vincenzo Antonio Isoldi, Philipp Misof, Ekaterina S. Ivshina, Kelly Maggs
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为神经点形式的新颖可学习几何特征，用于点云学习。

背景: 点云学习通常假设观测样本是高维特征空间中嵌入流形的噪声轨迹，但坐标、成对距离或学习图邻域往往无法直接捕捉这种几何结构。

目的: 为了在缺乏自然切向结构的情况下，构建一种紧凑、高效且置换不变的神经层，以学习形式比较矩阵。

方法: 利用扩散几何中的拉普拉斯技术，构建离散模型来比较点云上的微分形式。通过证明比较矩阵在标准采样、带宽、密度和流形假设下的长期一致性，实现了这一目标。

主要发现: 在合成和生物学相关实验中，神经点形式提供了具有竞争力的表示，且具有可解释性。当标签依赖于采样密度、流形结构或与响应相关的群体几何时，其优势最为明显。

结论: 神经点形式是一种有效的点云学习工具，能够捕捉高阶切向信息。

翻译: 点云学习通常建立在观测样本是高维特征空间中嵌入流形的噪声轨迹这一前提之上。然而，坐标、成对距离或学习图邻域往往无法直接捕捉这种几何结构。在光滑情况下，微分形式是编码高阶切向信息的工具。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一族名为神经点形式的新颖可学习几何特征。在没有自然切向结构的情况下，我们利用扩散几何中的拉普拉斯技术，通过内积构建离散模型来比较点云上的微分形式。在连续体中，共享环境特征空间的子流形被表示为比较矩阵，其条目描述了成对特征形式如何与外在切向信息相互作用。我们通过证明比较矩阵在标准采样、带宽、密度和流形假设下的长期一致性，使这一直觉精确化。这产生了一个紧凑、高效且置换不变的神经层，其输出是一个学习到的形式比较矩阵。在合成和生物学相关的实验中，我们表明神经点形式提供了具有竞争力的、可解释的表示，当标签依赖于采样密度、流形结构或与响应相关的群体几何时，其优势最为明显。

深度解读

Abstract

Point cloud learning often rests on the premise that observed samples are noisy traces of an underlying geometric object, such as a manifold embedded in a high-dimensional feature space. Yet much of this geometry is not captured directly by coordinates, pairwise distances, or learned graph neighborhoods alone. In the smooth setting, differential forms are devices to encode higher order tangency information. In this work, we introduce a new family of principled learnable geometric features for point clouds called neural point-forms (NPFs). In the absence of a natural tangency structure, we instead use Laplacian-based techniques from Diffusion Geometry to build a discrete model for comparing differential forms on point clouds via inner products. In the continuum, submanifolds of a shared ambient feature space are represented as comparison matrices, whose entries describe how pairs of feature forms interact with extrinsic tangency information. We make this intuition precise by proving the long-run consistency of comparison matrices under standard sampling, bandwidth, density, and manifold-hypothesis assumptions. This yields a compact, efficient and permutation-invariant neural layer whose output is a learned form-comparison matrix. Across synthetic and biologically relevant experiments, we show that NPFs provide a competitive, and interpretable representation, with the strongest benefits appearing when labels depend on sampling density, manifold-like structure, or response-relevant population geometry.

item.title: 3DTMDet: A Dual-Path Synergy Network of Transformer and SSM for 3D Object Detection in Point Clouds
item.author: Bingwen Qiu, Yuan Liu, Junqi Bai, Tong Jiang, Ben Liang, Fangzhou Chen, Xiubao Sui, Qian Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为3DTMDet的新型点云目标检测网络，该网络结合了状态空间模型和Transformer，旨在解决稀疏点云中局部几何细节丢失和远距离小目标检测困难的问题。

背景: 点云目标检测面临的主要挑战在于远距离点的极端稀疏性与远程上下文理解需求之间的冲突。现有方法通常使用一维序列化来扩大感受野，但这不可避免地会丢弃已经稀缺的局部几何细节，并降低对远距离和小目标的检测能力。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，3DTMDet旨在通过结合状态空间模型和Transformer，在有效捕获稀疏和远距离点之间的全局交互的同时，利用具有局部注意力的Transformer模块编码局部点集中的细粒度几何结构，从而在扩大感受野的同时保留准确的形状信息。

方法: 3DTMDet提出了3D混合Mamba Transformer（3DHMT）块，该块采用SSM-注意力-SSM管道来平衡全局上下文理解和局部细节保留。此外，还引入了一种受激光雷达物理原理启发的体素生成块，以沿传感器观测方向扩散特征，从而重建遮挡和远距离区域的完整物体结构。

主要发现: 在KITTI和ONCE数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，3DTMDet的性能优于最先进的检测器。

结论: 3DTMDet通过其创新的结构设计，有效缓解了远程检测中感受野扩大与几何保真度之间的矛盾，实现了更优的点云目标检测效果。

翻译: 点云目标检测中的一个基本挑战在于远距离点的极端稀疏性与远程上下文理解需求之间的冲突。现有方法通常使用一维序列化来扩大感受野，这不可避免地会丢弃已经稀缺的局部几何细节，并降低对远距离和小目标的检测能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了3DTMDet，一种新颖的检测网络，它协同结合了状态空间模型和Transformer。核心思想是利用SSM的线性复杂度和长序列建模优势来有效捕获稀疏和远距离点之间的全局交互，同时使用具有局部注意力的Transformer模块来编码局部点集中的细粒度几何结构，从而保留准确的形状信息。我们提出了3D混合Mamba Transformer（3DHMT）块，该块采用SSM-注意力-SSM管道来平衡全局上下文理解和局部细节保留，有效缓解了远程检测中感受野扩大与几何保真度之间的矛盾。此外，我们还引入了一种受激光雷达物理原理启发的体素生成块，以沿传感器观测方向扩散特征，从而重建遮挡和远距离区域的完整物体结构。在KITTI和ONCE数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，3DTMDet的性能优于最先进的检测器。代码可在https://github.com/QiuBingwen/3DTMDet获取。

Abstract

A fundamental challenge in point cloud object detection lies in the conflict between the extreme sparsity of distant points and the need for remote context understanding. The existing methods typically use 1D serialization to expand the receptive field, which inevitably discards already scarce local geometric details and reduces detection of distant and small objects. To address this issue, we propose 3DTMDet, a novel detection network that synergistically combines state space models (Mamba) with Transformers. The core idea is to utilize SSM's linear complexity and advantages in long sequence modeling to effectively capture global interactions between sparse and distant points, while using Transformer modules with local attention to encode fine-grained geometric structures in local point sets, preserving accurate shape information. We propose the 3D Hybrid Mamba Transformer (3DHMT) block, which uses an SSM-Attention-SSM pipeline to balance global context understanding and local detail preservation, effectively alleviating the tension between receptive field enlargement and geometric preservation in remote detection. In addition, we introduced a voxel generation block inspired by LiDAR physics, which diffuses features along the sensor observation direction to reconstruct the complete object structure of occlusion and distant areas. Extensive experiments conducted on the KITTI and ONCE datasets have shown that 3DTMDet outperforms state-of-the-art detectors. The code is available at https://github.com/QiuBingwen/3DTMDet.

item.title: Measuring Maximum Activations in Open Large Language Models
item.author: Chen, Luxuan, Tian, Han, Chen, Xinran, Kong, Rui, Wang, Fang, Chen, Jiamin, Li, Yuchen, Zhao, Jiashu, Wang, Shuaiqiang, Xiong, Haoyi, Yin, Dawei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究现代开放大语言模型中激活值的动态范围及其对低比特量化、激活缩放和稳定推理的影响。

背景: 先前的研究主要针对2024年之前的LLaMA风格模型，描述了异常特征和大量激活值，但下游的激活-量化栈继承了这一观点，并未针对2024年后的开放模型热潮进行重新审视。

目的: 探讨现代开放大语言模型中的激活值最大幅度有多大，以及该幅度在不同模型家族、代次和训练阶段如何变化。

方法: 采用统一流程，使用5,000样本多领域语料库、特定家族的分词器，并在嵌入、隐藏状态、注意力、MLP/MoE、SwiGLU门控和最终归一化层设置相同的钩子，测量了来自8个开放家族的27个检查点上的全局和逐层最大值。

主要发现: 1. 全局最大值在参数量相当的情况下跨度超过近四个数量级，Qwen3.5和MoE检查点在10的2次方到10的3次方范围，Gemma3-27B-it达到约7 x 10的5次方；2. 跨家族和跨代次比较打破了简单的单调缩放；3. MoE检查点比匹配规模的密集型对应模型峰值低14.0-23.4倍，而残差流在22/24个检查点中承载了全局最大值；4. 轻量级INT-8检查显示，测量到的最大值通过激活缩放选择与低比特重建误差共变。

结论: 最大激活幅度是一个与模型家族、架构和训练阶段相关的模型属性，而非大小的简单副产品，应在低比特部署前与任何开放权重发布一起测量和报告。

翻译: 激活值的动态范围是低比特量化、激活缩放和稳定LLM推理的一阶约束。先前的工作对2024年之前的LLaMA风格模型中的异常特征和大量激活值进行了描述，下游的激活-量化栈继承了这一观点，并未针对2024年后的开放模型热潮进行重新审视。我们提出了一个面向部署的问题：现代开放LLM中的激活值最大幅度有多大，以及该幅度在不同家族、代次和训练阶段如何变化？在统一流程（5,000样本多领域语料库、特定家族的分词器、嵌入、隐藏状态、注意力、MLP/MoE、SwiGLU门控和最终归一化层设置相同的钩子）下，我们在8个开放家族的27个检查点上测量了全局和逐层最大值，这些家族涵盖密集型、MoE、视觉-语言、中间训练和指令微调变体。我们发现，（i）在参数量相当的情况下，全局最大值跨度超过近四个数量级，Qwen3.5和MoE检查点在10的2次方到10的3次方范围，Gemma3-27B-it达到约7 x 10的5次方；（ii）跨家族和跨代次比较打破了简单的单调缩放；（iii）MoE检查点比匹配规模的密集型对应模型峰值低14.0-23.4倍，而残差流在22/24个检查点中承载了全局最大值。轻量级INT-8检查显示，测量到的最大值通过激活缩放选择与低比特重建误差共变。我们得出结论，最大激活幅度是一个与模型家族、架构和训练阶段相关的模型属性，而非大小的简单副产品，应在低比特部署前与任何开放权重发布一起测量和报告。代码在 https URL 公开。
