Abstract

Acquisition and creation of 3D assets have been largely view- or appearance-driven. As a result, existing digital 3D models often lack the requisite structural components to function as intended, such as joints, supports, interiors, or interaction elements. At the same time, even human-annotated motions are frequently error-prone, leading to physically implausible behavior. We introduce object functionalization, a novel task aimed at transforming visually plausible but non-functional 3D models into functional and physically operable ones. We formulate functionalization as a graph completion problem over a new functional graph representation, where labeled nodes represent object parts, labeled edges encode functional and contact relations, and movable nodes carry motion attributes, so that structural functional deficiencies manifest as missing nodes or incorrect edges. We develop a neural Graph Functionalizer (GraFu) to complete an incomplete graph representing a non-functional 3D object. The completed graph then drives a geometry realization stage that instantiates predicted connectors and structural elements in 3D, with the compelling side effect of rectifying erroneous human-annotated and predicted motions. To support training and evaluation, focusing on furniture as a rich and challenging target category, we introduce FurFun-233, a dataset of 233 paired non-functional and functionalized furniture models. On PartNet-Mobility ("zero-shot") and HSSD test sets, our method matches state-of-the-art methods in motion prediction accuracy while substantially improving functionality in terms of collision and connectivity.

item.title: TinySAM 2: Extreme Memory Compression for Efficient Track Anything Model
item.author: Zhaoyuan Ding, Yijing Yang, Han Shu, Xinghao Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TinySAM 2 是一种轻量级视频分割模型，旨在解决 SAM 2 的部署瓶颈，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低计算成本和内存占用。

背景: SAM 2 作为核心基础模型在视频分割领域表现出色，但其多阶段图像编码器和记忆模块具有复杂的计算特性，导致在实际应用中部署困难。

目的: 为了解决 SAM 2 的部署瓶颈，提出 TinySAM 2，旨在平衡性能与效率，降低参数数量、计算负载和部署成本。

方法: 引入记忆质量管理机制以选择和保留高信息量的历史帧；提出联合时空令牌压缩，利用平均池化压缩空间冗余令牌，并基于令牌级相似度测量在记忆库中选择信息令牌；采用 RepViT 作为轻量级图像编码器。

主要发现: 在 DAVIS 和 SA-V 等挑战性数据集上，TinySAM 2 达到了 SAM 2.1 90% 的性能，仅使用 7% 的记忆令牌和 3% 的训练数据。

结论: TinySAM 2 有效缓解了 SAM 2 在参数数量、计算负载和部署成本方面的瓶颈，为视频分割模型在设备上的广泛应用提供了资源高效的解决方案。

翻译: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) serves as a core foundation model in the field of video segmentation. Building upon the original SAM model, it introduces a memory bank mechanism and demonstrates outstanding performance in tasks such as semi-supervised video object segmentation and tracking anything. However, the complex computational characteristics of SAM 2's multi-stage image encoder and memory module have raised the barrier to the model's deployment in practical applications. To address this issue, we propose TinySAM 2, a lightweight video segmentation model that balances performance and efficiency. First, a memory quality management mechanism is introduced to select and retain high-informative historical frames as the memory. In addition, a joint-spatial-temporal token compression is proposed that reduces the memory storage and computational cost. Specifically, average pooling is employed to first compress redundancy tokens in the spatial domain. In the temporal domain, informative tokens are selected across frames in the memory bank based on token-level similarity measurement. Besides, we take RepViT as the lightweight image encoder, which further reduces the model parameters. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets such as DAVIS and SA-V demonstrate that TinySAM 2 achieves 90% of the performance of SAM 2.1, with only 7% memory tokens and 3% training data. This study effectively alleviates the bottlenecks in parameter count, computational load, and deployment costs associated with SAM 2, providing a resource-efficient solution for the widespread application of video segmentation models on devices.

Abstract

Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) serves as a core foundation model in the field of video segmentation. Building upon the original SAM model, it introduces a memory bank mechanism and demonstrates outstanding performance in tasks such as semi-supervised video object segmentation and tracking anything. However, the complex computational characteristics of SAM 2's multi-stage image encoder and memory module have raised the barrier to the model's deployment in practical applications. To address this issue, we propose TinySAM 2, a lightweight video segmentation model that balances performance and efficiency. First, a memory quality management mechanism is introduced to select and retain high-informative historical frames as the memory. In addition, a joint-spatial-temporal token compression is proposed that reduces the memory storage and computational cost. Specifically, average pooling is employed to first compress redundancy tokens in the spatial domain. In the temporal domain, informative tokens are selected across frames in the memory bank based on token-level similarity measurement. Besides, we take RepViT as the lightweight image encoder, which further reduces the model parameters. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets such as DAVIS and SA-V demonstrate that TinySAM 2 achieves 90% of the performance of SAM 2.1, with only 7% memory tokens and 3% training data. This study effectively alleviates the bottlenecks in parameter count, computational load, and deployment costs associated with SAM 2, providing a resource-efficient solution for the widespread application of video segmentation models on devices.

item.title: OmniSelect: Dynamic Modality-Aware Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
item.author: Morunliu Yang, Ruotao Xu, Le Li, Yue Wang, Jianxin Zhang, Juntao Li, Yihang Lou, Siwei Feng, Peifeng Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OmniSelect是一个无需训练的模态自适应令牌修剪框架，用于高效处理多模态输入。

背景: OmniLLMs在统一音频视频理解方面受到关注，但处理长多模态令牌序列会产生大量计算开销。

目的: 解决现有方法依赖固定、模态特定的指导，无法考虑不同查询中模态重要性变化的问题。

方法: 利用轻量级AudioCLIP模型估计跨模态相关性，将输入分类为音频主导、视频主导和统一修剪三种修剪模式，并在每个时间组内执行细粒度令牌修剪。

主要发现: OmniSelect通过显式建模模态偏好和动态策略选择，有效避免了“一刀切”压缩的弊端，在无需额外训练的情况下实现了高效的多模态令牌减少并保持了强大性能。

结论: OmniSelect是一种有效的训练-free方法，能够在保持性能的同时实现高效的多模态令牌压缩。

翻译: OmniSelect是一种无需训练的模态自适应令牌修剪框架，用于高效处理多模态输入。

Abstract

Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) have recently gained increasing attention for unified audio-video understanding. However, processing long multimodal token sequences introduces substantial computational overhead, making efficient token compression crucial. Existing methods typically rely on fixed, modality-specific guidance, which fails to account for the varying importance of modalities across different queries. To address this limitation, we propose $\textbf{OmniSelect}$, a training-free, modality-adaptive token pruning framework that dynamically selects appropriate compression strategies for multimodal inputs. Specifically, we leverage a lightweight AudioCLIP model to estimate cross-modal relevance and categorize each input into three pruning regimes: Audio-Centric, Video-Centric, and Uniform pruning. Based on these relevance scores, OmniSelect further performs fine-grained token pruning within each temporal group, adaptively allocating pruning ratios to preserve informative tokens across modalities. By explicitly modeling modality preference and enabling dynamic strategy selection, OmniSelect effectively avoids the pitfalls of one-size-fits-all compression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves efficient multimodal token reduction while maintaining strong performance, without requiring any additional training.

item.title: Efficient 3D Content Reconstruction and Generation
item.author: Jiahao Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了自动3D内容创建领域，旨在通过从文本或图像合成或恢复3D资产来替代劳动密集型的建模和扫描流程。

背景: 自动3D内容创建的应用领域包括视频游戏、虚拟现实、机器人和模拟，能够实现快速资产原型设计、多样化的交互世界生成以及高效的3D数据收集。

目的: 该研究旨在推进文本或图像到3D生成以及3D重建这两个互补范式的发展。

方法: 在生成方面，提出了Instant3D，结合多视图扩散和前馈稀疏视图3D重建；在重建方面，开发了FastMap，使用一阶优化和融合GPU内核实现结构从运动。

主要发现: Instant3D能够在5到20秒内生成高质量资产；FastMap相比之前的最先进方法实现了高达10倍的速度提升，同时保持了可比的姿态准确性和下游新视图合成质量。

结论: 通过提出Instant3D和FastMap，该研究在3D内容创建的生成和重建两个方向上均取得了进展。

Abstract

Automatic 3D content creation seeks to replace labor-intensive modeling and scanning pipelines with systems that can synthesize or recover 3D assets directly from text or images. Its applications span video games, virtual reality, robotics, and simulation, enabling rapid asset prototyping, diverse interactive world generation, and efficient 3D data collection for training foundation models. Contemporary solutions largely follow two complementary paradigms: (i) text- or image-to-3D generation, which learns priors over 3D geometry and appearance to create novel assets from natural language or a single view image; and (ii) 3D reconstruction, which estimates camera poses and geometry from RGB images. This thesis advances both directions. On the generation side, I introduce Instant3D, which combines multi-view diffusion with feed-forward sparse-view 3D reconstruction to produce high-quality assets in 5-20 seconds. On the reconstruction side, I develop FastMap, a structure-from-motion pipeline that achieves up to 10x speedup over prior state-of-the-art by using first-order optimization with fused GPU kernels extensively, while maintaining comparable pose accuracy and downstream novel view synthesis quality.

item.title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction
item.author: Qi Si, Penglei Wang, Yushuai Wu, Yifeng Jiao, Xuyang Liu, Xin Guo, Yuan Qi, Yuan Cheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为FLAG的扩散框架，用于从常规H&E染色预测空间基因表达，通过结构化分布建模解决基因维度诅咒问题。

背景: 当前模型将预测任务视为独立的点对点任务，忽略了基因协调和空间分布等关键生物结构。

目的: 引入FLAG框架，将任务重新定义为结构化分布建模，以保留基因协调和空间分布关系。

方法: FLAG通过整合空间图编码器以保持拓扑一致性，并利用基因基础模型对齐在生成过程中确保基因间保真度；同时提出了新的结构评估指标GSC和SSC。

主要发现: FLAG在传统准确性指标上具有竞争力，同时在捕捉基因间和基因-空间关系方面实现了显著增强的结构保真度。

结论: FLAG通过结构化分布建模有效解决了基因维度诅咒，在保持结构一致性的同时提升了预测性能。

翻译: 从常规H&E染色预测空间基因表达能够实现大规模分子分析，但现有模型将其视为孤立的逐点任务，从而忽略了基因协调和空间分布等关键生物结构。为了保留这些关系，我们引入了基于扩散的框架FLAG，将此任务重新定义为结构化分布建模。同时，我们识别出了关键的基因维度诅咒，即在高维空间中联合建模基因表达及其空间交互失败，而FLAG通过整合空间图编码器以保持拓扑一致性，并利用基因基础模型对齐在生成过程中确保基因间保真度，解决了这一挑战。为了严格评估模型性能，我们提出了一组新颖的结构评估指标，包括基因结构相关性和空间结构相关性。我们的实验表明，FLAG在传统准确性上具有高度竞争力，同时在捕捉基因间和基因-空间关系方面实现了显著增强的结构保真度。代码可在 https://github.com/darkflash03/FLAG 获取。

Abstract

Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H\&E enables large-scale molecular profiling, yet current models treat this as isolated pointwise tasks, thereby overlooking essential biological structures like gene coordination and spatial distribution. To preserve these relationships, we introduce \textbf{FLAG}, a diffusion-based framework that redefines this task as structured distribution modeling. At the same time, we identify the critical \textbf{Gene Dimension Curse}, where joint modeling gene expression and their spatial interactions fail in high-dimensional spaces, and FLAG solves this challenge by integrating a spatial graph encoder for topological consistency and utilizing Gene Foundation Model (GFM) alignment for gene-gene fidelity in the generation process. To rigorously assess model performance, we propose a set of novel structural evaluation metrics, including Gene Structural Correlation (\textbf{GSC}) and Spatial Structural Correlation (\textbf{SSC}). Our experiments demonstrate that FLAG is highly competitive in traditional accuracy (PCC/MSE) while achieving significantly enhanced structural fidelity in capturing both gene-gene and gene-spatial relationships. The code is available at https://github.com/darkflash03/FLAG.

item.title: 4DLidarOpen: An Open 4D FMCW Lidar Dataset for Motion-Aware Autonomous Driving
item.author: Kane Qian, Xin Zhao, Yining Shi, Rujun Yan, Zhengqing Pan, Kaojin Zhu, Mengmeng Yang, Kai Sun, Diange Yang, Kun Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 4DLidarOpen是一个大规模开放的多模态自动驾驶数据集，专注于4D频率调制连续波激光雷达感知。该数据集包含点状径向速度测量、多种类型激光雷达、环视相机和6自由度自车位姿数据，并在北京复杂城市环境中收集，涵盖密集行人交互、交通拥堵、高速驾驶和无保护操作等场景。

背景: 传统飞行时间激光雷达数据集主要提供几何测量，而4DLidarOpen引入了4D FMCW激光雷达的点状径向速度测量，并结合多种类型激光雷达、环视相机和自车位姿数据，以支持更全面的动态场景理解。

目的: 建立3D目标检测、鸟瞰图分割和流预测以及运动预测与规划的基准，并支持4D场景理解、多激光雷达融合以及速度感知感知和规划的研究。

方法: 采用混合标注策略，大规模自动标注数据支持可扩展训练，人类专家对人工标注的训练和验证集进行细化。

主要发现: 4D FMCW激光雷达的直接速度测量为动态场景理解提供了互补的运动线索。与仅几何感知相比，速度感知表示在涉及弱势道路用户和快速移动对象的场景中显著改善了运动相关感知和下游预测与规划。

结论: 4D FMCW激光雷达是一种有前景的运动感知自动驾驶传感模态。数据集和评估工具包已公开发布。

翻译: 我们提出了4DLidarOpen，这是一个大规模开放的多模态自动驾驶数据集，以4D频率调制连续波激光雷达感知为中心。与主要提供几何测量的传统飞行时间激光雷达数据集不同，4DLidarOpen包括来自前向4D FMCW激光雷达的点状径向速度测量，以及多种类型的激光雷达，包括旋转、固态和盲点变体、环视相机和6自由度自车位姿。该数据集在北京的复杂城市环境中收集，涵盖密集行人交互、交通拥堵、高速驾驶和无保护操作。4DLidarOpen提供同步的多传感器数据和跨五个对象类别的3D边界框注释和持久跟踪ID。采用混合注释策略，大规模自动标注数据支持可扩展训练，人类专家对人工标注的训练和验证集进行细化。基于此数据集，我们建立了3D目标检测、鸟瞰图分割和流预测以及运动预测与规划的基准。广泛的实验表明，来自4D FMCW激光雷达的直接速度测量为动态场景理解提供了互补的运动线索。与仅几何感知相比，速度感知表示改善了运动相关感知和下游预测与规划，特别是在涉及弱势道路用户和快速移动对象的场景中。这些结果表明，4D FMCW激光雷达是一种有前景的运动感知自动驾驶传感模态。数据集和评估工具包已公开发布，以支持4D场景理解、多激光雷达融合以及速度感知感知和规划的研究。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决缺乏公开的4D FMCW激光雷达数据集的问题，以支持自动驾驶中对运动物体的感知。这个问题很重要，因为4D激光雷达能提供更丰富的运动信息，而开放的数据集能促进相关算法的研究和验证。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 发布了一个用于运动感知自动驾驶的开放 4D FMCW 激光雷达数据集。

Abstract

We present 4DLidarOpen, a large-scale open multi-modal dataset for autonomous driving, centered on 4D frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) Lidar sensing. Unlike conventional time-of-flight Lidar datasets that mainly provide geometric measurements, 4DLidarOpen includes point-wise radial velocity measurements from a forward-facing 4D FMCW Lidar, together with multiple Lidars of different types, including rotating, solid-state, and blind-spot variants, surround-view cameras, and 6-DOF ego-vehicle poses. The dataset was collected in complex urban environments in Beijing and covers dense pedestrian interactions, congested traffic, high-speed driving, and unprotected maneuvers. 4DLidarOpen provides synchronized multi-sensor data and 3D bounding-box annotations with persistent track IDs across five object categories. A hybrid annotation strategy is adopted, where large-scale auto-labeled data support scalable training and human experts refine annotations for the human-annotated training and validation sets. Based on this dataset, we establish benchmarks for 3D object detection, birds-eye view (BEV) segmentation and flow prediction, and motion forecasting with planning. Extensive experiments show that direct velocity measurements from 4D FMCW Lidar provide complementary motion cues for dynamic-scene understanding. Compared with geometric-only sensing, the velocity-aware representation improves motion-related perception and downstream forecasting and planning, especially in scenarios involving vulnerable road users and fast-moving objects. These results indicate that 4D FMCW Lidar is a promising sensing modality for motion-aware autonomous driving. The dataset and evaluation toolkit are publicly released to support research on 4D scene understanding, multi-Lidar fusion, and velocity-aware perception and planning.

item.title: PRiSE-EEG: A Prior-Guided Foundation Model with Depth-Stratified Experts for Cross-Paradigm EEG Representation Learning
item.author: Wei Xiong, Jiangtong Li, Kun Zhu, Jie Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为PRiSE-EEG的先导引导EEG基础模型，旨在通过CKA校准的深度分层专家机制解决不同EEG范式间的优化冲突和表示差异问题。

背景: 现有的EEG基础模型在异构范式间学习可重用表示时，常采用统一的适应机制，且通常在单独的下游微调协议下报告性能。

目的: 分析密集型EEG Transformer，并解决不同EEG范式间的优化冲突和跨范式相似性问题，以提升模型性能。

方法: 提出PRiSE-EEG模型，利用静态皮层和先验知识形成连续多通道EEG补丁，并分配共享和专用专家；根据层间CKA共享度的sigmoid映射分配专家，早期保留通用规律，后期分配专用容量。

主要发现: 梯度相似性分析显示EEG范式间存在显著优化冲突；CKA分析表明深度分层过渡：浅层保留更强的跨范式相似性，深层变得日益专业化。

结论: 在12个公共EEG基准测试中，PRiSE-EEG在匹配协议下表现出强大的跨范式性能；CKA导出的专家分配优于密集Transformer、均匀MoE和手动固定共享-专用专家比例。

翻译: EEG基础模型旨在学习跨异构范式的可重用表示，然而现有方法通常使用统一的适应机制，并且通常在单独的下游微调协议下报告。在这项工作中，我们首先从两个互补的角度分析密集EEG Transformer。六个下游数据集之间的梯度相似性揭示了EEG范式之间显著的优化冲突，而在混合范式批次上的CKA分析显示了一致的深度分层过渡：浅层保留更强的跨范式相似性，而深层变得日益专业化。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了PRiSE-EEG，一个具有CKA校准深度分层专家的先导引导EEG基础模型。PRiSE-EEG使用弱静态皮层和先验知识形成连续多通道EEG补丁，然后根据来自层间CKA共享度的sigmoid映射，在MoE Transformer块中分配共享和专用专家。这种设计在早期块中保留了常见的EEG规律，而在后期分配了更多专用容量用于任务特定转换。在12个公共EEG基准测试上的实验显示，在匹配协议下具有强大的跨范式性能。紧凑的消融实验进一步表明，CKA导出的专家分配优于密集Transformer、均匀MoE和手动固定的共享-专用专家比例。

Abstract

EEG foundation models aim to learn reusable representations across heterogeneous paradigms, yet existing approaches often use uniform adaptation mechanisms and are typically reported under separate downstream fine-tuning protocols. In this work, we first analyze dense EEG Transformers from two complementary perspectives. Gradient similarity across six downstream datasets reveals substantial optimization conflicts among EEG paradigms, while CKA analysis on mixed-paradigm batches shows a consistent depth-wise transition: shallow layers preserve stronger cross-paradigm similarity, whereas deeper layers become increasingly specialized. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textbf{PRiSE-EEG}, a prior-guided EEG foundation model with CKA-calibrated Depth-Stratified Experts. PRiSE-EEG forms continuous multi-channel EEG patches using weak static cortical and network priors and dynamic short-time channel interactions, then allocates shared and specialized experts across MoE Transformer blocks according to a sigmoid mapping from layer-wise CKA sharedness. This design preserves common EEG regularities in early blocks while assigning more specialized capacity to later task-specific transformations. Experiments on 12 public EEG benchmarks show strong cross-paradigm performance under matched protocols. Compact ablations further show that CKA-derived expert allocation improves over dense Transformers, uniform MoE, and manually fixed shared-specific expert ratios.

item.title: Learning to Solve Compositional Geometry Routing Problems
item.author: Mingfeng Fan, Jianan Zhou, Jiaqi Cheng, Yifeng Zhang, Jie Zhang, Guillaume Adrien Sartoretti
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究组合几何路由问题(CGRP)，提出DiCon框架解决其挑战。

背景: CGRP是传统路由问题的统一超类，涵盖点、线、面及任意混合任务几何，提供广泛抽象。

目的: 解决CGRP中非点任务带来的挑战，包括内在不对称性、旅行路线与内在路径的紧密耦合，以及因大量可行但往往不相关选项而扩大的动作空间，从而影响表示学习和决策。

方法: 提出DiCon，一种差分注意力辅助求解器与对比学习的即插即用框架。包括差分注意力机制（主动抑制低竞争力候选动作的概率质量）和双级对比学习目标（促进鲁棒的全局实例表示和正则化几何感知任务表示）。

主要发现: DiCon在包含不同组合的多样化CGRP实例中实现了强性能、广泛适用性和优越的泛化能力。

结论: DiCon通过两种互补角度有效解决了CGRP的挑战。

翻译: 我们研究组合几何路由问题(CGRP)，这是一个传统路由问题的统一超类，涵盖了仅点、仅线、仅面以及任意混合任务几何，为现实世界的路由场景提供了广泛的抽象。除了基于点的标准路由外，具有非点任务的CGRP本质上是不对称的，将旅行路线与内在路径紧密耦合，并扩大了动作空间，其中包含大量可行但往往不相关的选项，从而对表示学习和决策提出了重大挑战。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了DiCon，一种差分注意力辅助求解器与对比学习相结合的即插即用框架，从两个互补的角度解决问题。首先，我们引入了一种差分注意力机制，主动抑制低竞争力候选动作的概率质量。其次，我们设计了一个双级对比学习目标，以促进鲁棒的全局实例表示并正则化几何感知任务表示。广泛的实验表明，DiCon在不同组合的多样化CGRP实例中实现了强性能、广泛适用性和优越的泛化能力。

Abstract

We study the Compositional Geometry Routing Problem (CGRP), a unified superclass of traditional routing problems that covers point-only, line-only, area-only, and arbitrary hybrid task geometries, providing a broad abstraction for real-world routing scenarios. Beyond standard point-based routing, CGRP with non-point tasks can be inherently asymmetric, tightly coupled travel routes with the intrinsic path, and enlarges the action space with numerous feasible yet often irrelevant options, thereby posing significant challenges for both representation learning and decision-making. To address these challenges, we propose DiCon, a differential attention-assisted solver with contrastive learning, as a plug-and-play framework that tackles the problem from two complementary angles. First, we introduce a differential attention mechanism that actively suppresses the probability mass on less competitive candidate actions. Second, we design a double-level contrastive learning objective to promote robust global instance representations and regularize geometry-aware task representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiCon achieves strong performance, broad versatility, and superior generalization across diverse CGRP instances with different compositions.

item.title: SENSE: Satellite-based ENergy Synthesis for Sustainable Environment
item.author: Kailai Sun, Mingyi He, Heye Huang, Can Rong, Alok Prakash, Baoshen Guo, Shenhao Wang, Jinhua Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SENSE的统一生成式城市建筑能源建模框架，能够联合合成真实的城市卫星图像以及与卫星图像对齐的高质量建筑能耗和高度图。

背景: 现有研究主要基于卫星图像和深度学习，但存在预测性研究无法反映城市规划生成本质、缺乏城市功能生成（如能源层）以及高质量高分辨率建筑能源数据稀缺等挑战。

目的: 提出SENSE框架，旨在通过可控扩散模型和大型视觉模型的知识学习，在潜在空间中生成城市建筑能耗和高度信息，以解决数据稀缺问题。

方法: SENSE基于可控扩散模型，以道路网络和城市密度指标为条件，利用大型视觉模型学到的知识，在潜在空间中生成城市建筑能耗和高度信息。

主要发现: 在四个城市的实验中，SENSE实现了高视觉保真度和强物理一致性，满足ASHRAE标准；使用少于20%的标注能源数据即可生成足够的合成数据，提升下游预测性能10% IoU；相比现有最佳方法，显著降低了预测误差（NMBE减少3%-11%，CVRMSE减少1%-9%）。

结论: SENSE为城市科学、能源科学和建筑科学提供了一种能源效率城市规划和物理生成解决方案，并提供了开源数据集和代码。

翻译: Urban Building Energy Modeling plays a critical role in achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies based on satellite imagery and deep learning have achieved remarkable progress, many challenges exist: most existing studies are inherently predictive, failing to reflect the generative nature of urban planning; although generative AI and diffusion models have seen explosive growth in satellite imagery, they lack the urban functional generation (e.g., energy layer); third, aligned high-quality high-resolution building energy data with satellite imagery is limited and scarce. Here we propose SENSE (Satellite-based ENergy Synthesis for Sustainable Environment), a unified generative UBEM framework that jointly synthesizes realistic urban satellite imagery and aligned high-quality building energy consumption and height maps. By conditioning on road networks and urban density metrics, SENSE, based on a controllable diffusion model, leverages the knowledge learned by large vision models to generate urban building energy consumption and height information (annotations) in the latent space. Experiments across four cities (New York City, Boston, Lyon, Busan) demonstrate that SENSE achieves high visual fidelity and strong physical consistency, satisfying the ASHRAE standard metric. Experiments demonstrate that SENSE can generate enough annotated synthetic data using less than 20% labeled energy data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 10% IoU. Compared to SOTA urban energy prediction methods, SENSE significantly reduced prediction error (reduced 3%-11% NMBE and 1%-9% CVRMSE). This study offers an energy-efficiency urban planning and physical generation solution for urban science, energy science and building science. The dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE and https://github.com/kailaisun/GenAI4Urban-Energy/.

item.title: How Good LLMs Are at Answering Bangla Medical Visual Questions? Dataset and Benchmarking
item.author: Rafid Ahmed, Intesar Tahmid, Mir Sazzat Hossain, Tasnimul Hossain Tomal, Md Fahim, Md Farhad Alam Bhuiyan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究介绍了BanglaMedVQA数据集，评估了当前基础模型在孟加拉语医学视觉问答任务上的表现。

背景: 大型语言模型和大型视觉语言模型的发展使得通用系统在复杂推理任务中展现出潜力，特别是在医学领域。

目的: 为了填补孟加拉语医学视觉问答基准的空白，研究引入了BanglaMedVQA数据集。

方法: 构建了包含临床验证图像-问题-答案对的数据集，并对当前基础模型进行了全面评估。

主要发现: 当前模型在孟加拉语上的表现显著低于英语基准，反映了低资源语言的挑战；即使是Gemini和GPT-4.1 mini等顶级模型也无法准确回答专业诊断问题；开源模型如Gemma-3在一般类别中偶尔表现更好，但在临床复杂问题上仍面临困难。

结论: 现有模型在细粒度医学推理方面存在严重局限，迫切需要高质量的评估方法。

翻译: 大型语言模型和大型视觉语言模型的最新进展使得通用系统能够在包括医学领域在内的复杂推理任务中展现出有前景的能力。医学视觉问答（MedVQA）尤其从这些发展中受益。然而，尽管孟加拉语是全球使用最广泛的语言之一，但尚不存在既定的孟加拉语MedVQA基准。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了BanglaMedVQA，这是一个包含临床验证的图像-问题-答案对的数据集，以及对该资源上当前基础模型的全面评估。与之前报告当前模型在英语MedVQA基准上表现较低的发现一致，我们的分析显示孟加拉语性能显著较低，反映了低资源语言固有的挑战。即使是Gemini和GPT-4.1 mini等顶级模型也无法准确回答专业诊断问题，表明在细粒度医学推理方面存在严重局限。尽管某些开源模型（如Gemma-3）在一般类别中偶尔胜过这些模型，但它们在临床复杂问题上也面临困难，强调了迫切需要顶级的评估方法。

Abstract

Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have enabled general-purpose systems to demonstrate promising capabilities in complex reasoning tasks, including those in the medical domain. Medical Visual Question Answering (MedVQA) has particularly benefited from these developments. However, despite Bangla being one of the most widely spoken languages globally, there exists no established MedVQA benchmark for it. To address this gap, we introduce BanglaMedVQA, a dataset comprising clinically validated image-question-answer pairs, along with a comprehensive evaluation of current foundation models on this resource. Consistent with prior findings that report low performance of current models on English MedVQA benchmarks, our analysis reveals that Bangla performance is substantially lower, reflecting the challenges inherent to low-resource languages. Even top-performing models such as Gemini and GPT-4.1 mini fail to accurately answer specialized diagnostic questions, indicating severe limitations in fine-grained medical reasoning. Although certain open-source models, such as Gemma-3, occasionally outperform these models in general categories, they too struggle with clinically complex questions, underscoring the urgent need for top-notch evaluation method.

item.title: WinTok: A Win-Win Hybrid Tokenizer via Decomposing Visual Understanding and Generation with Transferable Tokens
item.author: Yiwei Guo, Shaobin Zhuang, Zhipeng Huang, Canmiao Fu, Chen Li, Jing Lyu, Yali Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为WinTok的统一视觉分词器，通过显式解耦两个目标，在重建、理解和生成任务上取得了改进。

背景: 现有的统一视觉分词器在支持高层语义抽象和低层像素重建时面临内在冲突。

目的: 构建一个统一的视觉分词器，以弥合视觉理解和生成之间的差距。

方法: WinTok是一种简洁的混合分词器，通过显式解耦两个目标来取得双赢性能；它用一组可学习的语义标记补充像素标记，引入了一种非对称标记蒸馏机制，使语义标记能够继承预训练语义嵌入的强判别力。

主要发现: 在10个具有挑战性的基准测试中，WinTok在重建、理解和生成方面提供了持续的改进；在仅使用5000万开放数据训练的情况下，WinTok在分类准确率上比强基线UniTok高出11.2%，并达到了0.41的竞争性重建rFID。

结论: WinTok在显著更少的训练数据下实现了优于基线的性能，证明了其有效性和竞争力。

翻译: 构建统一的视觉分词器对于弥合视觉理解和生成之间的差距至关重要。然而，现有方法在支持高层语义抽象和低层像素重建时面临内在冲突，因为单个标记空间被迫同时支持这两项任务。我们提出了WinTok，一种简洁的混合分词器，通过显式解耦这两个目标来取得双赢性能。WinTok用一组可学习的语义标记补充像素标记，有效地缓解了跨任务干扰，而无需承担双分词器的计算开销。为了进一步增强理解能力，我们引入了一种非对称标记蒸馏机制：语义标记由任何视觉基础模型的预训练语义嵌入引导，使它们能够继承强大的判别力，同时保持灵活性。在10个具有挑战性的基准测试中，WinTok在重建、理解和生成方面提供了持续的改进。在仅使用5000万开放数据训练的情况下，WinTok在分类准确率上比强基线UniTok高出11.2%，并达到了0.41的竞争性重建rFID，尽管使用了显著更少的训练数据。代码已发布在 https://github.com/markywg/WinTok。

Abstract

Building a unified visual tokenizer is essential for bridging the gap between visual understanding and generation. Yet existing approaches struggle with the inherent conflict between these tasks, as a single token space is forced to support both high-level semantic abstraction and low-level pixel reconstruction. We propose WinTok, a concise hybrid tokenizer that achieves a win-win performance by explicitly decoupling the two objectives. WinTok supplements pixel tokens with a set of learnable semantic tokens, effectively mitigating cross-task interference without incurring the computational overhead of dual tokenizers. To further enhance understanding capability, we introduce an asymmetric token distillation mechanism: the semantic tokens are guided by pretrained semantic embeddings from any visual foundation model, enabling them to inherit strong discriminative power while maintaining flexibility. Across 10 challenging benchmarks, WinTok delivers consistent improvements in reconstruction, understanding, and generation. Trained on only 50M open-source data, WinTok surpasses the strong baseline UniTok by 11.2% in classification accuracy and achieves a competitive reconstruction rFID of 0.41, despite using substantially less training data. Code is released at https://github.com/markywg/WinTok.

item.title: POST: Prior-Observation Adversarial Learning of Spatio-Temporal Associations for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
item.author: Suofei Zhang, Yaxuan Zheng, Haifeng Hu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的多变量时间序列异常检测框架，通过联合先验-观测对抗学习范式统一时空建模，解决了空间过度泛化问题，实现了时间级检测和空间定位的新最高水平。

背景: 现有的多变量时间序列异常检测框架越来越多地依赖将图神经网络与序列模型相结合来捕获复杂的时空依赖关系，但较少关注空间过度泛化问题。

目的: 为了解决空间过度泛化问题，提出了一种新的框架，该框架通过联合先验-观测对抗学习范式统一时空建模。

方法: 在空间维度上，模型交替学习邻接矩阵作为结构先验，并在训练过程中以极小极大方式建模先验与数据驱动观测之间的关联差异。此外，构建了一个配备精确通道级注释的合成基准。

主要发现: 在公共数据集和专用基准上的广泛实验表明，所提出的框架在时间级检测和空间定位任务中建立了新的最高水平。

结论: 该框架提高了模型对时间级检测的敏感性，并使模型能够将异常定位到特定通道。

翻译: 现有的多变量时间序列异常检测框架越来越多地依赖将图神经网络与序列模型相结合来捕获复杂的时空依赖关系。然而，较少关注空间过度泛化问题，其中不受约束的结构建模不加区分地重建异常，不可避免地降低了检测召回率。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的框架，通过联合先验-观测对抗学习范式统一时空建模。在空间维度上，模型交替学习邻接矩阵作为结构先验，并在训练过程中以极小极大方式建模先验与数据驱动观测之间的关联差异。这种对抗性优化不仅提高了模型对时间级检测的敏感性，而且使模型能够将异常定位到特定通道。为了系统地评估这种异常定位能力，我们进一步构建了一个配备精确通道级注释的合成基准。在公共数据集和专用基准上的广泛实验表明，所提出的框架在时间级检测和空间定位任务中建立了新的最高水平。我们的代码、预训练模型和基准可在 https://github.com/anocodetest1/POST 公开获取。

Abstract

Existing Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection (MTSAD) frameworks increasingly rely on integrating Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with sequence models to capture complex spatio-temporal dependencies. However, less attention is paid to the spatial over-generalization problem, where unconstrained structural modeling indiscriminately reconstructs anomalies, inevitably degrading detection recall. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel framework that unifies spatio-temporal modeling through a joint prior-observation adversarial learning paradigm. In the spatial dimension, the model alternately learns adjacency matrices as structural prior and models the association discrepancy between prior and data-driven observation in a minimax manner during training. Such adversarial optimization not only improves the model sensitivity for time-wise detection, but also enables the model to localize anomalies to specific channels. To systematically evaluate this anomaly localization capability, we further construct a synthetic benchmark equipped with precise channel-wise annotations. Extensive experiments across public datasets and our dedicated benchmark demonstrate that the proposed framework establishes a new state-of-the-art in both time-wise detection and spatial localization tasks. Our code, pre-trained models, and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/anocodetest1/POST.

item.title: Foundation Models for Credit Risk Prediction: A Game Changer?
item.author: Bart Baesens, Andreas Goethals, Stefan Lessmann, Simon De Vos, Cristián Bravo, David Martens, Victor Medina-Olivares, Christophe Mues, Maria Oskarsdóttir, Seppe vanden Broucke, Tim Verdonck, Wouter Verbeke
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文比较了表格基础模型在信用风险建模中的表现，发现它们在数据集较小的情况下表现最佳，且无需超参数调整即可使用。

背景: 信用风险预测模型在信贷风险管理中至关重要，尽管梯度提升模型和SHAP解释器已成为准标准，但持续改进仍是首要任务。同时，大型语言模型等AI的快速发展正在颠覆预测建模范式，表格数据的基础模型虽然出现较晚，但在小数据集如中小企业贷款中可能特别有益。

目的: 在PD和LGD建模任务中，对最近提出的表格基础模型与广泛的竞争对手（包括机器学习技术）进行基准测试。

方法: 评估涵盖了各种数据集、性能指标和实验条件，测试了表格基础模型在无需超参数调整的情况下，即开箱即用的表现。

主要发现: 表格基础模型在各种数据集和任务中表现最佳，且随着数据集大小的缩小，预测性能显著提高。

结论: 表格基础模型在小数据集设置中表现优异，且易于使用，降低了计算成本。

翻译: 该论文比较了表格基础模型在信用风险建模中的表现，发现它们在数据集较小的情况下表现最佳，且无需超参数调整即可使用。

Abstract

Predictive models play a pivotal role in credit risk management, guiding critical decisions through accurate estimation of default probabilities and losses. Extensive research has introduced new modeling techniques, complemented by large-scale benchmarking studies consolidating the state-of-the-art. Today, quasi-standards such as gradient-boosting models paired with SHAP explainers have emerged, yet continuous improvement of risk models remains a top priority. Concurrently, rapid advancements in AI, most notably large language models, have disrupted predictive modeling paradigms. Foundation models, pretrained on extensive datasets from diverse domains, have demonstrated remarkable performance by leveraging prior knowledge. While prevalent in natural language processing and computer vision, foundation models for tabular data have only recently emerged. We conjecture that pretraining on out-of-domain data is particularly beneficial in small-data settings, such as SME lending or specialized corporate portfolios, and may help address longstanding challenges including low default portfolios and class imbalance. This paper benchmarks recently proposed tabular foundation models against a broad set of competitors, including established and advanced machine learning techniques, across two core tasks: PD and LGD modeling. Our evaluation encompasses various datasets, performance indicators, and experimental conditions. We find that tabular foundation models generally perform best across datasets and tasks. Moreover, they offer significant improvement in predictive performance as dataset size shrinks. These results are remarkable given that the models are tested out-of-the-box, without hyperparameter tuning, ensuring ease of use and mitigating computational costs.

item.title: Semi-LAR: Semi-supervised Contrastive Learning with Linear Attention for Removal of Nighttime Flares
item.author: Xiyu Zhu, Wei Wang, Kui Jiang, Zhengguo Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种半监督镜头光晕去除框架，通过联合解决伪标签可靠性和表示判别性问题，实现了从无标签图像中稳定学习。

背景: 镜头光晕去除具有挑战性，因为光晕伪影具有较大的空间范围，且与场景结构纠缠在一起，而现有方法严重依赖大规模配对数据。

目的: 构建一个半监督镜头光晕去除框架，使其能够从无标签图像中稳定学习。

方法: 提出了自适应伪标签仓库，通过无参考质量评估、基于动量的更新和无效标签过滤来逐步细化伪监督；此外，提出了光晕感知对比损失，将受污染的输入视为负样本，进行补丁级对比学习。

主要发现: 在多个光晕基准测试中，该框架表现出模型无关性，并持续提高了性能和鲁棒性。

结论: 所提出的框架在镜头光晕去除任务中有效且鲁棒。

翻译: Lens flare removal is challenging due to the large spatial extent of flare artifacts and their entanglement with scene structures, while existing methods heavily rely on large-scale paired data. We propose a semi-supervised flare removal framework that enables stable learning from unlabeled images by jointly addressing pseudo-label reliability and representation discrimination. We propose an adaptive pseudo-label repository that progressively refines pseudo supervision through no-reference quality assessment, momentum-based updates, and invalid label filtering, effectively mitigating error accumulation. Moreover, we propose a flare-aware contrastive loss that explicitly treats flare-contaminated inputs as negatives and performs patch-level contrastive learning, encouraging representations that are discriminative against flare patterns while remaining consistent with reliable pseudo targets. Extensive experiments on multiple flare benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework is model-agnostic and consistently improves performance and robustness.

Abstract

Lens flare removal is challenging due to the large spatial extent of flare artifacts and their entanglement with scene structures, while existing methods heavily rely on large-scale paired data. We propose a semi-supervised flare removal framework that enables stable learning from unlabeled images by jointly addressing pseudo-label reliability and representation discrimination. We propose an adaptive pseudo-label repository that progressively refines pseudo supervision through no-reference quality assessment, momentum-based updates, and invalid label filtering, effectively mitigating error accumulation. Moreover, we propose a flare-aware contrastive loss that explicitly treats flare-contaminated inputs as negatives and performs patch-level contrastive learning, encouraging representations that are discriminative against flare patterns while remaining consistent with reliable pseudo targets. Extensive experiments on multiple flare benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework is model-agnostic and consistently improves performance and robustness.

item.title: Visualizing the Invisible: Generative Visual Grounding Empowers Universal EEG Understanding in MLLMs
item.author: Junyu Pan, Yansen Wang, Enze Zhang, Baoliang Lu, Weilong Zheng, Dongsheng Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为生成式视觉定位GVG的框架，通过使用EEG到图像的生成模型作为视觉翻译器，将非视觉的EEG转化为实例特定的代理图像，从而为多模态大语言模型提供结构化的视觉上下文。

背景: 现有的方法主要将神经信号与抽象文本对齐，这是一种有损翻译，可能会丢弃脑活动中编码的细粒度感知信息。视觉诱发的EEG数据集仍然稀缺。

目的: 为了解决现有方法将神经信号仅与文本对齐导致的信息丢失问题，提出一种能够利用EEG生成图像的框架，以提供结构化的视觉上下文，使多模态大语言模型能够利用其视觉先验进行临床状态解释。

方法: 提出生成式视觉定位GVG框架，使用EEG到图像的生成模型作为视觉翻译器。GVG为非视觉EEG幻觉出实例特定的代理图像，提供结构化的视觉上下文。在GVG-Janus中进一步扩展了三模态图像+文本对齐，其中文本提供类别语义锚点，视觉代理用感知细节丰富神经表示。

主要发现: 在两个多模态大语言模型骨干网络上进行了验证。图像-only对齐已经具有竞争力：轻量级的GVG-X-Omni在冻结的7B骨干网络上仅调整170M参数，就匹配了1.7B参数文本对齐的基线。进一步扩展的GVG-Janus在三模态图像+文本对齐中显示出一致的增益。

结论: 视觉代理定位是文本对齐的有效补充，在EEG理解和视觉生成方面显示出一致的性能提升。

翻译: 利用预训练大语言模型和多模态大语言模型的通用表示为大脑基础模型提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，视觉诱发的EEG数据集仍然稀缺，导致现有方法主要将神经信号与抽象文本对齐，这是一种有损翻译，可能会丢弃脑活动中编码的细粒度感知信息。我们提出生成式视觉定位GVG，一种通过使用EEG到图像的生成模型作为视觉翻译器来可视化不可见事物的框架。GVG不为EEG强制进入文本，而是为非视觉EEG幻觉出实例特定的代理图像，提供结构化的视觉上下文，允许多模态大语言模型利用其视觉先验进行临床状态解释。我们在两个多模态大语言模型骨干网络上验证了这一想法，GVG-X-Omni和GVG-Janus。图像-only对齐已经具有竞争力：轻量级的GVG-X-Omni在冻结的7B骨干网络上仅调整170M参数，就匹配了1.7B参数文本对齐的基线。我们进一步将GVG-Janus扩展到三模态图像+文本对齐，其中文本提供类别语义锚点，视觉代理用感知细节丰富神经表示。实验表明在EEG理解和视觉生成方面有一致的增益，表明视觉代理定位是文本对齐的有效补充。

Abstract

Leveraging the universal representations of pre-trained LLMs and MLLMs offers a promising path toward brain foundation models. However, visually-evoked EEG datasets remain scarce, leading existing methods to align neural signals mainly with abstract text, a lossy translation that may discard fine-grained perceptual information encoded in brain activity. We propose Generative Visual Grounding (GVG), a framework that visualizes the invisible by using an EEG-to-image generative model as a visual translator. Instead of forcing EEG into text alone, GVG hallucinates instance-specific proxy images for non-visual EEG, providing structured visual contexts that allow MLLMs to exploit their visual priors for clinical-state interpretation. We validate this idea on two MLLM backbones, GVG-X-Omni and GVG-Janus. Image-only alignment is already competitive: the lightweight GVG-X-Omni matches 1.7B-parameter text-aligned baselines while tuning only 170M parameters on a frozen 7B backbone. We further extend GVG-Janus with trimodal Image+Text alignment, where text supplies categorical semantic anchors and visual proxies enrich neural representations with perceptual details. Experiments show consistent gains in EEG understanding and visual generation, suggesting visual proxy grounding as an effective complement to textual alignment.

item.title: Canonical Regularisation of Wide Feature-Learning Neural Networks
item.author: George Whittle, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Juliusz Ziomek, Natalia Ares, Maike A. Osborne
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了宽神经网络在特征学习阶段与核方法阶段在梯度流训练下的正则化和先验差异，提出了泛化的函数空间能量框架和黎曼几何方法，并提出了arc ridge作为可扩展的代理方法。

背景: 宽神经网络在特征学习阶段驱动现代深度学习，但研究远少于核方法阶段。两者在梯度流训练下的正则化和先验存在关键差异。

目的: 证明ridge正则化在特征学习阶段网络中存在偏差，并解决这一问题。

方法: 将正则化公理化为一个与阶段无关的函数空间能量和提升，通过研究特征学习网络的黎曼几何推导geodesic ridge，并证明函数空间先验是黎曼吉布斯过程。

主要发现: ridge正则化在特征学习阶段网络中存在偏差，即使正则化趋近于零；arc ridge是geodesic ridge的minimax鲁棒、可扩展的代理；早期停止与正则化之间存在深层关系。

结论: 提出的理论框架和arc ridge方法在图像处理和NLP迁移学习问题中得到了实证验证。

翻译: Wide neural networks in the feature-learning regime drive modern deep learning, and yet they remain far less studied than their kernel-regime counterparts. We consider a critical yet under-explored difference between these two regimes: the regulariser and prior implied by gradient flow training. This canonical regularisation property is well-studied in kernel regime networks -- of all the infinite global minima, gradient flow selects exactly the vanishing ridge solution -- and underpins the celebrated NN-GP correspondence, precisely allowing the modelling of noise during training. However, we prove ridge regularisation biases gradient flow in feature-learning regime networks, even in the infinitesimal limit of vanishing regularisation. Over training, ridge distorts the inductive bias of the network, with a particular damage done to pretrained networks where the implicit prior is informative. We resolve this by axiomatising the canonical regulariser as a regime-agnostic function-space energy and lift, which uniquely identifies ridge in the kernel regime, and crucially generalises to the feature-learning regime. By studying the Riemannian geometry of feature-learning networks, we derive geodesic ridge from our framework, generalising ridge to the feature-learning regime. Correspondingly, we prove the canonical function-space prior is a Riemannian Gibbs Process, generalising the more familiar Gaussian Process. As a practical contribution, we propose arc ridge as a minimax-robust, scalable surrogate to geodesic ridge, revealing a deep relationship between early stopping and canonical regularisation across learning regimes. Finally, we demonstrate the consequences of our theory empirically on both image processing and NLP transfer-learning problems.

Abstract

Wide neural networks in the feature-learning regime drive modern deep learning, and yet they remain far less studied than their kernel-regime counterparts. We consider a critical yet under-explored difference between these two regimes: the regulariser and prior implied by gradient flow training. This canonical regularisation property is well-studied in kernel regime networks -- of all the infinite global minima, gradient flow selects exactly the vanishing ridge solution -- and underpins the celebrated NN-GP correspondence, precisely allowing the modelling of noise during training. However, we prove ridge regularisation biases gradient flow in feature-learning regime networks, even in the infinitesimal limit of vanishing regularisation. Over training, ridge distorts the inductive bias of the network, with a particular damage done to pretrained networks where the implicit prior is informative. We resolve this by axiomatising the canonical regulariser as a regime-agnostic function-space energy and lift, which uniquely identifies ridge in the kernel regime, and crucially generalises to the feature-learning regime. By studying the Riemannian geometry of feature-learning networks, we derive geodesic ridge from our framework, generalising ridge to the feature-learning regime. Correspondingly, we prove the canonical function-space prior is a Riemannian Gibbs Process, generalising the more familiar Gaussian Process. As a practical contribution, we propose arc ridge as a minimax-robust, scalable surrogate to geodesic ridge, revealing a deep relationship between early stopping and canonical regularisation across learning regimes. Finally, we demonstrate the consequences of our theory empirically on both image processing and NLP transfer-learning problems.

item.title: Fixed External Cameras as Common Prior Maps for Active 3D Scene Graph Generation
item.author: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种仅基于RGB观测的主动增量3D场景图生成框架，通过融合机器人自身和固定外部摄像头的观测数据，利用图框架引导机器人探索高语义不确定区域，逐步完善场景先验。

背景: 现有的先验信息如BIM模型、平面图和遥感图像能为自主机器人系统提供有价值的几何和语义上下文。

目的: 利用固定外部RGB摄像头的广角环境视图作为通用先验地图（CPMs），在机器人运动开始前初始化语义和几何场景先验，并构建一个硬件无关的RGB-only框架。

方法: 系统采用基于图的主动语义探索框架，直接利用部分场景图引导机器人前往高语义不确定区域，逐步完成和细化先验。该方法仅依赖RGB观测和前馈3D重建模型，将所有摄像头（包括 onboard 和 external）同等对待，无需硬件修改。

主要发现: 仅用单个外部摄像头启动场景图，初始物体召回率可增加高达79%；丰富的先验上下文显著提高了后续主动探索的效率。

结论: 引入外部摄像头作为通用先验地图能够有效提升场景图的初始构建质量，并优化后续的主动探索过程。

翻译: Commonly available prior information, such as BIM models, floor plans, and remote sensing images, can provide valuable geometric and semantic context for autonomous robotic systems. In this paper, we treat observations from fixed external RGB cameras as Common Prior Maps (CPMs): wide-field views of the environment that initialize a semantic and geometric scene prior before any robot motion begins. We present an RGB-only framework for active, incremental 3D scene graph (3DSG) generation that seamlessly fuses observations from both onboard robot cameras and fixed external cameras within a single hardware-agnostic pipeline. By relying solely on RGB observations processed by a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, the system treats all cameras - onboard or external - identically, requiring no hardware modifications. A graph-based active semantic exploration framework then directly leverages the partial scene graph to guide the robot toward regions of high semantic uncertainty, progressively completing and refining the prior. Experiments demonstrate that bootstrapping the scene graph with even a single external camera increases initial object recall by up to +79%, and that the richer context of the prior significantly improves the efficiency of subsequent active exploration.

item.title: RGB-only Active 3D Scene Graph Generation for Indoor Mobile Robots
item.author: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种仅基于RGB输入的主动增量式3D场景图构建框架，统一了感知与规划，解决了现有方法依赖专用深度传感器和被动观测轨迹的局限性。

背景: 现有3D场景图生成方法通常依赖LiDAR或RGB-D相机等专用深度传感器，限制了部署范围，且现有管道多基于被动观测轨迹而非基于部分构建的场景表示选择视角，未能有效利用场景图中的语义和空间信息。

目的: 提出一种完全视觉化的框架，用于从RGB输入中主动、增量地构建3D场景图，解决上述局限性。

方法: 该框架围绕共享的结构化表示统一感知与规划，该表示捕获物体语义、3D几何、关系上下文和多视角信息；框架硬件无关，仅依赖RGB观测，可整合 onboard robot cameras 和 fixed external cameras 的输入。

主要发现: 在 Replica 数据集上，RGB-only 管道在 F1-score 上与使用地面真值深度的基线持平；在 ReplicaCAD 上的主动探索实验显示，语义驱动的视角选择比基于几何前沿的基线在相同探索预算下检测到的物体数量多出一倍以上；外部相机设置表明，互补的RGB视图能有效引导场景图构建并提高上下文理解。

结论: 该框架证明了仅使用RGB输入进行主动、增量式3D场景图构建的可行性，且在检测物体数量和上下文理解方面优于现有方法。

翻译: Current approaches to 3D scene graph generation rely on dedicated depth sensors, such as LiDAR or RGB-D cameras, for metric 3D reconstruction. This limits deployment to specialized robotic platforms and excludes settings where only RGB cameras are available, such as fixed external infrastructure. Existing pipelines also typically operate on passively collected observation trajectories, rather than selecting viewpoints based on the partially built scene representation, and therefore fail to effectively exploit the semantic and spatial information encoded within the graph during exploration. This paper presents a fully visual framework for the active, incremental construction of 3D scene graphs from RGB input only, addressing both limitations. The proposed approach unifies perception and planning around a shared structured representation that captures object semantics, 3D geometry, relational context, and information from multiple viewpoints. Because the framework is hardware-agnostic and relies only on RGB observations, it can incorporate inputs from both onboard robot cameras and fixed external cameras within the same representation. Experiments on the Replica dataset show that the RGB-only pipeline achieves F1-score parity with baselines using ground-truth depth. Active exploration experiments on ReplicaCAD further show that semantic-driven viewpoint selection detects more than twice as many objects as a geometric frontier-based baseline under the same exploration budget. Finally, the external-camera setting demonstrates that complementary RGB views can effectively bootstrap the scene graph and improve contextual understanding at no additional exploration cost.

Abstract

Current approaches to 3D scene graph generation rely on dedicated depth sensors, such as LiDAR or RGB-D cameras, for metric 3D reconstruction. This limits deployment to specialized robotic platforms and excludes settings where only RGB cameras are available, such as fixed external infrastructure. Existing pipelines also typically operate on passively collected observation trajectories, rather than selecting viewpoints based on the partially built scene representation, and therefore fail to effectively exploit the semantic and spatial information encoded within the graph during exploration. This paper presents a fully visual framework for the active, incremental construction of 3D scene graphs from RGB input only, addressing both limitations. The proposed approach unifies perception and planning around a shared structured representation that captures object semantics, 3D geometry, relational context, and information from multiple viewpoints. Because the framework is hardware-agnostic and relies only on RGB observations, it can incorporate inputs from both onboard robot cameras and fixed external cameras within the same representation. Experiments on the Replica dataset show that the RGB-only pipeline achieves F1-score parity with baselines using ground-truth depth. Active exploration experiments on ReplicaCAD further show that semantic-driven viewpoint selection detects more than twice as many objects as a geometric frontier-based baseline under the same exploration budget. Finally, the external-camera setting demonstrates that complementary RGB views can effectively bootstrap the scene graph and improve contextual understanding at no additional exploration cost.

item.title: SPATIOROUTE: Dynamic Prompt Routing for Zero-Shot Spatial Reasoning
item.author: Pawat Chunhachatrachai, Gueter Josmy Faure, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SpatioRoute的动态提示生成方法，用于在零样本设置下进行基于视频的3D空间问答。

背景: 基于视频的3D空间问答任务具有挑战性，要求视觉语言模型推理3D物体位置、场景功能性和方向关系，特别是在零样本设置下。

目的: 介绍SpatioRoute方法，通过动态提示生成路由每个问题到语义定制的提示模板，无需额外训练、微调或3D传感器输入。

方法: SpatioRoute有两种互补模式：SpatioRoute-R是基于规则的映射问题类型到专门模板；SpatioRoute-L是利用LLM从问题和情境生成任务特定提示。

主要发现: 在SQA3D基准测试中，SpatioRoute相比固定提示基线实现了高达5%的一致性整体准确率提升；在Qwen系列模型上，Chain-of-Thought提示导致性能下降，表明问题感知路由比统一推理指令更有效。

结论: SpatioRoute在无需3D点云输入的情况下建立了零样本视频空间VQA的新最高技术水平。

翻译: SpatioRoute是一种动态提示生成方法，无需训练、微调或3D传感器输入，通过规则和LLM驱动两种模式将问题路由到定制模板，在SQA3D基准上提升准确率，并证明问题感知路由优于统一推理指令。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Spatial question answering over egocentric video is a challenging task that requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to reason about 3D object positions, scene affordances, and directional relationships, particularly in the zero-shot setting where no task-specific fine-tuning is available. We introduce SpatioRoute, a dynamic prompt generation approach that routes each incoming question to a semantically tailored prompt template -- without any additional training, fine-tuning, or 3D sensor input. SpatioRoute operates in two complementary modes: SpatioRoute-R, a rule-based router that deterministically maps question typologies (e.g., What, Is, How, Can, Which) to specialized prompt templates; and SpatioRoute-L, an LLM-driven approach that generates task-specific prompts from the question and situational context alone, with no video input at routing time. We evaluate SpatioRoute on the SQA3D benchmark across VLMs spanning model families. SpatioRoute achieves consistent overall accuracy gains up to 5% over fixed prompt baselines, establishing a new state-of-the-art for zero-shot video-only spatial VQA without requiring 3D point-cloud inputs. As an additional finding, we observe that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, implemented via the Think it Twice architecture, consistently degrades performance in this setting on Qwen series models, confirming that question-aware routing is more effective than uniform reasoning instructions for spatial video understanding.

item.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos
item.author: X. Feng, J. Zhu, M. Wu, C. Chen, F. Mao, H. Guo, J. Wu, X. Chu, K. Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MIGA是一种无需训练的长视频生成方法，通过两阶段对齐机制和双一致性增强机制，在VBench和NarrLV数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

背景: 现有的train-free长视频生成方法如FIFO-diffusion虽然能生成无限长视频且内存消耗恒定，但存在训练与推理不匹配以及难以维持长期一致性的问题。

目的: 提出MIGA方法，以减少训练与推理之间的差距，并提高生成视频的长期一致性。

方法: MIGA包含两个主要机制：1. 两阶段对齐机制，通过减少输入模型的过度噪声跨度来缓解训练与推理的差距；2. 双一致性增强机制，包括自我反思方法纠正早期高噪声帧，以及长范围帧引导方法利用后期低噪声帧的广泛覆盖来引导生成。

主要发现: 在VBench和NarrLV数据集上的广泛实验表明，MIGA具有最先进的性能。

结论: MIGA是一种有效的无限帧长视频生成方法，显著改善了视频生成的长期一致性。

翻译: 在不产生显著计算开销的情况下，train-free长视频生成旨在使基础视频生成模型能够生成更长的视频。帧级自回归框架，如FIFO-diffusion，具有生成无限长视频且内存消耗恒定的优势。然而，训练与推理之间的不匹配，加上维持长期一致性的挑战，限制了基础模型的有效利用。为了缓解这些担忧，我们提出了MIGA，一种新颖的无限帧长视频生成方法。首先，我们提出了一种有效的两阶段对齐机制，通过减少输入模型的过度噪声跨度来缓解训练与推理的差距。然后，我们引入了一种创新的双一致性增强机制，其中自我反思方法纠正早期高噪声帧，长范围帧引导方法利用后期低噪声帧的广泛覆盖来引导生成，共同提高时间一致性。在VBench和NarrLV上的广泛实验证明了MIGA的最先进性能。我们的项目页面可在https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/miga_homepage/上获得。

Abstract

Without incurring significant computational overhead, train-free long video generation aims to enable foundation video generation models to produce longer videos. Frame-level autoregressive frameworks, e.g., FIFO-diffusion, offer the advantage of generating infinitely long videos with constant memory consumption. However, the mismatch between training and inference, coupled with the challenge of maintaining long-term consistency, limits the effective utilization of foundation models. To mitigate these concerns, we propose \textbf{MIGA}, a novel infinite-frame long video generation method. Firstly, we propose an effective two-stage alignment mechanism that mitigates the training-inference gap by reducing the excessive noise span fed to the model. We then introduce an innovative dual consistency enhancement mechanism, where the self-reflection approach corrects early high-noise frames and the long-range frame guidance approach leverages later low-noise frames with broad coverage to steer generation, jointly improving temporal consistency. Extensive experiments on VBench and NarrLV demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of MIGA. Our project page is available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/miga_homepage/.

item.title: CodeBind: Decoupled Representation Learning for Multimodal Alignment with Unified Compositional Codebook
item.author: Zeyu Chen, Jie Li, Kai Han
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CodeBind是一种通过模态共享特定码本设计优化多模态表示空间的框架，通过增量对齐目标模态和桥接模态，分解特征为共享组件和特定组件，利用组合向量量化方案实现语义一致性和模态独特细节，并在九种模态上实现了最先进的性能。

背景: 多模态表示对齐对大型语言模型和机器人技术至关重要，但传统方法因跨模态信息差异和数据稀缺而受限，导致对齐空间次优，且忽略了模态独特特征。

目的: 提出CodeBind框架，通过模态共享特定码本设计优化多模态表示空间，绕过完全配对数据的需求，分解特征以实现语义一致性和模态独特细节。

方法: CodeBind采用增量对齐目标模态和桥接模态的方法，分解特征为共享组件和特定组件，利用组合向量量化方案，其中共享码本桥接模态间隙，特定码本减轻表示偏差。

主要发现: 在九种模态（文本、图像、视频、音频、深度、热成像、触觉、3D点云、EEG）上验证，CodeBind在多模态分类和检索任务中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: CodeBind通过其独特的码本设计和特征分解方法，有效解决了传统方法中的跨模态信息差异和数据稀缺问题，实现了更优的多模态表示对齐。

翻译: 多模态表示对齐对大型语言模型和机器人技术至关重要。传统方法往往受限于跨模态信息差异和数据稀缺，导致对齐空间次优，忽略了模态独特特征。我们提出CodeBind，一种通过模态共享特定码本设计优化多模态表示空间的框架。通过增量对齐目标模态和桥接模态，CodeBind绕过了对完全配对数据的需求。与传统的硬对齐不同，CodeBind将特征分解为共享组件以实现语义一致性，以及特定组件以保留模态独特细节。该设计利用组合向量量化方案，其中共享码本桥接模态间隙，特定码本减轻表示偏差，防止主导模态掩盖其他模态。在九种模态（文本、图像、视频、音频、深度、热成像、触觉、3D点云、EEG）上验证，CodeBind在多模态分类和检索任务中实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

Multimodal representation alignment is pivotal for large language models and robotics. Traditional methods are often hindered by cross-modal information discrepancies and data scarcity, leading to suboptimal alignment spaces that overlook modality-unique features. We propose CodeBind, a framework that optimizes multimodal representation spaces through a modality-shared-specific codebook design. By incrementally aligning target and bridging modalities, CodeBind bypasses the need for fully paired data. Unlike traditional hard alignment, CodeBind decomposes features into shared components for semantic consistency and specific components for modality-unique details. This design utilizes a compositional vector quantization scheme, where a shared codebook bridges modality gaps and modality-specific codebooks mitigate representation bias by preventing dominant modalities from overshadowing others. Validated across nine modalities (text, image, video, audio, depth, thermal, tactile, 3D point cloud, EEG), CodeBind achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal classification and retrieval tasks.

item.title: Geometric Dictionary Learning of Dynamical Systems with Optimal Transport
item.author: Thibaut Germain, Sami Chemlal, Rémi Flamary, Vladimir R. Kostic, Karim Lounici
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DOODL框架通过学习特征谱动力学的字典来近似相关动力系统的低维流形，从而实现紧凑且可解释的嵌入，并在短轨迹和部分观测下实现快速可解释的算子估计。

背景: 算子理论表示为分析复杂动力学提供了强大框架，但通常每个系统独立估计算子，阻碍了相关动力学间共享结构的发现。

目的: 提出DOODL框架，旨在学习特征谱动力学的字典，使其组合近似相关动力系统在谱算子空间中的低维流形，从而实现紧凑、可解释的嵌入。

方法: DOODL框架基于相关动力系统位于谱算子空间低维流形附近的假设，通过学习特征谱动力学的字典来近似该流形，并约束估计以该学习到的算子流形为基础。

主要发现: 在亚稳态朗之万动力学和湍流等离子体模拟的实验中，DOODL在高度复杂的多尺度范围内表现出色，能够捕获支配动力学的特征谱结构而非仅仅拟合轨迹，在具有挑战性的低数据条件下，误差比独立算子估计方法低一到两个数量级。

结论: DOODL能够从短轨迹和部分观测中实现快速且可解释的算子估计，在处理复杂动力学时优于独立估计方法。

翻译: 通过算子理论表示学习动力系统为分析复杂动力学提供了强大框架，因为特征值和不变结构等谱量编码了特征时间尺度和长期行为。然而，动力算子通常针对每个系统独立估计，阻碍了相关动力学间共享结构的发现。为解决这一局限性，我们假设相关动力系统位于谱算子空间中的低维流形附近。基于这一假设，我们引入了DOODL，这是一个学习特征谱动力学字典的框架，其组合近似该流形并产生单个系统的紧凑、可解释的嵌入。除了表示学习外，DOODL通过将估计约束在学习到的算子流形上，从短轨迹和部分观测轨迹中实现快速且可解释的算子估计。在亚稳态朗之万动力学和湍流等离子体模拟上的实验表明，DOODL能够扩展到高度复杂的多尺度范围，同时捕获支配动力学的特征谱结构而不仅仅是拟合轨迹，在具有挑战性的低数据条件下，误差比独立算子估计方法低一到两个数量级。

Abstract

Learning dynamical systems through operator-theoretic representations provides a powerful framework for analyzing complex dynamics, as spectral quantities such as eigenvalues and invariant structures encode characteristic time scales and long-term behavior. However, dynamical operators are typically estimated independently for each system, preventing the discovery of shared structure across related dynamics. To address this limitation, we posit that related dynamical systems lie near a low-dimensional manifold in spectral operator space. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce DOODL (Dynamical OperatOr Dictionary Learning), a framework that learns a dictionary of characteristic spectral dynamics whose combinations approximate this manifold and yield compact, interpretable embeddings of individual systems. Beyond representation learning, DOODL enables fast and interpretable operator estimation from short and partially observed trajectories by constraining the estimation to the learned operator manifold. Experiments on metastable Langevin dynamics and turbulent plasma simulations demonstrate that DOODL scales to highly complex multiscale regimes while capturing characteristic spectral structure governing the dynamics rather than merely fitting trajectories, achieving errors one to two orders of magnitude lower than independent operator estimation methods in challenging low-data regimes.

item.title: StableVLA: Towards Robust Vision-Language-Action Models without Extra Data
item.author: Fu, Yiyang, Zhang, Chubin, Gong, Shukai, Deng, Yufan, Sun, Kaiwei, Min, Qiyang, Hou, Qibin, Tang, Yansong, Wang, Jianan, Zhou, Daquan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型在未见过的视觉干扰下的鲁棒性问题，提出了一种轻量级的信息瓶颈适配器（IB-Adapter）以提升模型性能。

背景: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型难以涵盖所有可能的训练数据，导致在遇到未见过的真实世界视觉干扰（特别是在视觉条件不完美的情况下）时性能显著下降。

目的: 为了缓解这一问题，提出一种轻量级适配器模块，旨在从视觉输入中选择性地过滤潜在噪声，从而提高模型的鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了一种基于信息论的信息瓶颈适配器（IB-Adapter），它不需要额外的数据或增强策略，仅通过过滤视觉输入中的噪声来工作。

主要发现: IB-Adapter在无需额外数据或增强策略的情况下，平均提升了30%的性能，且参数量少于1000万；在更小的骨干网络（0.5B参数）且未在Open X-Embodiment数据集上预训练的情况下，模型StableVLA在鲁棒性上可与7B规模的先进VLA模型相媲美。

结论: 该方法在参数开销可忽略不计的情况下，保持了长时域任务的准确性，并在合成和物理视觉损坏下均优于OpenPi。

翻译: 摘要：不可能在训练数据集中涵盖所有可能的干扰。这引发了一个关于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在遇到未见过的真实世界视觉干扰时的鲁棒性的关键问题，特别是在视觉条件不完美的情况下。在这项工作中，我们基于最近的先进VLA模型进行了一项系统研究，并揭示了在引入训练数据中不存在的视觉干扰时性能显著下降。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种基于信息论的轻量级适配器模块，称为信息瓶颈适配器（IB-Adapter），它从视觉输入中选择性地过滤潜在噪声。无需任何额外数据或增强策略，IB-Adapter平均比基线提高了30%，且参数少于1000万，证明了显著的效率和有效性。此外，即使拥有14倍更小的骨干网络（0.5B参数）且未在Open X-Embodiment数据集上预训练，我们的模型StableVLA在鲁棒性上也能与7B规模的先进VLA模型相竞争。在参数开销可忽略不计的情况下，我们的方法在长时域任务上保持了准确性，并在合成和物理视觉损坏下均优于OpenPi。

Abstract

It is infeasible to encompass all possible disturbances within the training dataset. This raises a critical question regarding the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models when encountering unseen real-world visual disturbances, particularly under imperfect visual conditions. In this work, we conduct a systematic study based on recent state-of-the-art VLA models and reveal a significant performance drop when visual disturbances absent from the training data are introduced. To mitigate this issue, we propose a lightweight adapter module grounded in information theory, termed the Information Bottleneck Adapter (IB-Adapter), which selectively filters potential noise from visual inputs. Without requiring any extra data or augmentation strategies, IB-Adapter consistently improves over the baseline by an average of 30%, while adding fewer than 10M parameters, demonstrating notable efficiency and effectiveness. Furthermore, even with a 14x smaller backbone (0.5B parameters) and no pre-training on the Open X-Embodiment dataset, our model StableVLA achieves robustness competitive with 7B-scale state-of-the-art VLAs. With negligible parameter overhead (<10M), our approach maintains accuracy on long-horizon tasks and surpasses OpenPi under both synthetic and physical visual corruptions.

item.title: DARE-EEG: A Foundation Model for Mining Dual-Aligned Representation of EEG
item.author: Yang Shao, Peiliang Gong, Qun Dai, Daoqiang Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DARE-EEG是一种自监督基础模型，通过双重对齐表示学习在预训练期间显式强制执行掩码不变性，并采用卷积线性探测策略来适应不同的电极配置和采样率。

背景: 现有的EEG编码器在处理信号不同掩码视图重叠较少的不完整观察时，难以约束它们到一致的潜在子空间，导致迁移能力下降。

目的: 提出DARE-EEG，通过预训练期间的双重对齐表示学习显式强制执行掩码不变性，并解决不同电极配置和采样率的适应性问题。

方法: 引入掩码对齐，通过对比学习约束来自同一EEG样本多个掩码视图的表示；引入锚点对齐，将掩码表示与动量更新的完整特征对齐以实现语义稳定性；提出卷积线性探测，通过解耦的频谱空间投影实现参数高效适应。

主要发现: DARE-EEG在多样化的EEG基准测试中始终达到最先进的准确率性能，同时保持相对较低的参数复杂性和优越的跨数据集可移植性，并有效发现和利用了EEG中丰富的潜在表示。

结论: DARE-EEG在准确率、参数复杂性和跨数据集可移植性方面均优于现有方法，证明了其在发现和利用EEG丰富潜在表示方面的有效性。

翻译: 通过大规模EEG数据上的掩码重建进行预训练的基础模型已成为一种有前景的范式，用于学习跨各种脑机接口应用的通用神经表示。然而，一个关键但被忽视的挑战是EEG编码器必须学习对不完整观察不变的表示——当同一信号的不同掩码视图重叠很少时，现有方法无法将它们约束到一致的潜在子空间，导致迁移能力下降。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DARE-EEG，一种自监督基础模型，它在预训练期间通过双重对齐表示学习显式地强制执行掩码不变性。具体而言，我们引入了掩码对齐，通过对比学习约束来自同一EEG样本多个掩码视图的表示，补充了锚点对齐，将掩码表示与动量更新的完整特征对齐以实现语义稳定性。此外，我们提出了卷积线性探测，这是一种参数高效的策略，通过解耦的频谱空间投影将预训练的表示适应到异构的电极配置和采样率。在多样化的EEG基准测试中的广泛实验表明，DARE-EEG始终在准确率性能方面达到最先进水平，同时保持相对较低的参数复杂性和优越的跨数据集可移植性，与现有方法相比。此外，DARE-EEG有助于有效地发现和利用EEG中丰富的潜在表示。

Abstract

Foundation models pre-trained through masked reconstruction on large-scale EEG data have emerged as a promising paradigm for learning generalizable neural representations across diverse brain-computer interface applications. However, a critical yet overlooked challenge is that EEG encoders must learn representations invariant to incomplete observations-when different masked views of the same signal have minimal overlap, existing methods fail to constrain them to a consistent latent subspace, leading to degraded transferability. To address this, we propose DARE-EEG, a self-supervised foundation model that explicitly enforces the mask-invariance property through dual-aligned representation learning during pre-training. Specifically, we introduce mask alignment that constrains representations from multiple masked views of the same EEG sample via contrastive learning, complementing anchor alignment that aligns masked representations to momentum-updated complete features for semantic stability. Additionally, we propose conv-linear-probing, a parameter-efficient strategy that adapts pre-trained representations to heterogeneous electrode configurations and sampling rates through decoupled spectro-spatial projections. Extensive experiments across diverse EEG benchmarks demonstrate that DARE-EEG consistently achieves state-of-the-art in accuracy performance while maintaining relatively low parameter complexity and superior cross-dataset portability compared to existing methods. Furthermore, DARE-EEG contributes to effectively discovering and utilizing the rich potential representations in EEG.

item.title: Attention-based PCA
item.author: Rodrigo Maulen-Soto, Claire Boyer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文通过主成分分析这一无监督问题研究注意力机制，发现softmax和线性注意力层在训练高斯数据时，其参数与协方差矩阵的主特征向量对齐，从而与PCA建立了直接联系。

背景: 通过主成分分析这一无监督问题的视角来研究注意力机制。

目的: 建立注意力机制与主成分分析之间的直接联系，并分析其在不同设置下的表现。

方法: 对高斯数据训练的softmax和线性注意力层进行有限和无限提示设置下的分析，并在高斯Wishart协方差矩阵的上下文设置中进行了扩展。

主要发现: 在无限提示极限下，注意力机制收敛到与主导谱方向对齐的全局最优解；在有限提示设置下，采样效应下出现相同行为；在上下文设置中，注意力成功恢复底层信号方向。

结论: 注意力机制在无监督目标下本质上执行类似PCA的计算，为其表示学习能力提供了理论基础。

翻译: We study attention mechanisms through the lens of a canonical unsupervised problem: principal component analysis (PCA). We show that, when trained on Gaussian data, both softmax and linear attention layers learn parameters that align with the principal eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, thereby establishing a direct and explicit connection with PCA. Our analysis covers both finite and infinite prompt regimes. In the infinite-prompt limit, we prove convergence to globally optimal solutions aligned with the leading spectral direction, while in the finiteprompt setting we show that the same behavior emerges up to sampling effects. We further extend the analysis to an in-context setting with spiked Wishart covariances, where attention successfully recovers the underlying signal direction. These results demonstrate that attention inherently performs PCA-like computations under unsupervised objectives, providing a theoretical foundation for its representation-learning capabilities.

Abstract

We study attention mechanisms through the lens of a canonical unsupervised problem: principal component analysis (PCA). We show that, when trained on Gaussian data, both softmax and linear attention layers learn parameters that align with the principal eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, thereby establishing a direct and explicit connection with PCA. Our analysis covers both finite and infinite prompt regimes. In the infinite-prompt limit, we prove convergence to globally optimal solutions aligned with the leading spectral direction, while in the finiteprompt setting we show that the same behavior emerges up to sampling effects. We further extend the analysis to an in-context setting with spiked Wishart covariances, where attention successfully recovers the underlying signal direction. These results demonstrate that attention inherently performs PCA-like computations under unsupervised objectives, providing a theoretical foundation for its representation-learning capabilities.

item.title: QSTRBench: a New Benchmark to Evaluate the Ability of Language Models to Reason with Qualitative Spatial and Temporal Calculi
item.author: Anthony G. Cohn, Robert E. Blackwell
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出并发布了一个用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛定性空间和时间推理（QSTR）基准测试。该基准测试涵盖了多种时空推理演算，包括点代数、艾伦区间代数、区间和持续时间（INDU）、区域连接演算（RCC-5、RCC-8、RCC-22）、九交模型、方向代数和STAR。基准测试系统性地变化了问题的呈现方式，包括前缀/后缀、词语/符号/临时术语以及所选演算的图解描述。

背景: 为了评估大语言模型在定性空间和时间推理方面的能力。

目的: 构建一个广泛的定性空间和时间推理基准测试，以评估大语言模型的表现。

方法: 构建了一个包含多种时空推理演算的基准测试，包括点代数、艾伦区间代数、区间和持续时间、区域连接演算（RCC-5、RCC-8、RCC-22）、九交模型、方向代数和STAR。基准测试系统性地变化了问题的呈现方式，包括前缀/后缀、词语/符号/临时术语以及图解描述。

主要发现: 所有测试的模型表现都优于随机猜测，但没有模型能 consistently 正确回答所有问题。性能因演算而异，点代数最简单，RCC-22最难。

结论: RCC-22的邻域概念是首次发布。基准测试和结果已以开放许可发布，以促进对LLMs中定性时空推理的进一步评估。

翻译: 我们介绍了一个用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛定性空间和时间推理（QSTR）基准测试。我们提出了关于组合推理（使用组合表，CT）、逆关系和概念邻域（CN）的QSTR演算问题，包括点代数（PA）、艾伦区间代数、区间和持续时间（INDU）、区域连接演算（RCC-5、RCC-8和RCC-22）、九交模型、方向代数和STAR。RCC-22的CN是首次在此发布。一个扩展的基准测试系统地变化了问题呈现，包括前缀/后缀、词语/符号/临时术语以及所选演算的图解描述。我们报告了当代前沿模型的结果。所有测试的模型表现都优于猜测，但没有模型能 consistently 正确回答所有问题。性能因演算而异，PA最简单，RCC-22最难。我们以开放许可发布了基准测试和我们的结果，以促进对LLMs中定性时空推理的进一步评估。

Abstract

We introduce an extensive qualitative spatial and temporal reasoning (QSTR) benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs). We pose questions concerning compositional reasoning (using composition tables, CT), converse relations, and conceptual neighbourhoods (CN) for QSTR calculi, Point Algebra (PA), Allen's Interval Algebra, Interval and Duration (INDU), Region Connection Calculus (RCC-5, RCC-8, and RCC-22), the nine intersection model, cardinal direction calculus, and STAR. The RCC-22 CN is published here for the first time. An extended benchmark systematically varies question presentation including prefix/infix, words/symbols/nonce terms and schematic descriptions for selected calculi. We report results for contemporary frontier models. All models tested perform better than guessing but none can consistently answer all questions correctly. Performance varies sharply by calculus, with PA being the most straightforward, and RCC-22 the most difficult. We release the benchmark, and our results under an open licence to facilitate further assessment of qualitative spatio/temporal reasoning in LLMs.

item.title: TabH2O: A Unified Foundation Model for Tabular Prediction
item.author: Pascal Pfeiffer, Dmitry Gordeev, Mathias Müller, Laura Fink, Joan Salvà Soler, Mark Landry, Branden Murray, Marcos V. Conde, Sri Satish Ambati
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TabH2O是一个基于表格数据的单一前向传递模型，通过上下文学习同时执行分类和回归任务。

背景: TabH2O建立在TabICL架构基础上，旨在解决表格数据处理的挑战。

目的: 开发一个统一的模型架构，能够同时处理分类和回归任务，并提高训练效率和稳定性。

方法: 1. 统一训练：采用双头架构，单一模型处理分类和回归；2. 单阶段预训练：通过改进训练稳定性技术（如有界可扩展softmax、跨阶段归一化等）实现；3. 噪声感知预训练：在合成数据集中包含显式噪声维度以增强模型鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在TALENT基准测试（300个数据集）上，TabH2O v1（29.2M参数）平均排名为2.55，优于调整后的CatBoost（4.07）、H2O AutoML（4.18）和LightGBM（5.08），与TabPFN v2.6（2.74）竞争，但略低于TabICL v2（2.12）。

结论: TabH2O在81%的测试数据集上排名前3，性能表现良好，证明了其作为表格数据基础模型的潜力。

翻译: 我们提出了TabH2O，这是一个基于表格数据的统一模型，通过上下文学习在单次前向传递中同时执行分类和回归任务。TabH2O在TabICL架构基础上进行了多项关键改进：(1)统一训练，单一模型通过双头架构同时处理分类和回归，消除了对单独模型的需求并降低了总预训练成本；(2)单阶段预训练，通过训练稳定性改进（有界可扩展softmax、跨阶段归一化、可学习残差缩放、logit软截断）消除了对多阶段课程学习的需求，使模型能够从一开始就使用完整序列进行训练；(3)噪声感知预训练，合成数据集包含显式噪声维度，教导模型对无关特征的鲁棒性。我们在TALENT基准测试（300个数据集）上评估了TabH2O v1（29.2M参数），其平均排名为6种评估方法中的2.55，优于调整后的CatBoost（4.07）、H2O AutoML（4.18）和LightGBM（5.08），与TabPFN v2.6（2.74）竞争，但略低于TabICL v2（2.12），同时在分类和回归任务的81%的测试数据集上排名前3。

Abstract

We present TabH2O, a foundation model for tabular data that performs classification and regression in a single forward pass via in-context learning. TabH2O builds on the TabICL architecture with several key modifications: (1) unified training, a single model handles both classification and regression via a dual-head architecture, eliminating the need for separate models and reducing total pretraining cost; (2) single-stage pretraining, training stability improvements (bounded scalable softmax, inter-stage normalization, learnable residual scaling, logit soft-capping) eliminate the need for multi-stage curriculum learning, enabling training with full-length sequences from the start; and (3) noise-aware pretraining, synthetic datasets include explicit noise dimensions to teach the model robustness to irrelevant features. We evaluate TabH2O v1 (29.2M parameters) on the TALENT benchmark (300 datasets), where it achieves an average rank of 2.55 out of 6 evaluated methods, outperforming tuned CatBoost (4.07), H2O AutoML (4.18), and LightGBM (5.08), competitive with TabPFN v2.6 (2.74), and behind TabICL v2 (2.12), while placing in the top-3 on 81% of the testing datasets across classification and regression tasks.

item.title: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization
item.author: Stefano Carotti, Marco Pacini, Alessio Gravina, Davide Bacciu, Bruno Lepri, Sebastiano Bontorin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) 和 Graph Transformers (GTs) 是图学习的基础范式，但存在捕捉图中远距离区域之间相关性时的局限性。Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR) 是一种新框架，通过在输入图和通过池化获得的分层抽象上联合操作来解决这一问题。

背景: 现有的 GNNs 和 GTs 虽然结合了深度模型的表示学习能力和样本效率，但在捕捉图中远距离区域相关性方面存在根本性限制。此外，这些模型在超出范围泛化方面的问题更为明显，即测试实例涉及比训练期间观察到的距离更长的交互。

目的: 介绍 Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR) 框架，以解决现有模型在捕捉图中远距离区域相关性以及超出范围泛化方面的局限性。

方法: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR) 框架，该框架在输入图和通过池化获得的分层抽象上联合操作。

主要发现: GHR 提供了三个关键优势：在长距离依赖任务中表现强劲，改善了超出范围泛化，并且参数效率高。在广泛的长期依赖基准测试中，GHR 优于现有图模型，同时仅使用当前最先进模型参数的 1%。

结论: 这些结果表明，增加模型容量本身可能不足以实现泛化，这为当前通过扩展架构以获得图基础模型的趋势提供了一个互补方向。

翻译: 图神经网络和图 Transformer 现在是图学习的基础范式，结合了深度模型的表示学习能力和由其归纳偏置引起的样本效率。尽管它们很有效，但大量工作表明，这些模型在需要捕捉图中远距离区域之间相关性的任务中仍然面临根本性限制。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR)，一个在输入图和通过池化获得的分层抽象上联合操作的全新框架。我们还表明，现有模型的限制在超出范围泛化中更为明显，其中测试实例涉及比训练期间观察到的距离更长的交互。相比之下，尽管设计简单，GHR 提供了三个关键优势：在长距离依赖方面表现强劲，改善了超出范围泛化，并且参数效率高。为了证实这些主张，我们表明在广泛的长期依赖基准测试中，GHR 始终优于现有图模型，同时仅使用当前最先进模型参数的 1%。这些结果表明，增加模型容量本身可能不足以实现泛化，这为当前通过扩展架构以获得图基础模型的趋势提供了一个互补方向。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Transformers (GTs) are now a fundamental paradigm for graph learning, combining the representation-learning capabilities of deep models with the sample efficiency induced by their inductive biases. Despite their effectiveness, a large body of work has shown that these models still face fundamental limitations in tasks that require capturing correlations between distant regions of a graph. To address this issue, we introduce Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a novel framework that operates jointly on the input graph and on a hierarchical abstraction obtained through pooling. We also show that the limitations of existing models are even more pronounced in out-of-range generalization, where test instances involve interactions over distances longer than those observed during training. By contrast, despite its simple design, GHR provides three key advantages: strong performance on long-range dependencies, improved out-of-range generalization, and high parameter efficiency. To corroborate these claims, we show that across a broad set of long-range benchmarks, GHR consistently outperforms existing graph models while using as little as 1% of the parameters of current state-of-the-art models. These results suggest a complementary direction to the current trend of scaling architectures to obtain graph foundation models, indicating that increased model capacity alone may not be sufficient for generalization.

item.title: Vision Foundation Models as Generalist Tokenizers for Image Generation
item.author: Anlin Zheng, Qi Han, Xin Wen, Chuofan Ma, Lanxi Gong, Gang Yu, Xiangyu Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探索了在冻结视觉基础模型上构建通用图像分词器的方向，提出了VFMTok方法，该方法通过区域自适应量化和语义重建目标，在离散和连续潜在空间中均实现了高质量的图像生成和高效的分词效率。

背景: 该研究关注构建通用图像分词器的方向，该分词器直接建立在冻结的视觉基础模型之上，这是 largely unexplored 的方向。

目的: 构建一个通用视觉分词器，使其能够无缝地在离散和连续潜在空间中操作，同时提高合成质量和分词效率。

方法: 利用冻结的视觉基础模型作为编码器，引入区域自适应量化框架以消除标准二维网格特征中的空间冗余，以及语义重建目标以使解码输出与视觉基础模型的表示对齐。

主要发现: VFMTok在离散自回归生成中加速模型收敛3倍，在ImageNet类条件合成上达到1.36的gFID；在连续空间生成中与去噪模型集成达到1.25的gFID；且无需分类器自由引导即可实现高保真类条件合成。此外，发现视觉基础模型的自监督学习目标决定了其作为分词器的有效性，特别是联合优化全局对比学习和潜在掩码图像建模的模型提供了最佳表示。

结论: VFMTok在图像生成任务中表现出色，且揭示了视觉基础模型的自监督学习目标对图像分词器设计的重要性，为未来图像分词器的设计提供了指导。

翻译: 本文探索了在冻结视觉基础模型上构建通用图像分词器的方向，提出了VFMTok方法，该方法通过区域自适应量化和语义重建目标，在离散和连续潜在空间中均实现了高质量的图像生成和高效的分词效率。

Abstract

In this work, we explore the largely unexplored direction of building a generalist image tokenizer directly on top of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM). To build this tokenizer, we utilize a frozen VFM as the encoder and introduce two key innovations: (1) a region-adaptive quantization framework to eliminate spatial redundancy in standard 2D grid features, and (2) a semantic reconstruction objective that aligns the decoded outputs with the VFM's representations to preserve semantic fidelity. Grounded in these designs, we propose VFMTok, a generalist visual tokenizer capable of operating seamlessly in both discrete and continuous latent spaces. VFMTok achieves substantial improvements in synthesis quality while drastically enhancing token efficiency. For discrete autoregressive (AR) generation, it accelerates model convergence by \textbf{3 times} and achieves a state-of-the-art gFID of \textbf{1.36} on ImageNet class-conditional synthesis. Similarly, for continuous-space generation, integrating VFMTok with a denoising model yields an exceptional gFID of \textbf{1.25}. Furthermore, because the latent space inherently captures rich spatial semantics, VFMTok enables high-fidelity class-conditional synthesis without classifier-free guidance (\textbf{w/o CFG}) across both generative paradigms, significantly accelerating inference speed. Beyond these remarkable empirical results, we systematically investigate the underlying mechanisms of our approach. We discover that the specific self-supervised learning objectives utilized during VFM pre-training dictate its effectiveness as a tokenizer. Specifically, a VFM jointly optimized with global contrastive learning and latent masked image modeling provides the optimal representations for image tokenization. These insights establish a strong foundation and offer valuable guidance for the design of future image tokenizers.

item.title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
item.author: Liu, Hongyi, Yang, Haoyan, Jiang, Tao, Tang, Bo, Xiong, Feiyu, Li, Zhiyu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SkillsVote是一个用于Agent Skills生命周期管理的框架，旨在解决原始轨迹噪声大、难以管理的问题。

背景: Long-horizon LLM agents留下的痕迹可能成为可重用的经验，但原始轨迹存在噪声且难以治理。开放技能生态系统包含冗余、不均匀和环境敏感的工件，盲目更新会污染未来上下文。

目的: 提出SkillsVote框架，对Agent Skills进行从收集、推荐到演进的整个生命周期治理。

方法: SkillsVote首先对百万级开源语料库进行环境要求、质量和可验证性分析，然后合成可验证技能任务。执行前进行结构化技能库的智能体库搜索以暴露指导性技能上下文。执行后，将轨迹分解为技能关联的子任务，将结果归因于技能使用、智能体探索、环境和结果信号，并仅将成功的可重用发现纳入证据门控更新。

主要发现: 离线进化使GPT-5.2在Terminal-Bench 2.0上提高了最多7.9个百分点，在线进化使SWE-Bench Pro提高了最多2.6个百分点。

结论: 受控的外部技能库可以在不更新模型的情况下提高冻结智能体，前提是系统控制了暴露、信用和保存。

翻译: Long-horizon LLM agents留下的痕迹可能成为可重用的经验，但原始轨迹存在噪声且难以治理。我们视Agent Skills为一种经验模式，它结合了可执行脚本和程序上的不可执行指导。然而，开放的技能生态系统包含冗余、不均匀和环境敏感的工件，不加区分的更新会污染未来上下文。我们提出了SkillsVote，这是一个用于Agent Skills从收集、推荐到演进的整个生命周期治理的框架。SkillsVote对百万级开源语料库进行环境要求、质量和可验证性分析，然后合成可验证技能的任务。在执行之前，SkillsVote在结构化技能库上进行智能体库搜索以暴露指导性技能上下文。执行后，它将轨迹分解为技能关联的子任务，将结果归因于技能使用、智能体探索、环境和结果信号，并仅将成功的可重用发现纳入证据门控更新。在我们的评估中，离线进化使GPT-5.2在Terminal-Bench 2.0上提高了最多7.9个百分点，而在线进化使SWE-Bench Pro提高了最多2.6个百分点。总体而言，受控的外部技能库可以在不更新模型的情况下提高冻结智能体，前提是系统控制了暴露、信用和保存。
