Abstract

Long-horizon LLM agents leave traces that could become reusable experience, but raw trajectories are noisy and hard to govern. We treat Agent Skills as an experience schema that couples executable scripts, with non-executable guidance on procedures. Yet open skill ecosystems contain redundant, uneven, environment-sensitive artifacts, and indiscriminate updates can pollute future context. We present SkillsVote, a lifecycle-governance framework for Agent Skills from collection and recommendation to evolution. SkillsVote profiles a million-scale open-source corpus for environment requirements, quality, and verifiability, then synthesizes tasks for verifiable skills. Before execution, SkillsVote performs agentic library search over structured skill library to expose instructional skill context. After execution, it decomposes trajectories into skill-linked subtasks, attributes outcomes to skill use, agent exploration, environment, and result signals, and admits only successful reusable discoveries to evidence-gated updates. In our evaluation, offline evolution improves GPT-5.2 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 by up to 7.9 pp, while online evolution improves SWE-Bench Pro by up to 2.6 pp. Overall, governed external skill libraries can improve frozen agents without model updates when systems control exposure, credit, and preservation.

item.title: Cracks in the Foundation: A Civil Infrastructure Dataset to Challenge Vision Foundation Models
item.author: Nicola Farronato, Niccolo Avogaro, Thomas Frick, Mattia Rigotti, Rizwan Ullah Khan, Michele Magno, Konrad Schindler, Cristiano Malossi, Florian Scheidegger
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Cracks in the Foundation (CiF)数据集，旨在解决土木基础设施缺陷分割中数据稀缺的问题，并揭示了当前视觉AI在密集图像理解方面的局限性。

背景: 自动化结构健康监测对防止基础设施灾难性故障至关重要。精确的像素级缺陷分割对于准确评估结构完整性至关重要，但当前进展因数据稀缺和算法固有障碍（如中心偏差和依赖形状）而受阻。

目的: 引入Cracks in the Foundation (CiF)数据集，这是迄今为止最大且最详细的土木基础设施实例分割数据集，以消除数据瓶颈。

方法: 通过五年的专家协作，精心策划了约150,000张高分辨率图像，构建了CiF数据集。

主要发现: 尽管出现了可提示的Foundation Models (FMs)和Vision Language Models (VLMs)，以及专用分割模型的出色能力，但在建筑环境中的密集图像理解仍未得到解决。最新的零-shot FMs在现实基础设施上面临重大挑战，且专用模型在特定监督下的性能在约25% mAP处趋于平缓。

结论: 土木基础设施检查被确立为一个开放挑战，揭示了主要在互联网图像上训练的当代模型的基本弱点，字面和隐喻地突显了当前Foundation Model范式中的缺陷。

翻译: 自动化结构健康监测对于防止基础设施灾难性故障至关重要。精确的像素级缺陷分割对于准确评估结构完整性是必要的，但由于数据极度稀缺且需要昂贵的专家标注，土木基础设施缺陷分割的进展受到了阻碍。算法固有的障碍（如中心偏差以及在检查几乎无纹理的建筑材料时更依赖形状）加剧了对数据的需求。为了消除这一瓶颈，我们介绍了Cracks in the Foundation (CiF)，这是迄今为止最大且最详细的土木基础设施实例分割数据集，包含约150,000张高分辨率图像，由土木工程专家在五年的协作中精心策划。借助这一前所未有的数据源，我们揭示了当前视觉AI的一个盲点：尽管可提示的Foundation Models (FMs)和Vision Language Models (VLMs)的出现，以及当今专用分割模型的令人印象深刻的性能，但在建筑环境中的密集图像理解实际上并未解决。我们的评估表明，即使是最近的零-shot FMs在现实基础设施上部署时也面临重大挑战，甚至特定监督的专用模型的性能也在约25% mAP处趋于平缓。CiF将土木基础设施检查——一个基本且看似简单的感知任务——确立为一个开放挑战，揭示了主要在互联网图像上训练的当代模型的基本弱点，字面和隐喻地突显了当前Foundation Model范式中的缺陷。

Abstract

Automated structural health monitoring is essential to prevent catastrophic infrastructure failures. Precise, pixel-level defect segmentation is needed to accurately assess structural integrity, but progress in defect segmentation for civil infrastructures has been held back by an extreme scarcity of data, which requires costly expert annotation. The need for data is accentuated by algorithmic hurdles intrinsic to the problem, including center-bias and the need to rely more on shape when inspecting nearly textureless building materials. To remove the bottleneck, we introduce Cracks in the Foundation (CiF), the largest and most detailed civil infrastructure (instance) segmentation dataset to date, comprising $\approx$150,000 high-resolution images meticulously curated over five years in collaboration with civil engineering experts. With the help of this unprecedented data source, we expose a blind spot of current visual AI: despite the advent of promptable Foundation Models (FMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs), and despite the impressive abilities of today's specialised segmentation models, it turns out that dense image understanding in the built environment is nowhere near solved. Our evaluations indicate that even the most recent zero-shot FMs face significant challenges when deployed on real-world infrastructure and even the performance of specialised models with domain-specific supervision plateaus at $\approx$25% mAP. CiF establishes inspection of civil infrastructure, an elementary and seemingly easy perceptual task, as an open challenge that reveals fundamental weaknesses of present-day models trained predominantly on internet images, literally and figuratively highlighting cracks in the current foundation model paradigm.

item.title: Seeing Together:Multi-Robot Cooperative Egocentric Spatial Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models
item.author: Kunyu Peng, Zhikun Zhou, Kailun Yang, Di Wen, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Junwei Zheng, Hao Shi, Yi Zhou, M. Saquib Sarfraz, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究多机器人协作动态空间推理问题，提出CoopSR基准和EgoTeam数据集，以及SP-CoR模型框架。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在自视点视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但其在多具身视点间进行协作推理的能力尚未被充分探索。

目的: 研究多机器人协作动态空间推理问题，即模型必须通过整合来自移动机器人团队的同步自视点视频来回答空间、时间、可见性和协调问题。

方法: 提出CoopSR基准和EgoTeam数据集，包含114,227对问答对；提出SP-CoR框架，结合动态感知多机器人帧采样、谱和物理引导的视图融合以及物理对齐提示蒸馏。

主要发现: SP-CoR在22个多模态大语言模型基线中持续提升协作推理能力，在Habitat上比最强微调基线提升3.87%，在iGibson上提升7.12%；在未见团队规模和真实机器人测试中表现出更强的泛化能力。

结论: SP-CoR框架能够在训练时利用机器人姿态监督，测试时仅需自视点视频，且在多个数据集和基线中均表现优异。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在自视点视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但其在多具身视点间进行协作推理的能力尚未被充分探索。我们通过多机器人协作动态空间推理研究这一问题，即模型必须通过整合来自移动机器人团队的同步自视点视频来回答空间、时间、可见性和协调问题。为了支持这一设置，我们介绍了CoopSR，这是该任务的第一个基准，以及EgoTeam，一个多机器人自视点问答数据集。EgoTeam包含114,227对问答对，涵盖Habitat和iGibson中的19种问题类型、四个难度等级和三种团队规模，以及约2,326个问答的真实世界测试集，这些问答是使用两个四足机器人收集的。我们进一步提出了SP-CoR（谱和物理信息协作推理器），这是一个用于细粒度协作空间推理的多模态大语言模型框架。SP-CoR结合了动态感知多机器人帧采样、谱和物理引导的视图融合以及物理对齐提示蒸馏，使模型能够在训练期间从机器人姿态监督中受益，而在测试时仅需自视点视频。在22个多模态大语言模型基线中，SP-CoR持续提升协作推理能力，在Habitet上比最强的微调基线提升3.87%，在iGibson上提升7.12%。它还显示出对未见团队规模和真实机器人测试的更强泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/KPeng9510/seeing-together.git找到。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决多机器人协作中的共视角空间推理问题，特别是利用多模态大语言模型来实现。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in egocentric video understanding, but their ability to reason cooperatively from multiple embodied viewpoints remains largely unexplored. We study this problem through multi-robot cooperative dynamic spatial reasoning, where a model must answer spatial, temporal, visibility, and coordination questions by integrating synchronized egocentric videos from a team of moving robots. To support this setting, we introduce CoopSR, the first benchmark for this task, together with EgoTeam, a multi-robot egocentric QA dataset. EgoTeam contains 114,227 QA pairs spanning 19 question types, four difficulty tiers, and three team sizes in Habitat and iGibson, along with a real-world test set of around 2,326 QAs collected using two quadruped robots. We further propose SP-CoR (Spectral and Physics-Informed Cooperative Reasoner), an MLLM framework for fine-grained cooperative spatial reasoning. SP-CoR combines dynamics-aware multi-robot frame sampling, spectral- and physics-guided view fusion, and physics-aligned prompt distillation, enabling the model to benefit from privileged robot-pose supervision during training while requiring only egocentric videos at test time. Across 22 MLLM baselines, SP-CoR consistently improves cooperative reasoning, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned baseline by +3.87% on Habitat and +7.12% on iGibson. It also shows stronger generalization to unseen team sizes and real-world robot tests. Code can be found at https://github.com/KPeng9510/seeing-together.git.

item.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis
item.author: Yang, Yixuan, Luo, Zhen, Gan, Wanshui, Hao, Jinkun, Lu, Junru, Yan, Jinghao, Lyu, Zhaoyang, Xu, Xudong
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为Code-as-Room的框架，用于从俯视图生成3D室内房间，通过结构化执行 harness 将3D房间表示为 Blender 代码，并引入了专门的基准测试。

背景: 设计逼真的3D室内房间对室内设计、虚拟现实、游戏和具身AI等应用至关重要。虽然基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法在从文本描述或参考图像合成3D房间方面显示出巨大潜力，但基于文本的方法难以捕捉精确的空间信息，而现有的基于图像的条件代理在从俯视图进行整体房间生成时 suffers from instability and infinite looping。

目的: 解决现有方法在捕捉精确空间信息和生成稳定性方面的局限性，提出一种新的框架来生成逼真且功能性的3D室内房间。

方法: 提出Code-as-Room，这是一个基于MLLM的代理框架，配备结构化执行 harness，使用 Blender 代码表示3D房间。给定俯视图房间图像，框架解析参考图像以提取场景元素及其空间关系，并在多阶段管道中合成可执行的 Blender 代码用于几何、材料和光照。引入跨阶段记忆模块以减轻代理框架中固有的上下文遗忘。还引入了基于代码的3D房间合成的专门基准测试。

主要发现: 基于基准测试，与现有的基于代理的方法进行了全面比较，验证了所提出的执行 harness 的有效性。

结论: Code-as-Room 框架通过结构化执行 harness 和跨阶段记忆模块有效解决了现有方法的局限性，能够生成逼真且功能性的3D室内房间。

翻译: 设计逼真且功能性的3D室内房间对于室内设计、虚拟现实、游戏和具身AI等广泛的应用至关重要。虽然最近基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法在从文本描述或参考图像合成3D房间方面显示出巨大潜力，但基于文本的方法难以捕捉精确的空间信息，现有的基于图像的条件代理在从俯视图进行整体房间生成时 suffers from instability and infinite looping。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Code-as-Room，这是一个基于MLLM的代理框架，配备结构化执行 harness，它使用 Blender 代码表示3D房间。给定俯视图房间图像，框架解析参考图像以提取场景元素及其空间关系，并在多阶段管道中合成可执行的 Blender 代码用于几何、材料和光照。整个过程中维护跨阶段记忆模块以减轻现有代理框架中固有的上下文遗忘。我们进一步引入了基于代码的3D房间合成的专门基准测试，包括各种评估协议。基于我们的基准测试，与现有的基于代理的方法进行了全面比较，以验证所提出的执行 harness 的有效性。

Abstract

Designing realistic and functional 3D indoor rooms is essential for a wide range of applications, including interior design, virtual reality, gaming, and embodied AI. While recent MLLM-based approaches have shown great potential for 3D room synthesis from textual descriptions or reference images, text-based methods struggle to capture precise spatial information, and existing image-conditioned agents suffer from instability and infinite looping when tasked with holistic room generation from top-down views. To address these limitations, we propose Code-as-Room, an MLLM-based agentic framework equipped with a structured execution harness, which represents 3D rooms with Blender codes. Given a top-down room image, the framework parses the reference image to extract scene elements and their spatial relationships, and synthesizes executable Blender code for geometry, materials, and lighting in a principled, multi-stage pipeline. A cross-stage memory module is maintained throughout to mitigate context forgetting inherent to existing agent-based frameworks. We further introduce a dedicated benchmark for code-based 3D room synthesis, encompassing various evaluation protocols. Based on our benchmark, comprehensive comparisons against existing agent-based methods are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our proposed execution harness.

item.title: OrganicHAR: Towards Activity Discovery in Organic Settings for Privacy Preserving Sensors Using Efficient Video Analysis
item.author: Prasoon Patidar, Riku Arakawa, Ricardo Graça, Rúben Moutinho, Adriano Soares, Ana Vasconcelos, Filippo Talami, Joana Couto da Silva, Inês Silva, Cristina Mendes Santos, Mayank Goel, Yuvraj Agarwal

来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为OrganicHAR的活动发现框架，通过将传感器能力置于活动发现中心，利用隐私保护传感器识别自然信号模式，仅在关键时刻使用视觉语言模型进行场景理解，从而发现离散的活动标签。

背景: 在家庭环境中部署人类活动识别仍然很少见，因为传感器信号在不同房屋、人员和时间之间变化剧烈，本质上需要现场数据收集和训练。

目的: 引入OrganicHAR框架，反转传统关系，将传感器能力置于活动发现中心，利用隐私保护传感器识别自然信号模式，仅在关键时刻使用视觉语言模型进行场景理解，发现离散的活动标签。

方法: 使用隐私保护传感器识别自然信号模式，仅在关键时刻利用视觉语言模型进行场景理解，发现离散的活动标签。

主要发现: 在12名参与者中，使用基本环境传感器（雷达、激光雷达、热成像阵列）时，粗粒度活动识别准确率为79%，加入可穿戴IMU、深度和姿态传感器时，细粒度活动识别准确率为73%。

结论: OrganicHAR在平均配置下保持77%的准确率，同时为每个用户发现4-8个类别（共15个），针对每个环境和传感器能力进行了定制。通过仅在局部传感器识别的关键时刻触发视频处理，将视觉语言模型的查询减少了90%，从而实现了自然环境中实用且隐私保护的活动识别。

翻译: 在家庭环境中部署人类活动识别仍然很少见，因为传感器信号在不同房屋、人员和时间之间变化剧烈，本质上需要现场数据收集和训练。先前的做法使用摄像头为隐私保护传感器生成训练标签，但这迫使传感器检测摄像头能看见但传感器本身无法可靠区分的预定义活动。在这项工作中，我们引入了OrganicHAR，一种活动发现框架，通过将传感器能力置于活动发现中心来反转这种关系。我们的方法使用隐私保护传感器识别自然信号模式，仅在关键时刻利用视觉语言模型进行场景理解，发现这些传感器可以可靠检测的离散活动标签。我们对12名参与者的评估证明了OrganicHAR的有效性：使用基本环境传感器（雷达、激光雷达、热成像阵列）时，粗粒度（4-5）活动准确率达到79%，加入可穿戴IMU、深度和姿态传感器时，细粒度（8-9）活动准确率达到73%。OrganicHAR在平均配置下保持77%的准确率，同时为每个用户发现4-8个类别（共15个），针对每个环境和传感器能力进行了定制。通过仅在局部传感器识别的关键时刻触发视频处理，我们将视觉语言模型的查询减少了90%，从而实现了自然环境中实用且隐私保护的活动识别。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Deploying human activity recognition (HAR) at home is still rare because sensor signals vary wildly across houses, people, and time, essentially requiring in-situ data collection and training. Prior approaches use cameras to generate training labels for privacy-preserving sensors (LiDAR, RADAR, Thermal), but this forces sensors to detect predefined activities that cameras can see yet the sensors themselves cannot reliably distinguish. In this work, we introduce OrganicHAR, an activity discovery framework that inverts this relationship by placing sensor capabilities at the center of activity discovery. Our approach identifies naturally occurring signal patterns using privacy-preserving sensors, leverages Vision Language Models (VLMs) only during these key moments for scene understanding, and discovers discrete activity labels at granularities that these sensors can reliably detect. Our evaluation with 12 participants demonstrates OrganicHAR's effectiveness: it achieves 79% accuracy for coarse (4-5) activities using only basic ambient sensors (radar, lidar, thermal arrays), and 73% accuracy for fine-grained (8-9) activities when a wearable IMU, depth, and pose sensor are added. OrganicHAR maintains 77% accuracy on average across configurations while discovering 4-8 categories per user (15 across all users) tailored to each environment and sensor capabilities. By triggering video processing only at key moments identified by local sensors, we reduce queries to VLM by 90%, enabling practical and privacy-preserving activity recognition in natural settings.

item.title: Benchmarking transferability of SSL pretraining to same and different modality segmentation tasks
item.author: Jue Jiang, Harini Veeraraghavan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究对比了九种自监督学习方法在医学图像分割任务中的表现，发现SMIT方法在准确性和数据效率方面表现最佳。

背景: 使用10,412个3D CT扫描图像（覆盖不同疾病部位）对九种自监督学习方法进行了预训练。

目的: 评估不同自监督学习方法在医学图像分割任务中的性能，分析其微调收敛速度、跨模态迁移能力以及在少样本和全样本微调中的特征复用模式。

方法: 将预训练的Swin Transformer编码器集成到SwinUNETR风格的分割网络中，在九个公开的分割任务上进行微调，使用Dice相似系数评估性能，并使用中心核对齐分析收敛速度、迁移能力和特征复用。

主要发现: SMIT方法在九个任务中取得了最高的整体分割准确性和最快的微调收敛速度，且在少样本到全样本微调中性能差距最小，显示出最强的数据效率。基于MIM的SimMIM和自蒸馏方法（DINO, iBOT）优于依赖图像级全局表示的对比学习和旋转预测方法。SSL方法之间的差异在少样本设置中最大，随着标注数据集大小的增加而缩小。

结论: 在标注预算有限的情况下，选择合适的自监督学习方法预训练至关重要。

翻译: Methods: 九种涵盖四种预任务家族的自监督学习方法使用相同的10,412个3D CT扫描图像（1.89~M 2D轴向切片）从零开始进行预训练，覆盖了不同的疾病部位。每种方法的预训练Swin Transformer编码器被集成到SwinUNETR风格的分割网络中（Swin编码器与3D CNN解码器和跳跃连接），并在九个不同复杂度的公开分割任务上进行微调，包括大型腹部器官、头颈部结构和CT及MRI中的肿瘤。使用Dice相似系数评估性能。使用中心核对齐进一步分析了微调收敛速度、跨模态迁移能力（CT到MRI）以及在少样本和全样本微调之间的特征复用模式。Results: 自蒸馏掩码图像变换器（SMIT），结合了掩码图像建模（MIM）与局部和全局自蒸馏，在九个任务中取得了最高的整体分割准确性、最快的微调收敛速度和最小的少样本到全样本性能差距，表明了最强的数据效率。SMIT还在少样本和全样本微调之间显示了最一致的特征复用模式。基于MIM的SimMIM和自蒸馏方法（DINO, iBOT）优于依赖图像级全局表示的对比学习和旋转预测。SSL方法之间的差异在少样本设置中最大，随着标注微调数据集大小的增加而缩小，表明在有限的标注预算下，SSL预训练方法的选择最为重要。

Abstract

Methods: Nine SSL methods spanning four pretext-task families were pretrained from scratch using the same 10{,}412 3D CT scans (1.89~M 2D axial slices) covering varied disease sites. The pretrained Swin Transformer encoder from each method was integrated into a SwinUNETR-style segmentation network (Swin encoder with a 3D CNN decoder and skip connections) and fine-tuned on nine public segmentation tasks of varying complexity, including large abdominal organs, head-and-neck structures, and tumors from CT and MRI. Performance was assessed using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC). Fine-tuning convergence speed, transferability across modalities (CT-to-MRI), and feature-reuse patterns between few- and many-shot fine tuning were further analyzed using centered kernel alignment. Results: Self-distilled masked image transformer (SMIT), which combines masked image modeling (MIM) with local and global self-distillation, achieved the highest overall segmentation accuracy across the nine tasks, the fastest fine-tuning convergence, and the smallest few-shot-to-many-shot performance gap, indicating the strongest data efficiency. SMIT also showed the most consistent feature-reuse patterns between few- and many-shot fine tuning. MIM-based SimMIM and self-distillation methods (DINO, iBOT) outperformed contrastive learning and rotation prediction, which rely on image-level global representations. Differences between SSL methods were largest in the few-shot setting and narrowed as the size of the labeled fine-tuning dataset increased, indicating that the choice of SSL pretraining matters most under limited annotation budgets.

item.title: Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Learning for 4D Radar Scene Flow Estimation
item.author: Jingyun Fu, Zhiyu Xiang, Na Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于图像和里程计的弱监督雷达场景流学习方法，通过实例感知的自监督损失和刚性静态损失来提升性能。

背景: 由于难以获取真实数据，现有方法通常依赖自监督损失或跨模态监督（如3D LiDAR、2D图像和里程计），但存在自监督结果不佳、跨模态方法架构复杂且依赖昂贵LiDAR传感器的问题。

目的: 克服现有方法的局限性，提出一种仅使用图像和里程计作为辅助监督的弱监督雷达场景流学习框架。

方法: 建立两种新颖的实例感知自监督损失，利用现成的2D跟踪和分割算法获取跟踪实例掩码并回投影到3D空间提供语义指导；对于静态区域，结合车辆里程计和雷达内在运动线索构建刚性静态损失。

主要发现: 在真实世界VoD数据集上的实验表明，该方法超越了依赖3D多目标跟踪和密集LiDAR点云的现有跨模态监督方法，以及现有的全监督场景流估计方法。

结论: 该方法在雷达场景流估计任务上表现出色，证明了仅使用图像和里程计进行弱监督训练的有效性。

翻译: 由于难以获取4D雷达场景流估计的真实数据，先前的方法通常依赖自监督损失或使用3D LiDAR数据、2D图像和里程计的跨模态监督。然而，自监督方法由于雷达固有的低保真测量通常产生次优结果，而现有的跨模态监督方法引入了复杂的多任务架构，并需要昂贵的LiDAR传感器从预训练的3D跟踪模型生成伪雷达场景流标签。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种针对弱监督雷达场景流学习的特定任务迭代框架，在训练期间仅使用图像和里程计作为辅助监督。特别地，我们通过利用现成的2D跟踪和分割算法建立两种新颖的实例感知自监督损失，这些算法获取跟踪实例掩码，并将其回投影到3D空间以提供实例级语义指导；对于静态区域，我们将车辆里程计与雷达的内在运动线索相结合，构建刚性静态损失。在真实世界View-of-Delft（VoD）数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法不仅超过了依赖3D多目标跟踪和密集LiDAR点云的现有跨模态监督方法，而且优于现有的全监督场景流估计方法。代码在https://github.com/FuJingyun/IterFlow上开源。

Abstract

Due to the difficulty of obtaining ground-truth data for 4D radar scene flow estimation, previous methods typically rely on either self-supervised losses or cross-modal supervision using 3D LiDAR data, 2D images, and odometry. However, self-supervised approaches often yield suboptimal results due to radar's inherently low-fidelity measurements, while existing cross-modal supervised methods introduce complex multi-task architecture and require costly LiDAR sensors to generate pseudo radar scene flow labels from pretrained 3D tracking models. To overcome these limitations, we propose a task-specific iterative framework for weakly supervised radar scene flow learning, using only images and odometry for auxiliary supervision during training. Specially, we establish two novel instance-aware self-supervised losses by exploiting off-the-shelf 2D tracking and segmentation algorithms to obtain tracked instance masks, which are back-projected into 3D space to provide instance-level semantic guidance; for static regions, we integrate vehicle odometry with radar's intrinsic motion cues to construct a rigid static loss. Extensive experiments on the real-world View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset demonstrate that our method not only surpasses state-of-the-art cross-modal supervised approaches that rely on 3D multi-object tracking on dense LiDAR point clouds but also outperforms existing fully supervised scene flow estimation methods. The code is open-sourced at \href{https://github.com/FuJingyun/IterFlow}{https://github.com/FuJingyun/IterFlow}.

item.title: Data Center Spatio-Temporal Load Flexibility in Security-Constrained Unit Commitment for Enhanced Grid Efficiency and Reliability
item.author: Haoxiang Wan, Xingpeng Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种模块化安全约束机组组合框架，通过协调灵活的数据中心工作负载与系统级调度，以减少可再生能源弃置、缓解输电拥堵并降低运营成本。

背景: 2023年数据中心能耗占美国总能耗的4.4%，预计到2028年将增长至6.7%至12%，给输电网络带来压力，同时代表了可控需求侧灵活性的一大未开发来源。

目的: 提出一种模块化安全约束机组组合框架，协调灵活的数据中心工作负载与系统级调度，旨在减少可再生能源弃置、缓解输电拥堵并降低运营成本。

方法: 建立了三种混合整数线性规划模型：数据中心空间模型、数据中心时间模型和数据中心时空模型，分别支持工作负载的空间重分布、时间转移以及两者的联合激活。

主要发现: 在IEEE 24节点可靠性测试系统的案例研究中，DC-ST模型在40%的灵活性比率下消除了所有基础情况和后故障情况下的输电违规，并将可再生能源弃置减少了高达84.4%；敏感性分析表明，20%至30%的中等灵活性水平已能捕获大部分可实现的效益。

结论: 该框架支持在实际部署中有限的数据中心运营商运营负担，表明适度灵活性水平即可获得显著效益。

翻译: 2023年数据中心电力消耗占美国总量的4.4%，预计到2028年将增长至6.7%至12%，给输电网络施加日益增加的压力，同时代表了 largely 未开发的需求侧灵活性来源。本文提出了一种模块化安全约束机组组合框架，协调灵活的数据中心工作负载与系统级调度，以减少可再生能源弃置、缓解拥堵并降低运营成本。建立了三种混合整数线性规划模型：数据中心空间模型，实现地理分布站点间工作负载的瞬时重分布；数据中心时间模型，允许每个站点在保持每日能量平衡的同时转移其可延迟负载；以及数据中心时空模型，联合激活这两种机制并覆盖最大的可行操作区域。在修改后的IEEE 24节点可靠性测试系统上的案例研究表明，DC-ST在40%的灵活性比率下消除了所有基础情况和后故障情况下的输电违规，并将可再生能源弃置减少了高达84.4%，相对于不可灵活的基线减少了30%。敏感性分析进一步表明，20%至30%的中等灵活性水平已能捕获大部分可实现的效益，支持在数据中心运营商运营负担有限的情况下进行实际部署。

Abstract

Data center electricity consumption reached 4.4% of U.S. total in 2023 and is projected to grow to 6.7--12% by 2028, imposing increasing stress on transmission networks while representing a largely untapped source of controllable demand-side flexibility. This paper proposes a modular security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) framework that coordinates flexible data center workloads with system-level scheduling to reduce renewable curtailment, alleviate congestion, and lower operating costs. Three mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) models are formulated: the Data Center Spatial model (DC-S), enabling instantaneous workload redistribution across geographically distributed sites; the Data Center Temporal model (DC-T), permitting each site to shift its deferrable load across time while preserving the daily energy balance; and the Data Center Spatio-Temporal model (DC-ST), jointly activating both mechanisms and spanning the largest feasible operating region. Case studies on a modified IEEE 24-bus reliability test system show that DC-ST eliminates all base-case and post-contingency transmission violations at a flexibility ratio of 40%, and reduces renewable curtailment by up to 84.4% at 30% relative to the inflexible baseline. Sensitivity analysis further reveals that moderate flexibility levels of 20%--30% already capture most of the achievable benefits, supporting practical deployment with limited operational burden on data center operators.

item.title: LESSViT: Robust Hyperspectral Representation Learning under Spectral Configuration Shift
item.author: Haozhe Si, Yuxuan Wan, Yuqing Wang, Minh Do, Han Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LESSViT是一种用于跨光谱泛化的传感器灵活架构，通过低秩高效空间-光谱注意力机制解决现有ViT方法在效率和表达能力之间的权衡问题。

背景: 不同传感器之间的高光谱图像建模面临波长覆盖、波段采样和通道维度变化的挑战，导致固定光谱配置下的模型难以泛化到其他传感器。

目的: 提出LESSViT架构以实现跨光谱泛化，并引入HyperMAE进行高效鲁棒的预训练。

方法: LESSViT基于LESS Attention，通过可分离的空间和光谱组件建模联合空间-光谱交互，降低计算复杂度；采用通道无关的补丁嵌入和波长感知的位置编码；引入HyperMAE进行解耦的空间-光谱掩码和分层通道采样。

主要发现: 在SpectralEarth基准测试中，LESSViT在光谱偏移下提高了鲁棒性，且在分布内保持竞争力。

结论: 显式且高效的空间-光谱建模对于可扩展和可泛化的高光谱表示学习至关重要。

翻译: Modeling hyperspectral imagery (HSI) across different sensors presents a fundamental challenge due to variations in wavelength coverage, band sampling, and channel dimensionality. As a result, models trained under a fixed spectral configuration often fail to generalize to other sensors. Existing Vision Transformer (ViT) approaches either rely on implicit spectral modeling with fixed channel assumptions or adopt explicit spatial-spectral attention with prohibitive computational cost, leading to a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and expressiveness. In this work, we introduce Low-rank Efficient Spatial-Spectral ViT (LESSViT), a sensor-flexible architecture for cross-spectral generalization. LESSViT is built on LESS Attention, a structured low-rank factorization that models joint spatial-spectral interactions through separable spatial and spectral components, reducing the complexity of full spatial-spectral attention from O(N^2 C^2) to O(rNC), where N is the number of spatial tokens, C is the number of spectral channels, and r is the rank of the low-rank approximation. We further incorporate channel-agnostic patch embedding and wavelength-aware positional encoding to support flexible spectral inputs. To enable efficient and robust pretraining, we introduce a hyperspectral masked autoencoder (HyperMAE) with decoupled spatial-spectral masking and hierarchical channel sampling. We evaluate LESSViT under a cross-spectral generalization setting that simulates cross-sensor variability. Experiments on the SpectralEarth benchmark demonstrate that LESSViT improves robustness under spectral shifts while remaining competitive in-distribution, and explicit and efficient spatial-spectral modeling is essential for scalable and generalizable hyperspectral representation learning.

Abstract

Modeling hyperspectral imagery (HSI) across different sensors presents a fundamental challenge due to variations in wavelength coverage, band sampling, and channel dimensionality. As a result, models trained under a fixed spectral configuration often fail to generalize to other sensors. Existing Vision Transformer (ViT) approaches either rely on implicit spectral modeling with fixed channel assumptions or adopt explicit spatial-spectral attention with prohibitive computational cost, leading to a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and expressiveness. In this work, we introduce Low-rank Efficient Spatial-Spectral ViT (LESSViT), a sensor-flexible architecture for cross-spectral generalization. LESSViT is built on LESS Attention, a structured low-rank factorization that models joint spatial-spectral interactions through separable spatial and spectral components, reducing the complexity of full spatial-spectral attention from $O(N^2 C^2)$ to $O(rNC)$, where $N$ is the number of spatial tokens, $C$ is the number of spectral channels, and $r$ is the rank of the low-rank approximation. We further incorporate channel-agnostic patch embedding and wavelength-aware positional encoding to support flexible spectral inputs. To enable efficient and robust pretraining, we introduce a hyperspectral masked autoencoder (HyperMAE) with decoupled spatial-spectral masking and hierarchical channel sampling. We evaluate LESSViT under a cross-spectral generalization setting that simulates cross-sensor variability. Experiments on the SpectralEarth benchmark demonstrate that LESSViT improves robustness under spectral shifts while remaining competitive in-distribution, and explicit and efficient spatial-spectral modeling is essential for scalable and generalizable hyperspectral representation learning.

item.title: Monitoring the Internal Monologue: Probe Trajectories Reveal Reasoning Dynamics
item.author: Chrabąszcz, Maciej, Szymczyk, Aleksander, Sendera, Marcin, Trzciński, Tomasz, Cygert, Sebastian
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了大型推理模型中思维链的可信度问题，提出通过分析隐藏表示来预测未来行为，并提取信号处理特征以提升预测准确性。

背景: 大型推理模型通过思维链引入了新的安全监控机会，但思维链并不总是忠实于模型的最终输出，从而削弱了其作为监控工具的可靠性。

目的: 研究是否可以从提示词和思维链的表示中预测大型推理模型的未来行为。

方法: 通过在每个生成的标记上评估探针来构建探针轨迹，即概念概率在推理过程中的连续演变；提取信号处理特征以捕捉波动性、趋势和稳态行为；使用基于模板的训练数据；比较平均池化、最后标记池化和最大池化操作。

主要发现: 未来模型行为在完整轨迹上比从单个静态预测中更容易区分；模板训练数据与动态生成的模型响应几乎达到同等效果；最大池化操作能实现高达95%的AUROC并产生稳定的探针轨迹；轨迹特征编码了任务特定的动态，提高了结果的可分离性。

结论: 探针轨迹建立了一个用于监控大型推理模型行为的互补框架。

翻译: 大型推理模型通过思维链引入了新的安全监控机会。然而，思维链并不总是忠实于模型的最终输出，从而削弱了其作为监控工具的可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们调查了大型推理模型的隐藏表示，以确定是否可以从提示词和思维链的表示中预测未来行为。通过在每个生成的标记上评估探针，我们构建了一个探针轨迹，即概念概率在推理过程中的连续演变。我们发现，未来模型行为在完整轨迹上比从单个静态预测中更容易区分。为了表征这些时间动态，我们提取了信号处理特征，这些特征捕捉了波动性、趋势和稳态行为，显著提高了未来模型状态的可分离性。我们还提出了两个方法论见解。首先，基于模板的训练数据与动态生成的模型响应几乎达到同等效果，消除了对昂贵的初始推理和标记的需求。其次，池化操作的选择至关重要：平均池化和最后标记方法几乎退化为随机性能，而最大池化实现了高达95%的AUROC并产生稳定的探针轨迹。使用四个数据集和四个推理模型（涵盖安全和数学领域），我们证明了轨迹特征编码了任务特定的动态，提高了结果的可分离性。这些发现确立了探针轨迹作为监控大型推理模型行为的互补框架。

Abstract

Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) introduce new opportunities for safety monitoring through their Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, CoT is not always faithful to the model's final output, undermining its reliability as a monitoring tool. To address this, we investigate the hidden representations of LRMs to determine whether future behavior can be predicted from prompt and CoT representations. By evaluating a probe at each generated token, we construct a probe trajectory, the continuous evolution of a concept's probability across the reasoning process. We find that future model behavior is more distinguishable when examined over the full trajectory than from a single static prediction. To characterize these temporal dynamics, we extract signal-processing features that capture volatility, trend, and steady-state behavior, significantly improving the separation of future model states. We also present two methodological insights. First, template-based training data achieves near-parity with dynamically generated model responses, eliminating the need for a costly initial inference and labeling. Second, the choice of pooling operation is critical: average-pooling and last-token methods collapse to near-random performance, while max-pooling achieves up to 95% AUROC and yields stable probe trajectories. Using four datasets and four reasoning models across the domains of safety and mathematics, we demonstrate that trajectory features encode task-specific dynamics that improve outcome separability. These findings establish probe trajectories as a complementary framework for monitoring LRM behavior. Warning: This article contains potentially harmful content.

item.title: Protein Fold Classification at Scale: Benchmarking and Pretraining
item.author: Dexiong Chen, Andrei Manolache, Mathias Niepert, Karsten Borgwardt
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了TEDBench基准数据集和MiAE模型，用于蛋白质拓扑分类。

背景: 蛋白质拓扑分类对理解生物功能至关重要，但缺乏大规模、无重复的基准数据集以及模型扩展性不足。

目的: 构建TEDBench大规模无重复基准数据集，并提出MiAE自监督框架以解决蛋白质结构表示学习挑战。

方法: TEDBench基于域百科全书(TED)和Foldseek聚类AlphaFold结构构建；MiAE使用高达90%的掩码率、SE(3)不变编码器和轻量级解码器，从潜在表示和掩码标记重建骨架坐标。

主要发现: MiAE在TEDBench上表现出良好的扩展性，优于监督方法和最先进基线；在CATH v4.4实验结构数据集上测试了迁移能力。

结论: MiAE为蛋白质折叠分类提供了强有力的配方，TEDBench可用于评估蛋白质表示学习方法。

翻译: 对蛋白质拓扑进行分类对于理解生物功能至关重要，但进展受到缺乏大规模基准数据集（避免重复）以及模型扩展性不足的阻碍。我们介绍了TEDBench，这是一个从域百科全书（TED）和Foldseek聚类AlphaFold结构构建的大规模、非冗余蛋白质折叠分类基准。我们表明，在TEDBench上，当前的蛋白质表示学习方法要么需要非常大的模型，要么无法提供强劲的性能。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了掩码不变自编码器（MiAE），这是一个用于蛋白质结构表示学习的自监督框架。MiAE使用高达90%的极高掩码率，以及SE(3)不变编码器和轻量级解码器，从潜在表示和掩码标记重建骨架坐标。MiAE具有良好的扩展性，在TEDBench上优于监督方法和最先进基线，为蛋白质折叠分类建立了强有力的配方。为了测试超越AlphaFold结构的迁移能力，我们进一步在CATH v4.4实验结构的精选数据集上进行了基准测试。TEDBench可在https://github.com/BorgwardtLab/TEDBench获取。

Abstract

Classifying protein topology is essential for deciphering biological function, but progress is held back by the lack of large-scale benchmarks that avoid duplicates and by models that do not scale well. We introduce TEDBench, a large-scale, non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification constructed from the Encyclopedia of Domains (TED) and Foldseek-clustered AlphaFold structures. We show that on TEDBench, current protein representation learning methods either require very large models or fail to deliver strong performance. To address this challenge, we propose Masked Invariant Autoencoders (MiAE), a self-supervised framework for protein structure representation learning. MiAE uses an extremely high masking ratio of up to 90% with an $\mathrm{SE(3)}$-invariant encoder and a lightweight decoder that reconstructs backbone coordinates from the latent representation and mask tokens. MiAE scales well and outperforms supervised counterparts and state-of-the-art baselines on TEDBench, establishing a strong recipe for protein fold classification. To test transfer beyond AlphaFold structures, we further benchmark on a curated dataset from experimental structures of CATH v4.4. TEDBench is available at https://github.com/BorgwardtLab/TEDBench.

item.title: Query-Conditioned Knowledge Alignment for Reliable Cross-System Medical Reasoning
item.author: Yan Jiao, Jingran Xu, Pin-Han Ho, Limei Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于查询条件的实体对齐方法，旨在解决跨系统实体对齐中的静态匹配问题。

背景: 现有的方法通常将实体对齐视为静态匹配问题，忽略了查询上下文和跨系统的非对称性。在整合医疗环境中，概念之间的对应关系本质上是上下文依赖的、非双射的且方向敏感的。

目的: 将实体对齐重新表述为查询条件对应问题，通过将源实体的文本描述视为查询来对目标图中的候选实体进行排名，从而实现上下文依赖的对齐。

方法: 框架集成了语义编码、基于图的表示学习和方向感知转换模块，以捕捉异构知识系统中的非对称和多对多对应关系。

主要发现: 在从SymMap衍生的中医-西医知识图谱上进行的评估显示，QCEA在症状对齐和草药-分子对齐任务上均优于代表性基线，特别是在Hit@K和MRR等对排名敏感的指标上。下游检索增强生成（RAG）实验表明，改进的对齐带来了更好的证据检索、更强的落地性和更高的答案准确性。

结论: 对齐不仅仅是数据集成步骤，而是塑造跨系统医疗推理中知识可访问性和可靠性的关键因素。

翻译: Cross-domain knowledge alignment is essential for integrating heterogeneous medical systems, yet existing approaches typically treat entity alignment as a static matching problem, ignoring query context and cross-system asymmetry. This limitation is particularly critical in integrative medical settings, where correspondence between concepts is inherently context-dependent, non-bijective, and direction-sensitive. In this paper, we propose Query-Conditioned Entity Alignment (QCEA), which reformulates entity alignment as a query-conditioned correspondence problem. Instead of learning a fixed mapping between entity representations, QCEA treats the textual description of a source entity as a query and ranks candidate entities in the target graph, enabling context-dependent alignment. The framework integrates semantic encoding, graph-based representation learning, and a direction-aware transformation module to capture asymmetric and many-to-many correspondence across heterogeneous knowledge systems. We evaluate QCEA on TCM--WM knowledge graphs derived from SymMap, covering both symptom alignment and herb--molecule alignment tasks. Experimental results show consistent improvements over representative baselines, particularly on rank-sensitive metrics such as Hit@K and MRR. Furthermore, downstream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experiments demonstrate that improved alignment leads to better evidence retrieval, stronger grounding, and higher answer accuracy. These findings highlight that alignment is not merely a data integration step, but a key factor that shapes knowledge accessibility and reliability in cross-system medical reasoning.

Abstract

Cross-domain knowledge alignment is essential for integrating heterogeneous medical systems, yet existing approaches typically treat entity alignment as a static matching problem, ignoring query context and cross-system asymmetry. This limitation is particularly critical in integrative medical settings, where correspondence between concepts is inherently context-dependent, non-bijective, and direction-sensitive. In this paper, we propose Query-Conditioned Entity Alignment (QCEA), which reformulates entity alignment as a query-conditioned correspondence problem. Instead of learning a fixed mapping between entity representations, QCEA treats the textual description of a source entity as a query and ranks candidate entities in the target graph, enabling context-dependent alignment. The framework integrates semantic encoding, graph-based representation learning, and a direction-aware transformation module to capture asymmetric and many-to-many correspondence across heterogeneous knowledge systems. We evaluate QCEA on TCM--WM knowledge graphs derived from SymMap, covering both symptom alignment and herb--molecule alignment tasks. Experimental results show consistent improvements over representative baselines, particularly on rank-sensitive metrics such as Hit@K and MRR. Furthermore, downstream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experiments demonstrate that improved alignment leads to better evidence retrieval, stronger grounding, and higher answer accuracy. These findings highlight that alignment is not merely a data integration step, but a key factor that shapes knowledge accessibility and reliability in cross-system medical reasoning.

item.title: OmniPro: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Omni-Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
item.author: Ruixiang Zhao, Jie Yang, Zijie Xin, Tianyi Wang, Fengyun Rao, Jing LYU, Xirong Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OmniPro是一个首个联合评估多模态感知、主动响应和多样化视频理解任务的基准数据集，包含2700个人工验证样本。

背景: 现有的基准主要依赖视觉信号，采用轮询或固定时间戳协议而非真正的主动评估，且覆盖的任务范围有限。

目的: 为了解决现有基准的不足，OmniPro旨在提供对多模态主动流视频模型的可靠评估和区分。

方法: OmniPro包含2700个样本，涵盖9个子任务和3个认知水平，84%的样本需要音频信号，并附带模态隔离标签。评估采用双模式协议：探测模式（在真实触发前查询模型）和在线模式（要求模型自主决定响应时机）。

主要发现: 评估11个代表性模型发现：音频提供一致增益但利用度差异大；性能随时间显著下降；非语音音频感知是最薄弱的维度。

结论: 该研究揭示了多模态主动流视频理解中音频利用的局限性、长期鲁棒性的不足以及非语音音频感知的挑战。

翻译: Omni-proactive streaming video understanding, i.e., autonomously deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous audio-visual streams, is an emerging capability of omni-modal large language models. Existing benchmarks fall short in three key aspects: they rely primarily on visual signals, adopt polling or fixed-timestamp protocols instead of true proactive evaluation, and cover only a limited range of tasks, preventing reliable assessment and differentiation of omni-proactive streaming models. We present OmniPro, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate omni-modal perception, proactive responding, and diverse video understanding tasks. It comprises 2,700 human-verified samples spanning 9 sub-tasks and 3 cognitive levels, covering 6 basic video understanding capabilities. Notably, 84% of the samples require audio signals (speech or non-speech), and each sample is annotated with modality-isolation labels to enable fine-grained multimodal analysis. We further introduce a dual-mode evaluation protocol: Probe mode assesses content understanding by querying the model before and after each ground-truth trigger, while Online mode evaluates full proactive ability by requiring models to autonomously decide when to respond in streaming input. Evaluating 11 representative models reveals three key findings: (1) audio provides consistent gains but with highly variable utilization across models, (2) performance degrades significantly over time, indicating limited long-horizon robustness, and (3) non-speech audio perception remains the weakest dimension.

Abstract

Omni-proactive streaming video understanding, i.e., autonomously deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous audio-visual streams, is an emerging capability of omni-modal large language models. Existing benchmarks fall short in three key aspects: they rely primarily on visual signals, adopt polling or fixed-timestamp protocols instead of true proactive evaluation, and cover only a limited range of tasks, preventing reliable assessment and differentiation of omni-proactive streaming models. We present OmniPro, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate omni-modal perception, proactive responding, and diverse video understanding tasks. It comprises 2,700 human-verified samples spanning 9 sub-tasks and 3 cognitive levels, covering 6 basic video understanding capabilities. Notably, 84% of samples require audio signals (speech or non-speech), and each sample is annotated with modality-isolation labels to enable fine-grained multimodal analysis. We further introduce a dual-mode evaluation protocol: Probe mode assesses content understanding by querying the model before and after each ground-truth trigger, while Online mode evaluates full proactive ability by requiring models to autonomously decide when to respond in streaming input. Evaluating 11 representative models reveals three key findings: (1) audio provides consistent gains but with highly variable utilization across models, (2) performance degrades significantly over time, indicating limited long-horizon robustness, and (3) non-speech audio perception remains the weakest dimension.

item.title: S2Aligner: Pair-Efficient and Transferable Pre-Training for Sparse Text-Attributed Graphs
item.author: Yuhan Wang, Haopeng Zhang, Yibo Ding, Jiaqi Yu, Xinyu Zhao, Yuhang Liu, Ziwei Zhang, Xiao Wang, Ruijie Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: S2Aligner 是一个针对稀疏文本属性图的框架，通过解耦语义对齐和结构建模，利用拓扑感知信号增强对齐，并引入跨域风险平衡机制，有效解决了稀疏数据下的结构-语义对应不可靠和迁移偏差问题。

背景: 现有的基于大语言模型的图-文本预训练方法通常假设节点文本提供充分且可靠的监督，但在现实世界的稀疏文本属性图中，这一假设往往被违反。当文本锚点缺失、噪声或分布不均时，图结构必须与弱语义证据对齐，导致结构-语义对应不可靠和稀疏性引起的迁移偏差。

目的: 提出 S2Aligner 框架，旨在解决稀疏文本属性图中的结构-语义对齐问题，减少跨域泛化差距，并抑制稀疏性导致的迁移偏差。

方法: S2Aligner 将图-文本表示分解为语义和结构组件，使用结构导向的重建与一致性控制将可靠的拓扑线索注入文本表示，并抑制文本稀疏下的不一致结构信号。此外，引入稀疏感知的跨域风险平衡，通过全局域密度比校准域风险，并利用图可靠性估计降低不可靠稀疏样本的权重。

主要发现: 理论分析表明该目标通过控制域风险差异减少了跨域泛化差距；在多样化的图域、稀疏水平和下游任务上的广泛实验表明，S2Aligner 一致优于现有基线。

结论: S2Aligner 能够有效处理稀疏文本属性图，通过解耦语义对齐和结构建模，显著提升了模型性能。

翻译: Pre-training on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is central to building transferable graph foundation models, where LLM-as-Aligner methods align graph and text representations through the semantic knowledge of large language models. However, these methods usually assume that node texts provide sufficient and reliable supervision, an assumption often violated in real-world sparse TAGs. When textual anchors are missing, noisy, or uneven across domains, graph structures must be aligned with weak semantic evidence, leading to unreliable structure-semantics correspondence and sparsity-induced transfer bias. This paper presents S2Aligner, a sparsity-aware and structure-enhanced LLM-as-Aligner framework for graph-text pre-training on sparse TAGs. The key idea is to decouple semantic alignment from structural modeling, allowing topology-aware signals to enhance alignment without contaminating the shared semantic space. Specifically, S2Aligner decomposes graph-text representations into semantic and structural components, uses structure-oriented reconstruction with consistency control to inject reliable topology cues into text representations, and suppresses inconsistent structural signals under textual sparsity. Moreover, S2Aligner introduces sparsity-aware cross-domain risk balancing, which calibrates domain risks through a global-domain density ratio and downweights unreliable sparse samples via graph reliability estimation. Theoretical analysis shows that this objective reduces cross-domain generalization gaps by controlling domain risk discrepancy. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains, sparsity levels, and downstream tasks demonstrate that S2Aligner consistently outperforms existing baselines.

Abstract

Pre-training on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is central to building transferable graph foundation models, where LLM-as-Aligner methods align graph and text representations through the semantic knowledge of large language models. However, these methods usually assume that node texts provide sufficient and reliable supervision, an assumption often violated in real-world sparse TAGs. When textual anchors are missing, noisy, or uneven across domains, graph structures must be aligned with weak semantic evidence, leading to unreliable structure-semantics correspondence and sparsity-induced transfer bias. This paper presents S2Aligner, a sparsity-aware and structure-enhanced LLM-as-Aligner framework for graph-text pre-training on sparse TAGs. The key idea is to decouple semantic alignment from structural modeling, allowing topology-aware signals to enhance alignment without contaminating the shared semantic space. Specifically, S2Aligner decomposes graph-text representations into semantic and structural components, uses structure-oriented reconstruction with consistency control to inject reliable topology cues into text representations, and suppresses inconsistent structural signals under textual sparsity. Moreover, S2Aligner introduces sparsity-aware cross-domain risk balancing, which calibrates domain risks through a global-domain density ratio and downweights unreliable sparse samples via graph reliability estimation. Theoretical analysis shows that this objective reduces cross-domain generalization gaps by controlling domain risk discrepancy. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains, sparsity levels, and downstream tasks demonstrate that S2Aligner consistently outperforms existing baselines.

item.title: Latent Action Reparameterization for Efficient Agent Inference
item.author: Wenhao Huang, Qingwen Zeng, Qiyue Chen, Zijie Guo, Yu Sun, Cheng Yang, Siru Ouyang, Jiri Gesi, Fang Wu, Jiayi Zhang, Huaming Chen, Bang Liu, Xiangru Tang, Chenglin Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为潜在动作重参数化（LAR）的框架，旨在通过学习紧凑的潜在动作空间来提高大语言模型代理的推理效率。

背景: 大语言模型代理通常依赖长序列的低级文本动作，导致有效决策视野长且推理成本高。

目的: 解决动作空间表示本身的关键瓶颈，通过重参数化代理动作来缩短有效决策视野，同时保持原始动作空间的表达能力。

方法: 提出潜在动作重参数化（LAR）框架，学习紧凑的潜在动作空间，其中每个潜在动作对应多步语义行为。与手工制作的宏或分层控制器不同，潜在动作是从代理轨迹中学习并直接集成到模型中的。

主要发现: LAR在一系列基于大语言模型的代理基准测试中显著减少了有效动作视野，并在固定计算预算下提高了推理效率。该方法显著减少了动作令牌和相应的墙钟推理时间，同时保持或提高了任务成功率。

结论: 动作表示学习是扩展高效大语言模型代理推理的关键且未被充分探索的因素，与模型架构和硬件的进步相辅相成。

翻译: 大语言模型代理通常依赖长序列的低级文本动作，导致有效决策视野长且推理成本高。虽然先前工作专注于通过系统级优化或提示工程提高推理效率，但我们认为关键瓶颈在于动作空间本身的表示。我们提出了潜在动作重参数化（LAR），这是一个框架，它学习紧凑的潜在动作空间，其中每个潜在动作对应多步语义行为。通过将代理动作重参数化为潜在单元，LAR能够在保持原始动作空间表达力的同时，在较短的有效视野上进行决策。与手工制作的宏或分层控制器不同，潜在动作是从代理轨迹中学习并直接集成到模型中的，允许规划和执行都操作在抽象动作表示上。在一系列基于大语言模型的代理基准测试中，LAR显著减少了有效动作视野，并在固定计算预算下提高了推理效率。因此，我们的方法显著减少了动作令牌和相应的墙钟推理时间，同时保持或提高了任务成功率。这些结果表明，动作表示学习是扩展高效大语言模型代理推理的关键且未被充分探索的因素，与模型架构和硬件的进步相辅相成。

Abstract

Large language model (LLM) agents often rely on long sequences of low-level textual actions, resulting in large effective decision horizons and high inference cost. While prior work has focused on improving inference efficiency through system-level optimizations or prompt engineering, we argue that a key bottleneck lies in the representation of the action space itself. We propose Latent Action Reparameterization (LAR), a framework that learns a compact latent action space in which each latent action corresponds to a multi-step semantic behavior. By reparameterizing agent actions into latent units, LAR enables decision making over a shorter effective horizon while preserving the expressiveness of the original action space. Unlike hand-crafted macros or hierarchical controllers, latent actions are learned from agent trajectories and integrated directly into the model, allowing both planning and execution to operate over abstract action representations. Across a range of LLM-based agent benchmarks, LAR significantly reduces the effective action horizon and improves inference efficiency under fixed compute budgets. As a consequence, our approach achieves substantial reductions in action tokens and corresponding wall-clock inference time, while maintaining or improving task success rates. These results suggest that action representation learning is a critical and underexplored factor in scaling efficient LLM agent inference, complementary to advances in model architecture and hardware.

item.title: Pointwise Generalization in Deep Neural Networks
item.author: Shaojie Li, Yunbei Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文建立了深度神经网络泛化的点wise理论，通过特征表示的层间特征谱导出点wise黎曼维度，为表征学习提供了新的统计基础。

背景: 为了解决深度神经网络为何能泛化的根本问题，并克服了长期阻碍对丰富非线性特征学习机制进行表征的障碍。

目的: 建立深度全连接网络的点wise泛化理论，构建表征学习的统计基础，并推导出依赖于假设和表征的泛化界。

方法: 通过分析训练模型在每一层中学习到的特征表示的特征谱特征值，导出点wise黎曼维度，以此表征假设。

主要发现: 点wise黎曼维度表现出显著的特征压缩，随过参数化增加而减小，并捕捉了优化器的隐式偏差；该维度在理论和实验中均提供了比基于模型大小、范数乘积和无限宽度线性化的方法更紧的泛化界。

结论: 深度网络在实用范围内是数学上可处理的，其泛化由点wise、特征谱感知的复杂性尖锐解释。

翻译: 本文解决了深度神经网络为何能泛化的根本问题，通过为全连接网络建立了点wise泛化理论。该框架解决了长期阻碍对丰富非线性特征学习机制进行表征的障碍，并为表征学习构建了新的统计基础。对于每个训练好的模型，我们通过源自各层学习到的特征表示的特征值的点wise黎曼维度来表征假设。这为推导依赖于假设和表征的泛化界提供了一个原则性框架。这些界在理论和实验中均提供了比基于模型大小、范数乘积和无限宽度线性化的方法更紧的保证。在分析上，我们确定了解释深度网络可处理性的结构属性和数学原理。在实验上，点wise黎曼维度表现出显著的特征压缩，随过参数化增加而减小，并捕捉了优化器的隐式偏差。综上所述，我们的结果表明深度网络在实用范围内是数学上可处理的，其泛化由点wise、特征谱感知的复杂性尖锐解释。

Abstract

We address the fundamental question of why deep neural networks generalize by establishing a pointwise generalization theory for fully connected networks. This framework resolves long-standing barriers to characterizing the rich nonlinear feature-learning regime and builds a new statistical foundation for representation learning. For each trained model, we characterize the hypothesis via a pointwise Riemannian Dimension, derived from the eigenvalues of the learned feature representations across layers. This establishes a principled framework for deriving hypothesis-dependent, representation-aware generalization bounds. These bounds offer a systematic upgrade over approaches based on model size, products of norms, and infinite-width linearizations, yielding guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter in both theory and experiment. Analytically, we identify the structural properties and mathematical principles that explain the tractability of deep networks. Empirically, the pointwise Riemannian Dimension exhibits substantial feature compression, decreases with increased over-parameterization, and captures the implicit bias of optimizers. Taken together, our results indicate that deep networks are mathematically tractable in practical regimes and that their generalization is sharply explained by pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity.

item.title: Incantation: Natural Language as the Action Interface for Multi-Entity Video World Models
item.author: Zhu, Shangwen, Peng, Qianyu, Pu, Zhao, Shu, Zhilei, Ke, Xiangrui, Xing, Zhaohu, Tong, Zizhao, Wang, Zeqing, Cui, Xinyu, Wang, Huangji, Zhao, Jian, Jin, Yeying, Cheng, Fan, Feng, Ruili
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Incantation是一个交互式视频世界模型，通过自然语言接口实现多实体控制和跨实体概念迁移。

背景: 现有交互式视频世界模型缺乏细粒度多实体控制和跨实体、跨世界泛化能力，主要归因于标准控制协议将动作语义绑定到特定实体或引擎。

目的: 提出自然语言作为接口，解锁先前接口无法实现的表达能力，实现每潜在帧的自然语言条件控制、多实体控制和概念级跨实体迁移。

方法: 将预训练的双向视频骨干网络与帧局部文本交叉注意力配对，通过ODE初始化的自强制蒸馏和RoPE解耦滑动KV缓存实现实时长时序流式传输。

主要发现: 在跨实体迁移上超越动作索引基线（89% vs 43%），在未见词汇提示上优于基线（90% vs 0%），2步学生模型在480p下维持19.7 FPS，在2小时运行中保持稳定的FVD。

结论: 将相同架构和训练配方应用于《拳皇》游戏，仅改变每实体动作词汇槽位。

翻译: 现代交互式视频世界模型已取得令人印象深刻的视觉保真度，但缺乏细粒度的多实体控制和跨实体、跨世界的泛化能力。我们将这一差距追溯到动作接口：标准控制协议（如动画ID、设备输入、场景级描述）在设计时将动作语义绑定到特定实体或引擎。我们提出自然语言作为接口，以解锁先前接口无法实现的表达能力，并介绍了Incantation，这是首个具有每潜在帧（0.25秒）自然语言条件控制的交互式视频世界模型，支持超越任何固定渲染管道的多实体控制和概念级跨实体迁移。我们将预训练的双向视频骨干网络与帧局部文本交叉注意力配对，并通过ODE初始化的自强制蒸馏和RoPE解耦滑动KV缓存实现实时长时序流式传输。我们在跨实体迁移上超越了动作索引基线（89% vs 43%），在未见词汇提示上优于基线（90% vs 0%），我们的2步学生模型在480p下维持19.7 FPS，在2小时运行中保持稳定的FVD。我们进一步将相同的架构和训练配方应用于《拳皇》，仅改变每实体动作词汇槽位。我们在此处发布了Incantation数据集的预览子集，包含手动收集的《艾尔登法环》玩家与Boss战斗片段，以及结构化的面向动作的元数据。随着完整项目的发布，将提供更大规模的《艾尔登法环》和《拳皇》数据。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 Incantation 的系统，利用自然语言作为接口来控制多实体视频世界模型，从而实现通过文本指令生成复杂的视频动作。

Abstract

Modern interactive video world models have achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet lack fine-grained multi-entity control and cross-entity, cross-world generalization. We trace this gap to the action interface: standard control protocols (e.g. animation IDs, device inputs, scene-level captions) bind action semantics to specific entities or engines at design time. We propose natural language as the interface to unlock expressiveness that no prior interface can achieve, and we present Incantation, the first interactive video world model with per-latent-frame (0.25 s) natural-language conditioning that supports simultaneous multi-entity control and concept-level cross-entity transfer beyond any fixed rendering pipeline. We pair a pretrained bidirectional video backbone with frame-local text cross-attention, and enable real-time long-horizon streaming through ODE-initialized Self-Forcing distillation with a RoPE-decoupled sliding KV-cache. We surpass the Action-Index baseline on cross-entity transfer (89% vs. 43%) and out-of-vocabulary prompts (90% vs. 0%), and our 2-step student sustains 19.7 FPS at 480p with stable FVD over 2-hour rollouts. We further apply the same architecture and training recipe to The King of Fighters, changing only the per-entity action vocabulary slots. We have released a preview subset of the Incantation dataset at this https URL , containing manually collected Elden Ring player-boss combat clips with structured action-oriented metadata. Larger-scale Elden Ring and KOF data will be released with the full project.

item.title: CrossView Suite: Harnessing Cross-view Spatial Intelligence of MLLMs with Dataset, Model and Benchmark
item.author: Wei Wang, Yuqian Yuan, Tianwei Lin, Wenqiao Zhang, Siliang Tang, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了CrossView Suite，包含CrossViewSet、CrossViewBench和CrossViewer三个组件，旨在解决多模态大模型跨视角推理的三大差距：大规模高质量训练数据稀缺、系统性评估基准缺失以及跨视角对象一致性对齐机制缺失。

背景: 空间智能要求多模态大模型超越单视角感知，在多个视角间一致地推理对象、可见性、几何和交互。然而，跨视角推理的进展受到三个主要差距的限制：大规模高质量标注训练数据的稀缺、系统性评估的综合基准的缺失，以及跨视角间显式对齐机制的缺失。

目的: 通过开发CrossView Suite来填补上述三个差距，推动多模态大模型从单视角感知向现实世界空间智能发展。

方法: 1. 引入多智能体数据引擎构建大规模高质量跨视角指令数据集CrossViewSet，包含17种细粒度任务类型和160万样本；2. 创建场景分离的CrossViewBench以全面评估MLLM的跨视角空间理解能力；3. 提出CrossViewer框架，采用感知->对齐->推理的渐进三阶段范式，配备自适应空间区域分词器以捕获细粒度对象表示，并显式对齐多视角对象以融合特征。

主要发现: 大规模训练数据、系统性评估和显式跨视角对齐对于推动多模态大模型从单视角感知迈向现实世界空间智能至关重要。

结论: 通过CrossView Suite的三个协调组件，本文成功解决了跨视角推理的关键问题，证明了显式对齐机制和高质量数据集的重要性。

翻译: 空间智能要求多模态大模型超越单视角感知，并在多个视角间一致地推理对象、可见性、几何和交互。然而，跨视角推理的进展受到三个主要差距的限制：大规模高质量标注训练数据的稀缺、系统性评估的综合基准的缺失，以及跨视角间显式对齐机制的缺失。为了解决这些差距，我们全面开发了CrossView Suite，包含三个协调的组件：CrossViewSet、CrossViewBench和CrossViewer。首先，我们引入了一个多智能体数据引擎来精心策划一个大规模、高质量的跨视角指令数据集，称为CrossViewSet，涵盖17种细粒度任务类型，拥有160万样本。其次，我们精心创建了一个场景分离的CrossViewBench来全面评估MLLM的跨视角空间理解能力，并在各个方面对其进行评估。最后，我们提出了CrossViewer，这是一个用于MLLM跨视角空间推理的渐进三阶段框架，遵循感知->对齐->推理的范式。我们的方法配备了一个自适应空间区域分词器来捕获细粒度对象表示，然后显式对齐多视角对象，从而融合对齐的特征以增强MLLM的跨视角推理能力。广泛的实验和分析表明，大规模训练数据、系统性评估和显式跨视角对齐对于推动多模态大模型从单视角感知迈向现实世界空间智能都至关重要。项目页面可在https://github.com/Thinkirin/Crossview-Suite上找到。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型在跨视角场景中的空间智能问题。文中未明确说明该问题的重要性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 CrossView Suite，包含数据集、模型和基准，旨在提升多模态大语言模型在跨视图场景理解中的空间推理能力。

Abstract

Spatial intelligence requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to move beyond single-view perception and reason consistently about objects, visibility, geometry, and interactions across multiple viewpoints. However, progress in cross-view reasoning remains limited by three major gaps: the scarcity of large-scale well-annotated training data, the lack of comprehensive benchmarks for systematic evaluation, and the absence of explicit alignment mechanisms that establish object-level consistency across views. To address these gaps, we thoroughly develop CrossView Suite across three coordinated components: CrossViewSet, CrossViewBench, and CrossViewer. Firstly, we introduce a multi-agent data engine to meticulously curate a large-scale, high-quality cross-view instruction dataset, termed CrossViewSet, covering 17 fine-grained task types with 1.6M samples. Second, we meticulously create a scene-disjoint CrossViewBench to comprehensively assess the cross-view spatial understanding capability of an MLLM, evaluating it across various aspects. Finally, we propose CrossViewer, a progressive three-stage framework for cross-view spatial reasoning in MLLMs, following a Perception -> Alignment -> Reasoning paradigm. Our method equips an adaptive spatial region tokenizer to capture fine-grained object representations, and then aligns the multi-view objects explicitly, and thus fuses aligned features for boosting the cross-view inference capacity for MLLMs. Extensive experiments and analyses show that large-scale training data, systematic evaluation, and explicit cross-view alignment are all critical for advancing MLLMs from single-view perception toward real-world spatial intelligence. The project page is available at https://github.com/Thinkirin/Crossview-Suite.

item.title: Data Presentation Over Architecture: Resampling Strategies for Credit Risk Prediction with Tabular Foundation Models
item.author: Aditya Tanna, Mitul Solanki, Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Pratinav Seth, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了表格基础模型在信用违约预测任务中的表现，重点考察了上下文构建策略对模型性能的影响。

背景: 信用违约预测是一个具有严重类别不平衡、异构特征和严格延迟预算的表格学习问题。表格基础模型通过上下文学习来解决这个问题，但其预测对上下文窗口的构建方式敏感。

目的: 通过在Home Credit和Lending Club数据集上对比四种经典模型和五种表格基础模型，评估不同的上下文构建策略和上下文大小对模型性能的影响。

方法: 在两个数据集上进行了基准测试，测试了四种经典模型和五种表格基础模型，考察了七种不同的上下文构建策略和从1K到50K的上下文大小。

主要发现: 在两个数据集上，上下文构建策略的选择比表格基础模型家族的选择更能解释AUC-ROC的方差；平衡和混合采样比均匀采样增加3到4个AUC点；在5K到10K的平衡上下文下，最强的表格基础模型达到了在完整数据上训练的经典基线的AUC，并且恢复了有意义的违约类召回率。

结论: 证据表明，在信用风险设置中，上下文构建是表格基础模型的主要部署杠杆，而非架构选择。

翻译: 摘要：信用违约预测是一个具有严重类别不平衡、异构特征和严格延迟预算的表格学习问题。表格基础模型通过上下文学习来解决这个问题，这使得它们的预测对上下文窗口的构建方式敏感。我们在Home Credit和Lending Club数据集上对四种经典模型和五种表格基础模型进行了基准测试，考察了不同的上下文构建策略（七种选项）和上下文大小（1K到50K）。在两个数据集上，上下文策略的选择比表格基础模型家族的选择更能解释AUC-ROC的方差：平衡和混合采样比均匀采样增加3到4个AUC点，且差距超过了表格基础模型之间的差异。在5K到10K个示例的平衡上下文下，最强的表格基础模型达到了在完整数据上训练的经典基线的AUC，同时也恢复了有意义的违约类召回率，这是默认阈值梯度提升决策树所不具备的。我们将此视为证据，表明在信用风险设置中，上下文构建是表格基础模型的主要部署杠杆，而非架构选择。

Abstract

Credit default prediction is a tabular learning problem with severe class imbalance, heterogeneous features, and tight latency budgets. Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) approach this problem through in-context learning, which makes their predictions sensitive to how the context window is built. We benchmark four classical models and five TFMs on the Home Credit and Lending Club datasets, varying the context-construction strategy (seven options) and the context size (1K to 50K). On both datasets, the choice of context strategy explains more variance in AUC-ROC than the choice of TFM family: balanced and hybrid sampling add 3 to 4 AUC points over uniform sampling, and the gap exceeds the spread between TFMs. With a balanced context of 5K to 10K examples, the strongest TFMs reach the AUC of classical baselines trained on the full data, while also recovering meaningful default-class recall that default-threshold GBDTs do not. We frame this as evidence that context construction, rather than architecture choice, is the primary deployment lever for TFMs in imbalanced credit-risk settings.

item.title: Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation
item.author: Lv, Xingtai, Sheng, Li, Zhang, Kaiyan, You, Yichen, Gao, Siyan, Luo, Xueheng, Zuo, Yuxin, Fan, Yuchen, Yang, Junlin, Cui, Ganqu, Wang, Bingning, Yang, Fan, Sun, Youbang, Ding, Ning, Zhou, Bowen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ZEDA是一种低成本的框架，通过零输出专家注入和自蒸馏将静态MoE模型转换为动态MoE模型，显著减少计算量并提高推理速度。

背景: 现有的动态MoE方法通常需要从头预训练或特定任务适应，而将完全训练的静态MoE模型转换为动态模型的方法研究较少。

目的: 提出ZEDA框架，旨在以低成本将后训练的静态MoE模型转换为高效的动态模型，从而在推理过程中允许简单token跳过不必要的专家。

方法: ZEDA在每个MoE层注入参数无关的零输出专家，通过两阶段自蒸馏进行适应，利用原始MoE作为冻结教师模型，并应用组级平衡损失。

主要发现: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash模型上，ZEDA消除了超过50%的专家FLOPs，在两个模型上分别比最强动态MoE基线高出6.1和4.0点，并实现了约1.20倍的端到端推理加速。

结论: ZEDA成功实现了静态MoE模型到动态MoE模型的低成本转换，在保持准确率的同时大幅降低了计算开销和推理时间。

翻译: 摘要：混合专家模型通过稀疏专家激活高效扩展语言模型，其动态变体通过根据输入调整激活的专家进一步减少计算。现有的动态MoE方法通常依赖于从头预训练或特定任务适应，导致对完全训练的静态MoE模型在实际转换方面的研究不足。实现这种适应将直接通过允许简单token在服务过程中跳过不必要的专家来减轻推理成本。本文介绍了零专家自蒸馏适应ZEDA，这是一个低成本框架，将后训练的静态MoE模型转换为高效的动态模型。为了稳定这种架构转换，ZEDA在每个MoE层注入参数无关的零输出专家，并通过两阶段自蒸馏适应增强模型，利用原始MoE作为冻结教师模型，并应用组级平衡损失。在涵盖数学、代码和指令跟随的11个基准测试中，ZEDA在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash模型上消除了超过50%的专家FLOPs，且准确率损失极小。它在两个模型上分别比最强的动态MoE基线高出6.1和4.0点，并提供了约1.20倍的端到端推理加速。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种方法，让训练好的混合专家模型通过自蒸馏机制，能够跳过一半的专家。

Abstract

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models efficiently through sparse expert activation, and its dynamic variant further reduces computation by adjusting the activated experts in an input-dependent manner. Existing dynamic MoE methods usually rely on pre-training from scratch or task-specific adaptation, leaving the practical conversion of fully trained MoE underexplored. Enabling such adaptation would directly alleviate the inference costs by allowing easy tokens to bypass unnecessary expert during serving. This paper introduces Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA), a low-cost framework that transforms post-trained static MoE models into efficient dynamic ones. To stabilize this architectural conversion, ZEDA injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer and adapts the augmented model through two-stage self-distillation, utilizing the original MoE as a frozen teacher and applying a group-level balancing loss. On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash across 11 benchmarks spanning math, code, and instruction following, ZEDA eliminates over 50% of expert FLOPs at marginal accuracy loss. It outperforms the strongest dynamic MoE baseline by 6.1 and 4.0 points on the two models, and delivers ~1.20$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

item.title: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
item.author: Zeng, Ziyun, Hua, Hang, Zou, Bocheng, Cai, Mu, Feris, Rogerio, Luo, Jiebo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MementoGUI是一个为基于多模态大模型的GUI代理设计的插件式记忆框架，旨在解决长时序任务中的状态保持问题。

背景: 现有的GUI代理在长时序任务中表现脆弱，通常依赖原始历史回放或仅文本记忆，前者导致冗余截图，后者丢失局部视觉证据。

目的: 引入MementoGUI框架，通过MementoCore控制器实现在线记忆的选择、压缩和检索，将长时序GUI控制视为在线记忆控制问题。

方法: MementoCore将记忆控制模块化为专门的操作符，包括步骤处理、记忆压缩、情节写入和情节选择；开发可扩展的数据管道和MementoGUI-Bench基准；使用多模态大模型指标进行评估。

主要发现: 在GUI-Odyssey、MM-Mind2Web和MementoGUI-Bench上的实验表明，MementoGUI显著优于无历史、历史回放和仅文本记忆的基线，且更大的MementoCore后端进一步增强了记忆增强的GUI控制。

结论: MementoGUI通过插件式记忆增强，无需微调GUI代理骨干网络，即可有效提升GUI代理在长时序决策中的表现。

翻译: 近期GUI代理在视觉定位和动作预测方面取得了显著进展，但在需要跨多次界面转换保持任务状态的长期任务中仍然脆弱。现有的代理通常依赖原始历史回放或仅文本记忆，这要么使模型被冗余的屏幕截图淹没，要么丢弃了未来决策所需的局部视觉证据。为了解决这些局限性，我们介绍了MementoGUI，一个插件式代理记忆框架，它为基于多模态大模型的GUI代理配备了MementoCore，这是一个用于在线记忆选择、压缩和检索的学习控制器。MementoGUI不将交互历史视为固定上下文，而是将长期GUI控制制定为在线记忆控制问题：工作记忆选择性保留与任务相关的界面事件的文本摘要和ROI级视觉证据，而情节记忆通过学习到的相关性选择检索可重用的过去轨迹。MementoCore将记忆控制模块化为专门的操作符，用于步骤处理、记忆压缩、情节写入和情节选择，从而无需微调GUI代理骨干网络即可实现插件式记忆增强。我们进一步开发了一个可扩展的数据管道，将计算机使用轨迹转换为记忆控制器训练数据，引入MementoGUI-Bench用于评估GUI代理中的长期决策，并设计了基于多模态大模型的指标用于语义动作匹配、任务进度和记忆一致性。在GUI-Odyssey、MM-Mind2Web和MementoGUI-Bench上的实验表明，MementoGUI始终优于无历史、历史回放和仅文本记忆的基线，更大的MementoCore后端进一步增强了记忆增强的GUI控制。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了MementoGUI，这是一种面向长跨度GUI智能体的多模态记忆控制学习方法。

Abstract

Recent GUI agents have made substantial progress in visual grounding and action prediction, yet they remain brittle in long-horizon tasks that require maintaining task state across many interface transitions. Existing agents typically rely on raw history replay or text-only memory, which either overwhelms the model with redundant screenshots or discards localized visual evidence needed for future decisions. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{MementoGUI}, a plug-in agentic memory framework that equips MLLM-based GUI agents with \textbf{MementoCore}, a learned controller for online memory selection, compression, and retrieval. Rather than treating interaction history as a fixed context, MementoGUI formulates long-horizon GUI control as an online memory-control problem: working memory selectively preserves task-relevant interface events with textual summaries and ROI-level visual evidence, while episodic memory retrieves reusable past trajectories through learned relevance selection. MementoCore modularizes memory control into specialized operators for step processing, memory compression, episodic writing, and episodic selection, enabling plug-in memory augmentation without finetuning the GUI agent backbone. We further develop a scalable data curation pipeline that converts computer-use trajectories into memory-controller training data, introduce \textbf{MementoGUI-Bench} for evaluating long-horizon decision-making in GUI agents, and design MLLM-based metrics for semantic action matching, task progress, and memory consistency. Experiments on GUI-Odyssey, MM-Mind2Web, and MementoGUI-Bench show that MementoGUI consistently improves GUI agents over no-history, history-replay, and text-only memory baselines, with larger MementoCore backbones further strengthening memory-augmented GUI control.

item.title: Pocket Foundation Models: Distilling TFMs into CPU-Ready Gradient-Boosted Trees
item.author: Aditya Tanna, Nassim Bouarour, Mohamed Bouadi, Vinay kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种快速欺诈评分器，通过离线蒸馏将表格基础模型转换为在CPU上运行的XGBoost或CatBoost学生模型，解决了特定于上下文学习教师的标签泄漏问题，实现了显著的加速和性能提升。

背景: 欺诈评分器需要在2毫秒内回答，而最佳的表格基础模型在GPU上需要151-1,275毫秒，存在巨大的速度差距。

目的: 通过离线蒸馏将表格基础模型转换为在CPU上运行的轻量级学生模型，以填补这一速度差距。

方法: 1. 使用分层留一法（OOF）教师标记防止特定于上下文学习教师的标签泄漏问题。2. 将TabICLv2蒸馏为XGBoost或CatBoost学生模型。3. 在153个分类数据集上评估性能。4. 分析了教师排名转移、特征维度影响、多教师平均以及高维任务下的蒸馏效果。

主要发现: 1. 蒸馏后的XGBoost在CPU上以1.9毫秒运行，达到0.882宏平均AUC，为教师AUC的96.5%。2. 相比CatBoost基线，蒸馏模型在统计上显著更好（Wilcoxon p = 0.0008；51%胜率）。3. 教师排名精确转移到学生排名。4. 性能增益集中在低维数据（<21特征）上。5. 多教师平均对MLP学生有帮助，但对树学生帮助较小。6. 在教师本身落后于CatBoost的高维任务中，蒸馏反而使情况变糟。

结论: 通过分层OOF教师标记和蒸馏技术，成功将表格基础模型转换为在CPU上快速运行的轻量级模型，实现了显著的加速（38倍到860倍），并在性能上保持了接近教师的水平，同时开源了完整流程。

翻译: 摘要：欺诈评分器需要在2毫秒内回答。最佳的表格基础模型在GPU上需要151-1,275毫秒。我们通过将TFM离线蒸馏为在CPU上原生运行的XGBoost或CatBoost学生模型来缩小这一差距。主要的障碍是特定于上下文学习教师的问题：它们在评分自己的训练集时会泄漏标签，因此软目标坍缩为接近独热向量，没有剩余的类间结构可供蒸馏。分层留一法教师标记可以防止这种情况。在来自TALENT、OpenML-CC18、TabZilla和TabArena的153个分类数据集上，将TabICLv2蒸馏为XGBoost在CPU上以1.9毫秒给出0.882宏平均AUC（教师AUC的96.5%），在教师-学生对之间实现了38倍到860倍的加速，并在统计上优于调优的CatBoost基线（Wilcoxon p = 0.0008；51%胜率）。四个进一步的发现：教师排名精确转移到学生排名；增益集中在低维数据（<21特征：比CatBoost高0.011 vs >21特征：高0.001）；多教师平均对MLP学生有帮助（+0.006，p = 0.003），但对树学生增加不到0.001；在高维任务中，如果教师本身落后于CatBoost，蒸馏反而使情况变糟而非更好。完整流程作为TabTune库的一部分开源。

Abstract

A fraud scorer needs to answer in under 2 ms. The best tabular foundation models (TFMs) take 151-1,275 ms on GPU. We close this gap by distilling the TFM offline into an XGBoost or CatBoost student that runs natively on CPU. The central obstacle is specific to in-context learning (ICL) teachers: they leak labels when scoring their own training set, so the soft targets collapse to near-one-hot vectors with no inter-class structure left to distill. Stratified out-of-fold (OOF) teacher labeling prevents this. Across 153 classification datasets drawn from TALENT, OpenML-CC18, TabZilla, and TabArena, distilling TabICLv2 into XGBoost gives 0.882 macro-mean AUC (96.5% of teacher AUC) at 1.9 ms on CPU, a 38x to 860x speedup across teacher-student pairs with a statistically significant edge over a tuned CatBoost baseline (Wilcoxon p = 0.0008; 51% win rate). Four further findings: teacher rank transfers exactly to student rank; gains concentrate on low-dimensional data (< 21 features: +0.011 over CatBoost vs. >21 features: +0.001); multi-teacher averaging helps MLP students (+0.006, p = 0.003) but adds less than 0.001 for tree students; and on high-dimensional tasks where the teacher itself trails CatBoost, distillation makes things worse rather than better. The full pipeline is open-sourced as part of the TabTune library.

item.title: KairosHope: A Next-Generation Time-Series Foundation Model for Specialized Classification via Dual-Memory Architecture
item.author: Luis Balderas, José Alberto Rodríguez, Miguel Lastra, Antonio Arauzo-Azofra, José M. Benítez
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: KairosHope是一个新一代时间序列基础模型，旨在解决标准注意力机制的计算瓶颈和经典统计知识的缺失问题，通过HOPE块、混合决策头和自监督预训练等方法，在分类任务中实现了大规模泛化与分析精度的统一。

背景: 时间序列基础模型在通用预测任务中表现出色，但在专门分类问题上的适应受到标准注意力机制计算瓶颈和经典统计知识系统性遗漏的限制。

目的: 介绍KairosHope，设计一个能够统一大规模泛化能力与分析精度的下一代时间序列基础模型，以解决分类任务中的计算瓶颈和知识缺失问题。

方法: 提出HOPE块，用双记忆系统（Titan模块和连续记忆系统CMS）替代二次注意力；引入混合决策头融合深度潜在表示和确定性统计特征；在Monash档案上进行自监督预训练（结合掩码时间序列建模和对比学习InfoNCE）；通过线性探测和全微调协议在UCR基准数据集上进行适应。

主要发现: 在严格时间因果性领域（如HAR或传感器数据）表现出优越性能。

结论: KairosHope为将基础模型适应到时间序列分析建立了一个稳健且高效的框架。

翻译: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have demonstrated notable success in general-purpose forecasting tasks; however, their adaptation to specialized classification problems remains constrained by the computational bottleneck of standard attention and the systematic omission of classical statistical knowledge. This technical report introduces KairosHope, a next-generation TSFM designed to reconcile massive generalization with analytical precision in classification tasks. The core of the proposal is the HOPE block, an architecture that replaces quadratic attention with a dual-memory system: Titans modules for dynamic short-term retention and a Continuum Memory System (CMS) for the abstraction of long-term historical context. To enrich the inductive bias, a Hybrid Decision Head is introduced, which fuses deep latent representations with deterministic statistical features extracted via tsfeatures package. KairosHope undergoes self-supervised pre-training on the massive Monash archive, combining Masked Time Series Modeling (MTSM) and contrastive learning (InfoNCE). Its subsequent adaptation to the UCR benchmark datasets is conducted through a rigorous Linear Probing and Full Fine-Tuning (LP-FT) protocol to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Empirical results demonstrate superior performance in domains characterized by strict temporal causality such as HAR or Sensor data. Consequently, KairosHope establishes a robust and efficient framework for the adaptation of foundation models to time series analysis.

Abstract

Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have demonstrated notable success in general-purpose forecasting tasks; however, their adaptation to specialized classification problems remains constrained by the computational bottleneck of standard attention and the systematic omission of classical statistical knowledge. This technical report introduces KairosHope, a next-generation TSFM designed to reconcile massive generalization with analytical precision in classification tasks. The core of the proposal is the HOPE block, an architecture that replaces quadratic attention with a dual-memory system: Titans modules for dynamic short-term retention and a Continuum Memory System (CMS) for the abstraction of long-term historical context. To enrich the inductive bias, a Hybrid Decision Head is introduced, which fuses deep latent representations with deterministic statistical features extracted via tsfeatures package. KairosHope undergoes self-supervised pre-training on the massive Monash archive, combining Masked Time Series Modeling (MTSM) and contrastive learning (InfoNCE). Its subsequent adaptation to the UCR benchmark datasets is conducted through a rigorous Linear Probing and Full Fine-Tuning (LP-FT) protocol to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Empirical results demonstrate superior performance in domains characterized by strict temporal causality such as HAR or Sensor data. Consequently, KairosHope establishes a robust and efficient framework for the adaptation of foundation models to time series analysis.

item.title: AI for Auto-Research: Roadmap & User Guide
item.author: Kong, Lingdong, Sun, Xian, Chow, Wei, Li, Linfeng, Lin, Kevin Qinghong, Zhang, Xuan Billy, Wang, Song, Li, Rong, Wu, Qing, Gao, Wei, Wang, Yingshuo, Xie, Shaoyuan, Liu, Jiachen, Qu, Leigang, Li, Shijie, Ng, Lai Xing, Cottereau, Benoit R., Liu, Ziwei, Chua, Tat-Seng, Ooi, Wei Tsang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究分析了2026年4月前的AI在科研全生命周期中的应用，揭示了AI在科研中的可靠性边界及人机协作的重要性。

背景: AI辅助研究已跨过阈值，全自动系统可低成本生成论文，长时域智能体能执行实验、起草文稿和模拟评审，但面临科研压力下的诚信问题。

目的: 对AI在科研全生命周期进行端到端分析，识别可靠辅助与不可靠自主之间的边界，并提供结构化分类法、基准套件和工具清单。

方法: 通过四个认识论阶段（创造、写作、验证、传播）分析AI在科研中的发展，并识别AI在不同任务中的表现差异。

主要发现: AI在结构化、检索驱动和工具中介任务上表现优异，但在真正新颖的想法、研究级实验和科学判断上仍脆弱；生成想法常在实施后退化；研究代码远落后于模式匹配基准；端到端自主系统尚未达到主流期刊接受标准；自动化可能掩盖而非消除失败模式。

结论: 人类治理的协作是最可信的部署范式，需通过结构化分类法、基准套件和工具清单来指导实践。

翻译: AI辅助研究正跨过一个门槛：全自动系统现在可以低成本生成研究论文，而长时域智能体可以以最小的人工输入执行实验、起草手稿并进行模拟评审。然而，这种生产力前沿暴露了一个更深层次的诚信问题：在科研压力下，即使是前沿大语言模型仍然会编造结果、遗漏隐藏错误，并且无法可靠地判断新颖性。通过2026年4月的发展情况研究，我们对AI在完整研究生命周期中的应用进行了端到端分析，分为四个认识论阶段：创造（想法生成、文献综述、编码与实验、表格与图形）、写作（论文写作）、验证（同行评审、反驳与修订）和传播（海报、幻灯片、视频、社交媒体、项目页面和交互式智能体）。我们确定了可靠辅助与不可靠自主之间尖锐的、阶段依赖的边界：AI擅长结构化、检索驱动和工具中介的任务，但在真正新颖的想法、研究级实验和科学判断方面仍然脆弱。生成的想法往往在实施后退化，研究代码远落后于模式匹配基准，而端到端自主系统尚未一致达到主流期刊的接受标准。我们进一步表明，更大的自动化可能会掩盖而非消除失败模式，使人类治理的协作成为最可信的部署范式。最后，我们提供了一个结构化分类法、基准套件和工具清单、跨阶段设计原则以及一个面向实践者的操作指南，资源在我们的项目页面上维护。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何利用人工智能自动化进行科学研究的问题，旨在为研究人员提供一份关于该领域的路线图和指南。这个问题在研究中非常重要，因为传统的科研过程往往耗时且繁琐，利用AI自动化可以显著提高效率，帮助研究人员快速获取和整合信息，从而加速科学发现的过程。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 由于提供的文本仅包含PDF的元数据和二进制数据，没有包含论文的具体内容，因此无法总结其贡献，答案是unknown。

Abstract

AI-assisted research is crossing a threshold: fully automated systems can now generate research papers for as little as $15, while long-horizon agents can execute experiments, draft manuscripts, and simulate critique with minimal human input. Yet this productivity frontier exposes a deeper integrity problem: under scientific pressure, even frontier LLMs still fabricate results, miss hidden errors, and fail to judge novelty reliably. Studying developments through April 2026, we present an end-to-end analysis of AI across the complete research lifecycle, organized into four epistemological phases: Creation (idea generation, literature review, coding & experiments, tables & figures), Writing (paper writing), Validation (peer review, rebuttal & revision), and Dissemination (posters, slides, videos, social media, project pages, and interactive agents). We identify a sharp, stage-dependent boundary between reliable assistance and unreliable autonomy: AI excels at structured, retrieval-grounded, and tool-mediated tasks, but remains fragile for genuinely novel ideas, research-level experiments, and scientific judgment. Generated ideas often degrade after implementation, research code lags far behind pattern-matching benchmarks, and end-to-end autonomous systems have not yet consistently reached major-venue acceptance standards. We further show that greater automation can obscure rather than eliminate failure modes, making human-governed collaboration the most credible deployment paradigm. Finally, we provide a structured taxonomy, benchmark suite, and tool inventory, cross-stage design principles, and a practitioner-oriented playbook, with resources maintained at our project page.

item.title: Lance: Unified Multimodal Modeling by Multi-Task Synergy
item.author: Fu, Fengyi, Huang, Mengqi, Wu, Shaojin, Jiang, Yunsheng, Huo, Yufei, Li, Hao, Song, Yinghang, Ding, Fei, Guo, Jianzhu, He, Qian, Fu, Zheren, Mao, Zhendong, Zhang, Yongdong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Lance是一个轻量级原生统一模型，支持图像和视频的多模态理解、生成和编辑，通过协作多任务训练探索实用的统一多模态建模范式。

背景: Lance不依赖于模型容量扩展或以文本-图像为主导的设计，而是探索通过协作多任务训练实现统一多模态建模的实用范式。

目的: 提出Lance模型，旨在通过协作多任务训练实现统一多模态建模，支持图像和视频的多模态理解、生成和编辑。

方法: Lance基于两个核心原则：统一上下文建模和解耦能力路径。它采用双流混合专家架构处理共享的交错多模态序列，引入模态感知旋转位置编码以减少异构视觉标记间的干扰并增强跨任务对齐。训练采用分阶段多任务训练范式，结合面向能力的目标和自适应数据调度。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，Lance在图像和视频生成方面显著优于现有的开源统一模型，同时保留了强大的多模态理解能力。

结论: Lance通过协作多任务训练和双流混合专家架构，成功实现了轻量级原生统一模型，在多模态生成和理解任务上表现出色。

翻译: 我们介绍了Lance，这是一个轻量级原生统一模型，支持图像和视频的多模态理解、生成和编辑。Lance不依赖于模型容量扩展或以文本-图像为主导的设计，而是通过协作多任务训练探索统一多模态建模的实用范式。它基于两个核心原则：统一上下文建模和解耦能力路径。具体而言，Lance从头开始训练，在共享的交错多模态序列上采用双流混合专家架构，实现联合上下文学习，同时解耦理解和生成路径。我们进一步引入模态感知旋转位置编码，以减少异构视觉标记间的干扰并增强跨任务对齐。在训练过程中，Lance采用分阶段多任务训练范式，结合面向能力的目标和自适应数据调度，以加强语义理解和视觉生成性能。实验结果表明，Lance在图像和视频生成方面显著优于现有的开源统一模型，同时保留了强大的多模态理解能力。
